me 0 /de/de4/ klong 'a ba goms kyi gsung /de//debo satha ma 'jag medayarsā'ajig rten ltar snang lha ghong gaste /de 3 gtwa bge kyang lo4ra she /del pa med:'dod /desazhe sdang gti mug gis:de wo ye nasabasgribs 'bratsolaskun pa min:rang snang rang la shar ba ste:shes rab kyisakyang dpād du med ṣka.oṃpog rgyud lung man ngag rnams kyis ni:de nyid lokhyage brtagasakyang mthong ba min te spyongamalge:dmyal ba byesasong yi dwags dang :rigs drug snang ba ya rigan du shar ba de rang nyid :ched du bsgrubs pa bya4 byungaboltabu ma yin te:thogamaye nas de ltar shar nasayong :skyesabu'i phyol bsasal byung ba min: bri/de dkyil /der de yin spyo'i lha de rang :ma bzla tsho sngagasadang /deraphro phyag rgya ma /de' ma/de pa de:bskyed 4rgya shabong sase she rdzogasapa'i rim pa de:sangasargyasade waduḥ4 semasacan /der 'das yin:dbang spyo la4ra4tho4 dang rim pa ralto⑫dang /de ṣṭha ྾dam /de yin:rang gi bla ma lha yang ngo :zhal hphusalodon /desaman ngag rnam gsum ste:phyi nang /de kyi /desang ba'i bya ba ga/de :dal ba ngag yo sgo lab /detho/dem gsum thob mthong /der:phyi ni lus la na ye shetso ba'i grog yin nang ni sems labasarag bawospyaganas:gsang ba dal na spyopa' /deme durja4rig pa nyid yin no:phyi la cha gsum dag du ste:lusadang ngag dang yid yin rgo:lus kyis yogarten 'a rṣa pa nga so nams rab tu gtang :rkyen med grog me par ri dwagasasma ma yi ra khrod dgon par gnas pa 'o:skor ba la sogasayo7 bya lha phyag dang :'gro dang yan lag bskyod bye rgyu/debazapabyaphro bya 'a5mi bya:grogasadang bralate /deg pur /deg:ngag la rnam pa 8

me ma shulab gal / klong pho ba yims kyi gsu las/()yo ma 'jag medapago'ajig rten ltar snang ltabrasalobang mate chogagaskagyi gtu ba kyang lo4yo — 'khrul pa med:'dod chagasazhe sdang gti mug gis de nyid ye nasabasgribs 'bra༄laglon pa min:rang snang rang la shar ba ste:shes rab kyisakyang dpyad du med waṃyopog rgyud lung man ngag rnams kyis ni:de nyid goyige brtagasakyang mthong ba min te spyongamaryā:dmyal ba byosasong yi dwags dang :rigs drug snang ba ma rigan du sha ba de rang nyid :ched du bsgrubs pa bya4 byungapoltabu ma yin te:thogamaye nas de ltar shar nasayong :skyesabu'i rtsol bsasal byung ba min:yobrigatsa dkyil 'khor de yin sa krola'i lha de rang :ma bzlo phri sngagasadang sa rarga phyag rgya ma bltasa' mchod pa de bskyed rgargyasoshasang mase she rdzogasapa'i rim pa de sangasargyas wadun4 semasacan 'khor 'das yin:dbang ྾ labad4tho4 dang rim pa rkamad gang ma yodam tshig yin rang gi bla ma lha yang ngo :zhal ryāpayodon chemasaman ngag rnam gsum ste:phyi nang galaX kyi gogasang ba'i bya ba gtong :dal ba ngag yo sgo ba chogasatho3ma gsum thob mthong 'gyur phyi ni lus la na ye shes ba'i grog yin nang ni sems labasarag bzhiguganas:gsang ba la na lopa' tso me dutshu4rig pa nyid yin no:phyi la cha gsum dag du ste:lusadang ngag dang yid yin no:lus kyis lagarten 'a go pa wāng so nams rab tu gtang :rkyen med grog me ra ri dwag sma ma sha ra khro dgon par gnas pa 'o:skor ba la sogasayotha bya lha phyag dang :'gro dang yan lag bskyod bye rgyucha rabazapabya༄ bya 'drami bya grogasadang bralate gcig pur 'dug ngag la rnam pa 8

rgyud kya khong don bsdusapa sgron ma snang byed/gsum yin te:'jig rten /del pa'i long ga/de dang :sngags bzlasa.a par smu da kha rṣa brjod rja kyadon ྾bapar྾ sal sogs dang :mdor na brjod pa'i /de rnam spangs:lkugs pa garsā pa byupa yang ga ma/debar dag ni ji ba/de no:yid la rnam pa gsum spang te:bsam dang mi bsam thams cad dang :bzang dang /de ba'i bzang 4 gaju yang gser sgrog gsabacangasapa dang thag pa' sgog gas/deng4pa /de ba' sgo nas ma/de par 'dra'o rtog pa dang :bsam pa'i rgyun rnams /ded pa 'o:semasamed ཿ shesago /de 'gul smod med pa ro dang 'dra bar /deg:nang ni rnam pa gsum yin te:lusakyi spyod pa sbyad mi bya:ngag gis brda tsam nyid mi bya: spyomablo4de ma lo/deyid kyisasgom pa sgom pa min:shes rab kyisakyang /dede /de a ra'e dkuthongalta mi bya:gsang ba rnam pa gsum yin te:mig ni 'gul bar mi bya ste:glang po lta bur g.ya su mi/de /den ༄ ma/de kro po ra lha gnas par bya:lus ni ཿgastang/deg las/del bar mi bya ste:drang srong nyid dang /deg stangs rtsag ṭudang gan /deng khya asab/de:sgon mo/de pa 'a shes pa /del bar mi bya ste:mda' bsrang migagazur wonate ba/de du mig tu ga/de:lus kyi gnad ni dal ba rtsa 4 /de gyishalab4yin:ngag gnad smra ba /ded pasalasakya rma ma snang tsho ma langasan ye shesarang bas gyasaskye ba'o pa yin:semasakyi gnad ni ga/de pa dbugs kyang yad sne7na payin:le 'u rnam pa drug dag gis:gzhung gi tshad rnams rdzogs pa 'o:a ti:rgya::bkra shisamadzes ldan /de bya ba'i:rgyud kyi /de don bdun duphyejayām par /ded:ngo bo /del pa ga/de thoskyarang sar grol:nges/de rnam pa bzhi yin te:snang ba ཿnga ba lnga' bgarduladang bralabasaye shasalnga' rang 'odag/deb ma 'dres yongs rdzogs 8

rgyud kya khong don bsdubapa sgron ma snang byed/gsum yin te:'jig rten 'khrul pa'i long gtam dang :sngags bzlasalo par ma kha rsā brjo yo kyadon ga par4 sal sogs dang :mdor na brjod pa'i tshig rnam spangs lkugs pa gar pa byung yang go malasabar dag ni ji bzhin no:yid la rnam pa gsum spang te:bsam dang mi bsam thams cad dang :bzang dang ngan ba'i bzang ba gaja yang gser sgrog galobacang pa nga thag pa' sgog gsabacang pa 'ching ba' sgo nas mnyam par 'dra'o rtog pa dang :bsam pa'i rgyun rnams bcad pa 'o:semasamed lu shesago 47 'gul smod med pa ro dang 'dra bar 'dug nang ni rnam pa gsum yin te:lusakyi sprod pa spyad mi bya:ngag gis brda tsam nyid mi bya: rgamablobade ma yos yid skyosasgom pa sgom pa min shes rab kyisakyang chagade bas wa gor ྾thobalta mi bya:gsang ba rnam pa gsum yin te mig ni 'gul bar mi bya ste:glang po lta bur g.ya su mi'akhrul g.yon ༄ ma'akhrul po po ra lha gnas par bya:lus ni khrugastangs sag lasa'ado/la bar mi bya ste:drang srong nyid dang 'dug stangs tsog budang gnayangang khya masabazhin:sgron malags pa 'a shes pa 'gul bar mi bya ste:mda' bsrang migagazur wonate bzhin du mig tu gzhug:lus kyi gnad ni dal ba rtsa ba bas gyishalabayoyin:ngag gnad smra ba bcad pasal kya mo ma snang po ma langason ye shelorang ba' gya skye ba'o pa yin semasakyi gnad ni gtad pa bugs kyang yad yo༅na payin le 'u rnam pa drug dag gis:gzhung gi tshad rnams rdzogs pa 'o:a ti:rgya::bkra shisamadzes ldan zhes bya ba'i:rgyud kyi tshig don bdun dubyerasdam par bshad ngo bo 'khrul pa gagrog thorsārang sar grol ngesatshig rnam pa bzhi yin te:snang ba lung ba lnga' bgarduladang bralab ye sha lnga' rang 'odag4ba ma 'dres yongs rdzogs 8

me 0 shulab/delag klo ṣṭha ba stimasaspyo gsu /de//depas:sago nas ra snyogo/debakra zhesabya bar rnam par /ded:brjod bcas /del po cisabyu zhe na gzhi khungs bcad ya gzhi de'i shesa' malasaphyir:gnas lugs ngos nasashis pa 'o:sgon ma /den mo.agyi sgon ma /desu me zung khrug rang gsal phyir:'od kyi rgyan du mdzeesapa bragarṣas āo snyo྾ chalta losnye /de:thamasacad zhi gre/dewesnurdzogasapasaldan /depa'o:dbye ba rnam pa gsum yin te:ཿla pa'i ཿnga khungasadzeeltarsān 4da pa dang : ma /del ba'i ye shesasakha la dbab:/dedzide wo gzhi la ldog pa 'o:dgosapa /del pa brtsad ṣṭhad de:eshe /dedang hpha gzhi khagalabazlog pa 'o:dper na sa dkulhobospyor lo lta bu ste:ཿla pa de nyid rtsamoran ma shesan:lu ṣkag nas ṣkag tu āosnyo yun ring spyor:spyor lo ma bskor sor bas na:de wo rang sar dag pa 'o:khong don man ngag bzhi yin te:/del pa'i gzhi nyid lhun khrub si po chephasalug gto dbab dang :/del pa'i /del lugs/de riltolo ltar sag bstan pa dang :ma /del ye shesango/dewaṃltongos/deng dang :de wo ldog pa'i 'a idaṣka wogabazlog pa 'o:/delaba'i ye shesamarispyo /de4 sbag sbog de:thog ma ca yiྈsatsāskruspesnyekadag /del med las:ngesapa med pa'i she/de/derṣab lhun grub las:sna /desadu ma'i ྾spyo/der /de la:lo⑩shesaltardorgo bltar 'gagasapa med pa'i rol pa ni:/de'i rtsalasnyocir yang mdzad cing cir yang rṣar:ngesamed snang ba du ma /de:de nyid go/de she/dezu lo blo can la:mthong ba ma 'gags maza she 'i cha bgasnephyiragyuraste nang gsal 84

me ba shulabazhagalag klo za ba khumasarkya gsu 'bum/()pas soryā nag ra snyogosalasabakra zhesabya bar rnam par bshad:brjod bcas 'khrul po cipobyu zhe na gzhi khungs bcad ya gzhi de'i shesa' rtsal phyir:gnas lugs ngos nasashis pa 'o:sgron ma mdza na mayogyi sgron ma la sasu me zung 'jug rang gsal phyir 'od kyi rgyan du mdzesapa theg ༄ yo 4༅ tshalha yo4 ཿsa'o:thamasacad zhi khrologakhe rdzogasapasaldan zhesapa'o:dbye ba rnam pa gsum yin te:wal pa'i ཿnga khungasadziltaban 4da pa dang : ma 'khrul ba'i ye shesasam la dbab zhubade rsā gzhi la ldog pa 'o:dgosapa wal pa brtsad yod de:yeshe ——dang pho gzhi gagalabazlog pa 'o:dper na ma ྾྾bsgyur lo lta bu ste:ཿla pa de nyid rtsa jan ma shesan:lu waṃg nas ryāg tu gogo yun ring yor spyor lo ma bskor sor bag na:de go rang sar dag pa 'o:khong don man ngag bzhi yin te:'khrul pa'i gzhi nyid lhun khrub si po chewa lug gto dbab dang :'khrul pa'i 'khrul lugasag rigayo ltar sas bstan pa dang :ma 'khrul ye shesangoshos/lhongosabazung dang :de go ldog pa'i she rṣadarna lagabazlog pa 'o:'khrulaba'i ye shes risha lag4 sbag sbog de thog ma ca yipobarsāyomesgokadag 'khrul med las:ngesapa med pa'i shes 'jagobasolhun grub las:sna tshogasadu ma'i ྾rṣasashar tshul la mayeshe ltabarṣa bltar 'gagasapa med pa'i rol pa ni ga'i rtsal4cir yang mdzad cing cir yang yor ngesamed snang ba du ma g.yo:de nyid bag sheyogazu lo blo can la mthong ba ma 'gags theja she 'i cha bgayophyirawarate nang gsal 84

ma kyi khong don/ bsdu pa sgon ma snang byed/te:de la ngesapa'i oṃ —nga ba'o:de ltar gnasapa'i gzhi de las:/de tsha/de rgyu dang /del ba'i sabon shesangarṣa snesnyoni:ga/de ba'i cha /de byedadu ni phyir shor bas:shes pa gsal ga4 drag⑩ cha ༅ lngo labadakhe she /derṣarababartag gsal rig rig ste:ma rig pa ni rgyu khag toṣkagapa dang / sa /desapa dpa/catwa brtaltohphumirag pa gsum dag las:yid /de phyir /desate /depa/depo/desgoshar snang cha las:yul de gaskemabadag tu /deng ba'i blos:gzhi dang gzhi yi ngebo kag snang cha zubal:gzhi dang gzhi /dekhyad par /del:ngobo /de /derje /dem ragapatsho/del pa'i rgyu lasayul rkyen phrad:rkyen pha rṣa ragapa dngadamig/de rṣa yul nga bag lo rkyen der 'dzan dang de ma thag rkyenade rnam dus/desalo ba/de dmigs pa ma dag pas:sna tshogs snang ba'i gsal cha 'dres:yid drug maragapadang/des gyidkud/phad kya rnam shes/ gto la 'bebs/ tso du /de/ rnam par dag pa/ nges pa 'jogapa' 'dzin pa ma 'gagasapas:nyon mongs drug gi dugalngamorakhasabadag tu changs:yul drug skyagayadra ro reg /deso /de snang ba shar:de ltar yul la bdag bzung bas:de nas rim gyis phyi sgod napa/de kyi:snang ba mi2 ba du mas chu /derag dru7 gzugs bsdus pa'o:'di nyid mi shes gdamasapa 'di med pa'i theg pa spyo khrus pa rnams:zo ⑫ bzhi te /de/debargyud mar gnas:so /de lus dang tshad de yang kha dog sna tshog shesalo dusan rgod pa la dgag pa' thab med rma dang thig le shar ba ryā gyis thog lo lusakya 4 gsarig drug so0྾ga su len pa'o:de ltar /del pa'i don shesanas:ma /del ye shes 'e na/de hphudon 'di lta bu:nam mkha' /del skyinadang /depa med pa la:rig pa /del med rdo rje tsos phyungasabyasate:dbang po /del pa 8

mes/de shul /de las/ klong /de rab /dem kyagasu 'bum//demed par ga ma2labar blta:de ltar gsum shes ñdza su āo shāsnye bude.āo/de rgya’ ma grag hphu sar rnal /der pas:gzer gsum dag ni gdab par bya:lusakyi gnad ni rtsa྾ banyuta yin te:stemasadang gcud pa mgadang tshol pa.astasnyopaskungabasi pa'o de rtse sa dang 'breyos g.ya.āoyon gyasad thabs mchog tu /des:rig pa'i gnad ni ye she rma dang༄rta rgyub /de yin te:bzung dang lhortsa bskyil 'og rma bsdam mchog tu gces:dbyings kyi sgron ma'i gnad ni 'od mthing kayin te:ma/de pa'i dus tshod la 'a dog sna rgas su /de ba' dus su rgod pa mnan pa'i thabasade lasartsa dang thig le shar ྾ na byang ba seng thabasabazung ba /des:ma /del ye shesade ba 'a no:gdeng gsum thob pa'i rnal hphur la:snang ba ngo bo ka dag tsorang shar dngo༅ rang grol yin pasan/:sa྾ngade rig pa nyid ladang pokakag/del rgyu med:/delargyu med pas/desakyi kṣiṃb gzhi la bskyal:rig pa ngo bo dang snang ba rtsa lhoradag du 'gro ste dus ma/des pas:/del pa nyid ni de wa spyo rgyumede /dedu/degazhi log pa'o:le 'u bdun 'ad rgyu le'u lnga lasam snang ba rgyud kyi 2sa ma sgo 4 brtag gyis ga/de rdzogs so:i ti:rgya rgya rgya:thal /der /debya rgyud kyi ni:de'idon /der byed pa nges lung rtogs par byed pa'i dziḥ'adi nyid don ni rnam par dbye:ngo bo 4gi 2gadzeerang rig bde /de la:ga/de gyi brjoshka dang bralabaradzo rtsod pa'i skyon rnamasaskrong :nges tshig rnam pa gnyisayin te:sgra /deng bang /deg paldog pa'i ga.adus bstan pas: grag stong byer med sgra /de rnam par /ded pa 'o:de nyid blos btags rang/de po/de lamalusker grol bas:thal /der zhesasu /ded pa 'o:dbye na rnam pa gsum yin te:sgra lngang ba' 5nga / bkod pa'asgra nga / āo4pa' dang / grag cha 86

mesapo'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'dum kyagasu 'bum/(2)med par ga po labar blta de ltar gsum shes shka su go ༅snye budebasags rgyasku ma grag yo sar rnal 'byor pas:gzer gsum dag ni gdab par bya lusakyi gnad ni rtsal bahūṃta yin te:stemasadang gcud pa mgadang lal pa'astasnyoparsāngabapo pa'o de rtse yo dang 'breyos g.yagayon gyasad thabs mchog tu bsdes:rig pa'i gnad ni ye shesopo dang༄ge rgyub rlung yin te:bzung dang rṣapo bskyil 'og po bsdam mchog tu gces dbyings kyi sgron ma'i gnad ni 'od mthing g.yin te mched pa'i dus tshod la 'a dog sna mas su 'char ba' dus su rgod pa mnan pa'i thabasade lasapo dang thig le shar yi na byang ba seng thabasobazung ba gces:ma 'khrul ye shesade ba 'a no:gdeng gsum thob pa'i rnal 'byor la:snang ba ngo bo ga dag spyarang shar dngob rang grol yin pasan:ba྾ngade rig pa nyid ladang pogashaga'akhrul rgyu med:'khrulargyu med pasapas sakyi ltab gzhi la bskyal:rig pa ngo bo dang snang ba rtsa lhoradag du 'gro ste dus mtshungs pas:'khrul pa nyid ni de wa spyo rgyumede pa sgodusgoyongagazhi log pa'o:le 'u bdun 'ad rgyu le'u lnga la ma snang ba rgyud kyi gas ma tsha 4 brtag gyis gzhud rdzogs so:i ti:rgya rgya rgya:thal 'gyur zhesabya rgyud kyi ni:de'idon g.yabar byed pa nges lung rtogs par byed pa'i ga 'di nyid don ni rnam par dbye ngo bo ba khrugasarang rig bde chen la gzhan gyi brjoshka dang bralababashka rtsod pa'i skyon rnamasaspong :nges tshig rnam pa gnyisayin te sgra 'byung bang 'dug paldog pa'i g.yodus bstan pas: grag stong byer med sgra zhes rnam par bshad pa 'o:de nyid blos btags rangagaso pogs lamalu4ra grol bas thal 'gyur zhesasu bshad pa 'o:dbye na rnam pa gsum yin te:sgra lung ba' sgrang / bkod pa'asgra nga / sasapa' dang / grag ma 86

rgyud kya khong don bsdu pa sgon ma snang byed/stso bzhi ga/de 'bebasathal /der dang :gzhi gnas/de sade a 'dzin thal /der dang : sgra rgyud de rnamasalabartagasapa /deng rkyen grogs 'a/de thal /der ro:dper na bang mdzod lde mig gsaphya ba.āosalasgo0da padang 'dra:dgosapakozhen rgyud rnams ga/de dag gi:sgra don ga/de la 'bebasapa'o:khong don man ngag gang zhe na:rnam pa gsum du bstan pa yin:rtags khopadang/de྾bkod yi ge'i sgra don dang :rigs drug deragatso rag she pa' oṃ /degasakyi rang sgra dang :/deng ba sachu ma rmasgamo/de lnga yi sgra don no:de dag yisasu āo pa ga/de la ngesaphab nas:rtog med rag cha ltahphu sgo /des su blangs pa yis:'ad ltarasnang ba thams cad rang ge grogs su /der:rtags bkod yi ge'i sgra don ni:brjod pa'i ri gsi sgra dang lusal gnas pa'i sgra:braskebakod pa'i sgra dang gsum yin no:brjod pa 'i sgra ni ming gi tshogs:du ma brjod pa'i rang sgra rnamasaḥthig le nyag /deg gango bo ྾gagasgra da ཿ — ba' sgra la/de' spros med pas:pha rol sgra ni grags pa stong :mad snang tsam du brag cha lta bur shes pa ste:snang ba cer /depan ba/de thabasadang 'brel:dang po yog nyamasasu len dus su:ngag ni /ded pas supa ya— ga7 ma brjod pa ra 'dug pa ngag la gnad yan pa ra rang brjod 'gags:mi rtog bsam ga/de /de por ཿ she/deg4 gnas:gnas pa' 9 rang gi lusanyid la:ā li kwa li phreng gnas sna— jang phrang bsaspyoran/de pas rtsanangan rkyang par:ngag tu ji ltar brjod pa ā laka la la4ma 'da' rnams:ā li ka li'i bzlas sngagasazlo ma da/dehphu/ded pa'o:wo su sa 'di nyid shes pa'i yo gi ni:ngag tu brjod pa sngagasayin pas:dmigs gto med pa' sngags kyi /deng ba 'o:de phyir gang bsams bsam 8

rgyu kya khong don bsdu pa sgron ma snang byed/stso bzhi gtan 'bebasathal 'gyur dang :gzhi gnasatshad sade ma 'dzin thal 'gyur dang : sgra rgyu de rnamasalabartag pa 'byung rkyen grogs 'char thal 'gyur ro:dper na bang mdzod lde mig ga phya barsāsalaphorsād padang 'dra:dgosapagazhen rgyud rnams g.yin dag gi sgra don gtan la 'bebasapa'o:khong don man ngag gang zhe na:rnam pa gsum du bstan pa yin:rtags khopadangag ga྾bkod yi ge'i sgra don dang :rigs drug dedagatso rag she pa' rga gzugasakyi rang sgra dang :'byung ba sochu ma mo mogs lnga yi sgra don no:de dag skasasu 'a pa gtan la ngesaphab nas rtog med rag ྾ lngayo na nyams su blangs pa yis 'a ltarasnang ba thams cad rang ge grogs su 'gyur rtags bkod yi ge'i sgra don ni brjod pa'i — gagi sgra dang lusal gnas pa'i sgra brayobakod pa'i sgra dang gsum yin no:brjod pa 'i sgra ni ming gi tshogs:du ma brjod pa'i rang sgra rnams:thig le nyag gcig gango bo 4gag da lu — ba' sgra lasogami' spros med pas pha rol sgra ni grags pa stong :mod snang tsam du brag cha lta bur shes pa ste:snang ba cer gsapan bzhag thabasadang 'brel:dang po yogathanyamasasu len dus su:ngag ni bcad pas supa yas gawa ma brjod pa ra 'dug ba ngag la gnad man pa ra rang brjod 'gags:mi rtog bsam gtan chen por khu shes ga4 gnas gnas pa' tsho rang gi lusanyid la:ā li kā li phreng gnas sna jang phrang bsarsāranagasasopas rtsanangan rkyang par:ngag tu ji ltar brjod pa ā la la lasam 'da' rnams:ā li kā li'i bzlas sngagasazlo ma dgosakugand pa'o:yo su rga 'di nyid shes pa'i yo gi ni:ngag tu brjod pa sngagasayin pas dmigs gam med pa' sngags kyi 'phreng ba 'o:de phyir gang bsams bsam 8

me tsho shul /delas/ klong snyo rab tsomasakyi gsu khrum//deg/de yin:bkod pa'i sgra ni yi ge 〉posnyo ste phoḥbos dang 'bod /deladug thamasaca bri yon pa nyid yin no:bos pa rnams ni ba/de tshig yin te:rsā/dergyu mehphudangos por brtagasapa thamasacad do:brtagasapa de kun rang grol bar rag gro/del5 /detsha :yo gi dag gisashesapa na:yi ge zad pas grangs mtha' zad:de phyir thig le nyag /deg go:'bod pa'i sgra ni ā li /de dang :gī li sum ṭubazhi la sogs:gzhi rtsal snyosna /desasnang bsan:'di nyid kyang ni ṣkar brjod pasastong :snang la rang bzhi med pa ste: na chu zla lta bur shesapar bya:lusal papo loganas pa'i yi ge de:snying gi dkyil na phrehla adukun gnasate:lce dang sob dang mchu rnams/dekya ba dang :rkan kug dang mgrin par dag nas /deng :de nyid yo gis rab brtags na:gnas storku yan de gnasamed rang gogapa so 'o:ā li kwa li'i tshogasarnams kyis: rtsa ren yoge /de4 rtsa rnams skyed par byed pas na:kha dog kasamadzwadabye ba shesapar bya:de /de la brtagasawa/de las/de zad:riltosheshethig le zla dang bral ba 'o:/deng ba lnga yi sgra don ni:rnal /der /deg /de lta ba desadango/de lamathongabar 'dopa:phyi yi /de 'dzi rnam spangs te:dben pa' gnas su migo shās song nasakyang :thog ryāspyo ma sngon du 'gro ba ni:lus kyi gnad ṣkare /desalusakyi rṣa /de 4du langs pa la:rkang pa lag pagogapaltagadengasabyasate:mjing pa yid /de /de/degye lab/dergyab tu 'o:ngag gi gnad dusgyuoboskeng 'don ku co che:rtsol ba drag posaskad ོpo rnams /deng gagarṣapaza:semasakyi gnad du /deb shehphu88

sa kyi khong —na bsdu sgon ma sna bye/su mkha' la sbur:de la dran pa /de gsal bar bya:de nasathang cig pha samyos par /der:de nasade nyid dran sangs la྾nas:spyod lam ji ltar babomos pa bya:dben pa'i gnas sam 5ma thamasayo du margyub lung stong du:/de dan la sogasasha shi0/deloshing rnamasakyi:phung po la sogasarab byasate:de lame /de ga/de byasal:mkha' 'gro ma la rgarka ga/de ma sbyin:de nasame yi dbyebs la sa slo/dengo/debartag:me /de ⑫byibasapal sogasamadung rtse lngaṭuni:dbang dang dgug pa'i lasarnams/deng/deb:/der lo tsoral spri lta5pagru gsum ni:/de bsgrad dang /dedrag /de lasarnams/deb:de lade g.ya stong rang ba/de med shesanas: 4to ja lto mo/de rnal /der spyod pa nyid la sbyar:kha dog nyid kyang dkug ོkhrubarnam par brtag:dkar ser mi rtog ye shesasode ṣkang⑪baya:shin tu dkar la gdangs pa /de/de/de ni:rnal /der byang chub sems rṣa po:snying rjes 'gro ba'i don sprulaspyon byed rtags:rab tu dmar la ga/de dwangasapa ni:cung /de 'jig rten du spyod pa gnas hphu gas:dbyibs kyang lug gi rwa dang /des:sngo nag 'jigasapa'i 4dku nar ཿgan dbyebasa'adra na:drag /de༄latsa kyispyopasna 7 spyod pa sna /des kyis:dur khrod dag tu 'gro sa/deg/de rgyu bar bya:/des/degaskolaser la rtsi gnag pas:bdag ni 'jigs pa kun spangasate:seng ge lta bur/de gno 'a 'jag bral gyi ga rgyu bar bya:de ltar spyod pa mchog byas nas:yang ni dben pa de nyid du:bud shing tshogs la me sla ya me busal:de nas 'dom /de sa rja du:bde ba'i stan la /deg nasani:lus kyi gnad ni phyos song kha89

ma kyi khong na bsdu sgron ma sna bye/su mkha' la spur:de la dran pa gas gsal bar bya de nasathang cig ra samyos par 'gyur:de nasade nyid dran sangs ba྾nas spyod lam ji ltar babamos pa bya:dben pa'i gnas sam ryām thamasas du ma ba lung stong du tsan dan la sogasasha shiyo4bskayoshing rnamasakyi:phung po la sogasarab byasate:de lame chen gtang byasal:mkha' 'gro ma la rgan gtor ma spyin:de nasame yi dbyibs la ma momangongos brtag me tog rkabyibashabal sogasamadung rtse ltabuni dbang dang dgug pa'i lasarnamasagasanga'agrub:'khor lo b.ral gri ltabubagru gsum ni:gos bsgrad dang migacidrag po'i lasarnamasa'agrub:de lade gab stong rang bzhin med shesanas: bawa ja lto mos rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid la sbyar:kha dog nyid kyang ryāg ོrsā rnam par brtag dkar ser mi rtog ye shesasode ṣkangayobapha:shin tu dkar la gdangs pa rkag4ba'aja ni rnal 'byer byang chub sems go po:snying rjes 'gro ba'i don sprulakhun byed rtags:rab tu dmar la gsal dwangasapa ni cung zhig 'jig rten du spyod pa gnas lo gas dbyibs kyang lug gi rwa dang mtshungs:sngo nag 'jigasapa'i nas nar lugan dbyibasa'adra na drag po'i༄lamasakyisapasna lo spyod pa sna tshogs kyis:dur khrod dag tu 'gro stobacagashis rgyu bar bya:chagasachenagasalaser la rtsi gnag pas bdag ni 'jigs pa kun spangasate:seng ge lta burags gno 'a 'jag bral gyi ga rgyu bar bya:de ltar spyod pa mchog byas nas yang ni dben pa de nyid du bud shing tshogs la me sla ya me busal:de nas 'dom do'i sa go du:bde ba'i stan la 'dug nasani:lus kyi gnad ni byos song kha89

me po'i shul bzhag la / klong pho rab bamasakya gsung 'bum/(la/med pa ste:yod par gyur pa thams cad la:ye shes ye shes zhes bya'i tshig:tshig tu brjod pa kun brjod de:don kun 'di zhesadonangobo ra 'a yan gogs gya gas lamapheb pa lom rtogs pas po ti glegs bam yi ge rnams gca lo payir kyang :dgos med tshi chad ngal ba'i rgyu 'di dag gis4sargyarsāl rya thob pa lo no:'o na sangs rgyasakyi gsungasapa dgosapa med dam zhe na/ re zhig ma yin pa'i sgo 'dogs gcod pa tsam yan/dpe ra na gser ma yan pa'i sgro 'dogs bcad nas gser rang ma shesapa dang 'dra bar gnas lugasam yin pa'i sgro 'dogs yod na gnasalugasarang ngo ma shesapa'o:'di nyid mi shes rmongs pa ste:'og ma rnams dang khyad med 'gyur:des na rnal 'byor gsayo lagomasang/ gces:nyams blangs bsa'akhrul te ma she4ra gol ba ni:gangalu labarṣa yolusakyi gnad nyidarkachestem shes na dkor mdzod nabanologasabasgo mo dam dkrigasa'adra ོra pogon phyi nasanor rnyed ma yin no:phagasalaralo lhasnyengaskyed pa yi ni rim pa dang :don 'di nyid ni khyad med 'gyur:phanagadabyings kyi rma yo gnad ga ma shes na:bya long nam mkha'i mtha' 'tshol ma4 pagatomed྾moso podang 'dra rig pa'i gnad rdo rje gagurgyud de ma shes na: samed la jothapor lon pa nam mkha' spar gyisa'adebs pa dang 'dra:lu lularasha' gnad gsum man ngag mi shes par:chags gyi sgor sa nalobasgom par 'dod pa'i sgom chen pa spyad dbang med pa'i nor sapo'i ྾ ྾da bdag 'dra de yab sapo wa ba yotshangade'i ponatha lagrangabashegs de phyir gsum nyid du 'brel ba'o:rig pa'i rten salusayosayoyin te:lusagacig med na med pa dku pogag2sa yo ste yod na ye shesayod par rigapa ñtsapar nges:de ltar lusal ga yod pa de chosacan spyi yi 94

rgyu kya kho shen bsdus sgron ma snang byed/ma/de nyid /despya kyis:spyi /de gtsug nasarkang mthil bar a/de spyo lagasapa la:brtag dpyad rnam pa sna /des kyis:dpyad pas de nyidaraske.āo' rnyed pa min:mo dang pra la sogs pa yiḥrtsisani rnam pa sna /desakyis:/de྾g.ye she4yan bltas shing dpyad khyang rnyed pa min:'o na alabastan menge /de med yin zhe na:bstan du med pa ma yin te:lus gnad stems na ma/de du ma/de sa gapa gagam༄ /dedu snang :dper na lus la khrag khyab ste skyesartsal/desakha lnga sayong:skyesabu glen pa 4khosheske'aga' /de gis:gang gang lus la rtsamepa4 4 gto ya khrag btsal bas:gcig kyang /deng ba ma galoronga'a'o yin no/ 'o na lus la khrag med dam khon:lusal khrag med ma yin te:/debosga rkang /den sathamasacad khyab cing khrag la brten:skyesabu thabasadang ldan pa polta cuyis:gargyuphro rtsa la ga/de na khrag /deng ltar:lusaganasaye shesade ba/de no akyagan ma she4na me shesami /de lushan la ṣkan nas/de ོ yul gyi gnad ni nam mkha' stem mu: kham 'di nyid mi shesakha /deg gis:/de dang ma/de mo med pa sanam mkha' nyid la /dewobaltasabyasakyang ཿri/deye she 'di wo mthong ba ma yin no:lhan 'onanamo྾ lamisnyesnerṣa du med pa ma yin teḥ'adi nyid kyisams4lagomasapa'i rnal /der pas:bltasha skadacig /de la don shes wīr:rig pa'i gnad ni rṣa mo du:rtag tudabya ragade nyid la gnas tso che bya:ga/de pa'i sems kyisaskad cig kyang :yengasashing blta bar mi bya 'o:'o na gnad gsum ye shes de:'di nyid ma gtogs gag rnams kyis:mthong ba dag ni med dam ca rṣa:gag lta spyod pa'i rnal /der 9

rgyu kya kho na bsdus sgron ma snang byed/mtshan nyid gosagru kyis:spyi bo'i gtsug nasarkang mthil bar as rṣa largasapa la:brtag dpyad rnam pa sna tshogs kyis:dpyad pas de nyidadarsāga' rnyed pa min:mo dang pra la sogs pa yi:rtsisani rnam pa sna tshogasakyis:ston྾naye she yan bltas shing dpyad kyang rnyed pa min:'o na a bstan menge sha krol med yin zhe na:bstan du med pa ma yin te:lus gnad stems na mngon du mgagade sa gapa sagamaja sumadu snang :dper na lus la khrag khyab ste skye bulakhragagi ga zha ma྾nga:skyesabu glen pa bas ske'aga' zhig gis:gang gang lus la rtsamepa'i 4 gto ya khrag btsal bas gcig kyang 'byung ba ma galoganga'a'o yin no/ 'o na lus la khrag med dam lon:lusal khrag med ma yin te:tso bon rkang 77༄na sathamasacad khyab cing khrag la brten:skyesabu thabasadang ldan pa blta buyis gargyupo rtsa la gtar na khrag 'byung ltar:lusaganasaye shesade bzhin no gakyagan ma sheson ye shesami lan lugan la shen nasalas ོ yul gyi gnad ni nam mkha' stem ga: yamaso 'di nyid mi shesakha gcig gis:nyin dang mtshan mo med pa phunam mkha' nyid la salagobaltasabyasakyang :rigasaye she 'di go mthong ba ma yin no:wan 'onanam྾ la yosago du med pa ma yin te:'di nyid kyigamasababagomasapa'i rnal 'byer pas bltasha skadacig nyid la don shes lur:rig pa'i gnad ni rṣa mgo du:rtag tudabyasoragade nyid la gnas shka che bya:gzhan pa'i sems kyisaskad cig kyang :yengasashing blta bar mi bya 'o:'o na gnad gsum ye shes de:'di nyid ma gtogs gag rnams kyis mthong ba dag ni med dam ca go:gawa lta spyod pa'i rnal 'byor 9

me po'i shubabazhag las/ klo chen ba 'byam rkya gsu 'bum/(2)pas:'di nyid ma bstan bar du ni:ji ltar brtagasakyang ཿsharka phyi mthong ba min dam pa'i gdamasangag 'di bstan na pen ba rnams lus la 'o masakhyab kyangagorsāgayo ryā kya 'oglo'akhya:mkhasapasanu ma nasa'adren na 'o ma dag ni ཿnga ba bgo:྾ du yokyigadashe4 mgo du gsal te lusagand kyang :rtag tu gomasasgoyodaku'aphrodang khyad med mthong :tso ba shesapa pho 'didage gol 'a pa'irtag shan pa smad 'tshong sdig can yang 'di nyid bstan pasagrol thob 'gyur khru solani ye shesas phapa 'a mimatho bsababyagowa thosarang sangasargyasarnamasadang :byang sems tho mosayesgrib pa bral gsangs ma tshu rdzulasayosanu bsakyang :'di nyid gnad gsum rgya yob gding med na:rdul cha tsam yang mthong mi 'gyur rgyal ya bsna du mashe gro gawa dag gisani smos ci dgos:desan rtagatu gomasadang thabs kyi phog nyid gces le'u bdun gyis gzhu don rdzogs:i ti:rgya rgya rgya::sgron ma 'bar ba zhesabya ba'i rgyud kyi go don bdunadu wayibashad par bya:ngo bo gsal byed snang ba ston babaryānges go rnam pa gsum yin te:rṣa thabagag ñtsamun pa thams cad sel bsasgron:kun gyi gzhin gyurd ga' 2ga yom yin no:'od zer kun tu yangs pa'i phyir 'bar ba yin pasagasal bar mja yodugayo:dbye na rnam pa bzhi yin no:rnam dag dbyingasakyi sgron ma mtha khaluse kya'o dang :thig le stong pa'i sgron ma dang gsarṣa mapo:shes rab rang byung sgon ma rigartsagogayongage go dang :rgyang gsachu yi sgron ma ྾daskesgo go ba'o:dgosapa rgyud rnamasagawa gyi go:'di go du ni sa96

me lo shul/de las/ klo ོ ba 4masakya gsu khrum//depas:'di nyid ma bstan bar du ni:ji ltar brtagasakyang ཿshaphro phyi mthong ba min:dam pa'i gdamasangag 'di bstan na:pen ba rnams lus la 'o masakhyab kyangago4 losarṣa kya 'oskelto:mkhasapasanu ma nas/den na:'o ma dag ni /deng ba bzhi:྾ du tsikyiphagashedku ma/de du gsal te lusagand kyang :rtag tu goms/de/dedang khyad med mthong :/debo she pa yo 'didage 7la 'asapa'itag shan pa smad /deng sdig can yang:'di nyid bstan pasagrol thob /der tshosadkulani ye shesas goya 'a mimatho bsardobyaphakha thosarang 4sargyasarnamasadang :byang sems pta mo/desgrib pa bral /de 7saspyo dzu/denu bsakyang :'di nyid gnad gsum rgya 4/de gding med na:rdul cha tsam yang mthong mi /der rgyalalospu 4snapadu mashesaskegronigag dag gisani smos ci dgos:desan rtagatu gomasadang thabs kyi swog nyid gces:le'u bdun gyis galnga don rdzogs:i ti:rgya rgya rgya::sgon ma 'bar ba /debya ba'i:rgyud kyi spyo don bdunadu sku/ded par byaḥngo bo gsal byed snang ba ston 4rkahphunges /de rnam pa gsum yin te:/de shābagasha rnyimun pa thams cad sel bsasgron:/de gyi ga/de gyuradashe/de 2ga dzeem yin no:'od zer kun tu yangs pa'i phyirasnye'abar ba yin pasagasal bar mdzo 4dudzolpo:dbye na rnam pa bzhi yin no:rnam dag dbyingasakyi sgon ma mtha khalngase kya'o dang :thig le stong pa'i sgon ma dang ga rṣa mayo:shes rab rang byung sgon ma rigartsa/de/dego dang :rgyang /desachu yi sgon ma dkudaskerṣa go pe'o:dgosapa rgyud rnamasagag gyi gho:'di ṣka du ni spyo96

rgyu kyi khong rdon bsdus sgron ma snang bye/ba snang bar byed:dper na ga/de byed sgon shingagime rṣan an /dengababazhi:khong don man ngag rnam pa lnga:mi phar ba7sa pa spyo gi sgon ma yis:'jig rten ming gi shen hphu pas bon byed:rtan 'brel rdzasakyi sgon ma ྾da/deshangal/deyis:ba/desapa grangs kyi sa/des/dergya mun pa sel ba.a:spyi mthun las kyi sgon ma nyi zla /deyis:'gro ba'i mun pa sel bar byed:marja pa dpe yi sgon ma 'a saspyolgon yis:log rtog ma ci /de'agal ba'i the /de sel:ye shes rtags kyi sgon ma /de thag/deyis:bag /des/deg /de mun pa sel:ye shes rtagasakya/de la bzhi yin te:'od kyi rtag su dbyengasayarṣa — ayin no:ye shesartagasasu thig le rmatsorasgo྾ste:sku yi rtagasasu lu gu rgyud gser gyitpapa lta /deg /deshasatsosartagasasu /de dag /deg:de yang sa dusmogasang don gsum du bstan: ngaphre shesasu sgon ma'i gnasani snying yin te:lam ni she ryacu/de she/dertsa ོ bzhi yin no:sgo ni mthong byed mig gi sgo:/des su len par 'dod pa sarya4yis:/del pa'i bya ba phyanastekun bto ste:dur khrod gnasasam dben /dekho rtsabadag wo spyog pur gnas kyang rung :lta spyod mthun pa'i grogs btsal te:bsam gto gnod pa'i dgra rnamakheg 2 lo hphu khyi sgra a spangs lasnyesgron ma nyid lo ba byephe ཿsani goms byed na:ཿla /der barṣa du gnad rnamasastems:lus kyi gnad ni snying yin pasasnyedang dku dus su ba4 rgyun na popasha/de/dereyen /ded:snying gi gnad ni rtsa yin pas/desawagasagyusra/de/despyosasku/de dang ོ labazlog dang thur du mnan pa ni:yo gi nyid kyisashesapar bya:9

rgyu kyi kho don bsdus sgron ma sna bye/ba snang bar byed:dper na gsal byed sgron shing me mun min yogababago:khong don man ngag rnam pa lnga:mi phar bawas pa go gi sgron ma yis:'jig rten ming gi na tshu bas bon byed:rtan 'brel rdzasakyi sgron ma ྾dbasashangalasosayis btagasapa grangs kyi sas samajargya mun pa sel bapo:spyi mthun las kyi sgron ma nyi zlo ྾yis:'gro ba'i mun pa sel bar byed:mgo pa dpe yi sgon ma 'a bgolgon yis:log rtog ma ci loga'agal ba'i the tshom sel:ye shes rtags kyi sgron ma chogs thagalongasayis:bag chagasa'athug po'i mun pa sel:ye shes rtagasakya70de la bzhi yin te:'od kyi rtag su dbyingasamayo — wayin no:ye shesartagasasu thig le metsolo4bste:sku yi rtagasasu lu gu rgyud gser gyi pa lta 'dug tshulagasa.a rtagasasu 'gyu dag 'phrig:de yang sa durṣagasang don gsum du bstan yoye she su sgron ma'i gnasani snying yin te lam ni babu྾ shegagartsa pho bzhi yin no:sgo ni mthong byed mig gi sgo:nyams su len par 'dod pa g.yoyoyis:'khrul pa'i bya ba phyanagakun bto ste dur khrod gnasasam dben sa yo rtsabadag go spyog pur gnas kyang rung :lta spyod mthun pa'i grogs btsal te:bsam gam gnod pa'i dgra rnamaḥb 2 'a ryā khyi sgra rsā spangs la:sgron ma nyid yo ba byeyo bsani goms byed na:'khrul 'khor bzhi du gnad rnamasastems lus kyi gnad ni snying yin pas:dang po'i dus su baryā rgyun rka popashagayokhasareyen bcad snying gi gnad ni rtsa yin pasarig sayogasalngagrabasadapaga'i spyosasugs dang yo labazlog dang thur du mnan pa ni:yo gi nyid kyisashesapar bya:9

me /de shul ba/delas/ 1nga /de rab /demasakya gsu /dem//dertsa yi gnad ni mig yin ragapa /desasgo yod pas :seng ge gyen /deng thakarodang ri bong ya por dang :mda' zur gyas/de srang lta bu lta stangs bzhi:nyin dus rnal /der pa yis sheyo ma/delalta:ma/de dus shes bya bum par ga/de /detshidabug4nang du ༄bal:shes pa nyid ni snying khar 'od kyago bu la bsdu:sgon ma tsita /de dkyil du she pa rari ga/destems:thig le rtsa 'od 7bapayi nang du sba:desani ye shes nang du tso nangagamar tsheltar gsal:de ltar nyin dang ma/de dus su:/de4 rgyun du byed pa'i rnal /der pas:goms pa'i phroṃ ni rtsal dkusargya wo/deng dang ma/desaḥde nasagoms te mthar /desu dkuyo' mmuphyin pas:/de rṣa lagamo lu pa'artag dang ma/de mo gnyis med par:rtag tu /de mo ba/de du lusasnyong 'od ltar 'ong /der:de dus rnal /der pa de nyid rag larma dnga'adre/delusakyi rtags shapa bal ltar ni yang ba dang 'bu sa 'ong :rta ltar mgyogs shing ye shesakya rtsa lacha oṃ pa'artags sug/de/ la mig mi /des/a4nang ⑫bomed:zas dang skom gyi dran pa 'gags rma la'agro'ong mad pa 'artagasasushe rang lalo ⑫ga 'dod pa med kyang de ltar /deng :shes rab rtsal ma 'gag4pa la rtags ni 'di lta bu:shasarab dang rag pa dbyer med pa' rtagasasu sngar mthong ma myong ba'i chosaspya dza rangaka shes0dang :ngag tu /depa she hphu kya dbaskulas lochegasasu ci brjod /de kyi ga/de ཿpa :— sdodam pa 'dresahphu༄ga su lung dang rgyud kyi tshig rnams kun:ma bltas ba/de du rang la 'char:rig pa'i rtag ni lu gu rgyud ltodzo/de:/del dang 'phrig pa nyid bral tesnyesnang ba rang sar sto4yo rṣa du sa kshirtagasasu she pa garagato dum /der gnas pa'o:gsang ba nyams su phyong ba'i rtags gang bzhi dzeegasadrug ga 'gro ngarag par grol bsadamyal ba la sogs ngan song 98

me po'i shul bzhagalas/ klong chen rab 'byamasakya gsu 'bum/(3)rtsa yi gnad ni mig yin ra pa langaposgo yod pas :seng ge gyen lasang thakapadang ri bong ma por dang :mda' zur gyasamo srang lta bu lta stangs bzhi:nyin dus rnal 'byor pa yis she4 mags g.yolta:mtshan dus shes bya bum par gzhug mkha༅dbugabanang du ༄bal:shes pa nyid ni snying khar 'od kyago bu la bsdu:sgron ma tsita ta'i dkyil du shesopa ra gas stims:thig le rtsa 'od jabapayi nang du sba:desani ye shes nang du yo nangagamar tsheltar gsal:de ltar nyin dang mtshan dus su:yo rṣa rgyun du byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas:goms pa'i rga ni rtsal ma rgya wogashong dang mtshungs:de nasagoms te mthar lnga su lo4'a lophyin pas:nyin rṣa lagayolu pa' gsadang mtshan mo gnyis med par:rtag tu nyin mo bzhin du lusasnyong 'od ltar 'ong 'gyur:de dus rnal 'byor pa de nyid rag papo dnga'adreyogalusakyi rtags shang bal ltar ni yang ba dang 'bu mam 'ong :rta ltar mgyogs shing ye shesakya po lam oṃ pa'artagasasugazhan la mig mi chags/sarsānang 0bamed:zas dang skom gyi dran pa 'gags po la'agro'ong mad pa 'artagasasuo rang laca yog 'dod pa med kyang de ltar 'byung :shes rab rtsal ma 'gag pa lalortags ni 'di lta bu shasarab dang rag pa dbyer med pa' rtag su sngar mthong ma myong ba'i chosakya rga rangag shesabadang :ngag tu gsapa shesab kya dbarsā'as yortagasosu ci brjod chos kyi gtam lung :/ bdam pa 'dresoḥhog su lung dang rgyud kyi tshig rnams kun:ma bltas bzhin du rang la 'char:rig pa'i rtag ni lu gu rgyud yorsābs:'gul dang 'phrig pa nyid bral te:snang ba rang sar stobam rṣa du ma thartagasosu she pa garagato dum ngasalar gnas pa'o:gsang ba nyams su phyong ba'i rtags gang bzhi snyog drug ga 'gro ngarag par grol bsadamyal ba la sogs ngan song 98

rgyud kyi khong rdon bsdusapa sgron ma snang byed/la: de wo rangaragaspyoshe4 ya nga bag tsha kun dang bral: ri/lo/des/de sangasargyasal yang brod pa med: gzha la spyor ba mkhrub pa ra shesapa sa'akhar bar lhung dogs sdug bsngal bral: mya ngan 'das la de rṣa raju rig yin — ra rtogasapas re ba med/ le'u bzhi yis gzhung don rdzogs: e ti: rgya:rnor bu 'phra bkod ces bya ba'i: rgyud kyi tshig don bdun gyisabastan par bya:ngo bo rang rig gzhi la sna rgasarapagroladuspyodaḥ nges tshig rnam pa gsum yin te: sa gzhan gyi dgos pa 'dis skong phyir: dgos 'dod 'a na pas motsā ba labaskapa banor bu 'o: rdo rje lug rgyud 'phra zhi— 'dor ba brtags dka' bas: kun gyisami mthongagarsha gzung bar dka' ba phra ba'i don: de ltar rtegs dka'i ngo bo nyid ye shes de:yul la khyab pas nam ma kha' lashes ba bkod pa 'oḥ dbye ba rnam pa gsum yin ce:rang sharasnang ba thakhruyo rang grol longs spyod pas: gzhi la longasaspyod kun gyi nor bu da— 'dra: phra rag pa de rtsa shesakyi rtsalagyisadang 'khrug dang 'gyu ba'i tshe: 'di nyid kye gnad ra pa ra g.yin gyis mi mthong zadagato da pagadatsobophyir phra: snang ba dum bu dum bu'i tshe 'od dum bu dum bur shar tshe: mched pa rtogs phyir je che je che mthong bsabakod pa'i don:dgos pa ji lngaṭuzhetho rgyud gzhan 'dod pa rnams: rgyud 'di nas rab tu ston byed pasaḥ phra mo'i don rnams rtogasabyed pa'o: dper na bzhu ba'i /yammusabya4shang gser dang mtshungs: khong don man ngag du ston rṣa rnam bzhi ste: spyod pa gtso snyodu byed rnal 'thur dang : sgom pa 7 shesargyun du byed pa dang : lta ba nyid la gtsor lam du byed dang: de bshes 'bras bu lam byed pa'o/ /spyod pa rnam pa gsum yin te: bying rgod gseng ba'i spyod pa ni: lngo rṣa midugagal te bying ba 99—

rgyud kyi khong don bsdusapa sgron ma snang byed/la: de go ra rigatushesapa ya nga bag tsha kun dang bral: rigapa'asongasas pasosangabasargyapo/la yang brod pa med: gzha la yor ba mgrub pa ra shesapa sa'akhor bar lngang dogs sngag bsngal bral: mya ngan 'das la de rṣa rang rig yin — ra rtogalopas re ba rnyid/ rle'u driṅge yis gzhung don rdzogs: e ti: rgya:nor bu 'phra bkod ces bya ba'i: rgyud kyi tshig don bdun gyisabastan par bya ngo bo rang rig gzhi la sna masar groladuspyod: nges tshig rnam pa gsum yin te: po g.yin gyi dgos pa 'dis skong phyir: dgos 'dod 'byin pas masgo ba labaskang banor bu 'o: rdo rje lug rgyud 'phra zhi 'gyur ba brtags dka' bas: kun gyisami mthongagazhi gzung bar dka' ba phra ba'i don: de ltar rtegs dka'i ngo bo nyid ye shes de:yul la khyab pas nam ma kha' lolan ba bkod pa 'o: dbye ba rnam pa gsum yin de:rang sharasnang ba tha4yo rang grol longs spyod pas: gzhi la longasaspyod kun gyi nor bu dang 'dra: phra rig pa de po shesakyi rtsalagyisadang 'khrug dang 'gyu ba'i tshe: 'di nyid kye gnad yo pa ra gzhan gyis mi mthong zadagayo da pagadagabaphyir phra: snang ba dum bu dum bu'i tshe 'od dum bu dum bur shar tshe: mchod pa rtogs phyir je che je che mthong bsabakod pa'i don:dgos pa ji lngabuzhe3 rgyud gzhan 'dod pa rnams: rgyud 'di nas rab tu ston byed pas: phra mo'i don rnams rtogasabyed pa'o: dper na bzhu ba'i g.yayosabyargashang gser dang mtshungs: khong don man ngag du ston yo rnam bzhi ste: spyod pa gtso 4du byed rnal 'byor dang : sgom pa rṣa langargyun du byed pa dang : lta ba nyid la gtsor lam du byed dang: de bzhin 'bras bu lam byed pa'o/ /spyod pa rnam pa gsum yin te: bying rgod gseng ba'i spyod pa ni: kṣasayo rgyadugagal te bying ba —99

me po'i shulabashagal / klo 'a rab khum rgyagasu khrum/()'gagags bsnang duyid rma chu:mthar phyin 'bras bu gtan la dbab lu kya༄snyo gi na na sku nga ye she su gan pa grog gi wa rtsa'i na/ na thig le ba ge'i gan mig ga sgron ma' nang du rtag tu 'charab gnad gsum bzhag pa'i ngo sprod kyis:rang gi 'dug tshul nyams su blang :de la gnad gsum ngo sprod ni:de ltar ye shesalu rkyag 4rten 'o sakhrus rarka ltaba' gan laban pas nyi shu rtsa gcag tu phye ya bang po spros pa la ga' ba'i na yonate grangs gsogan nyer bag de dag kun 'di nyid du ni rnam par bsdusan:ye shesalusagand tho yogan las mig tu 'dus:'od ni yul mi 4lalasasagand nam mkha'o:rig pa mthong gnad 6nya lu gu rgyud:sprul sku lus gnad man ryāwaṃsnying yin te:longasasku yul gnad 'gagyisdegadabyingasasu bstan:chosasku rig gnad lu gu rgyud brtenabawaṃ yoyodape ni lusagand rtsa mgatsoshka yin te:rtagasani yul waṃ yisnang ba dang gnad sgron ma 'o:don ni rig gnad dbyingasakhru rga medab rig 'dres gzhung don le'u gsum gyis rdzogs i ti:rgya rgya rgya:mu tig phreng ba zhes bya b.lon nan la ngo bo man ngag 6kha kheg khrigs chags kyis:'khrul ba'i yul rkyen gzhi la radag du bzlog:ngesatshig rnam pa gnyisayin te:mu tig man ngag khrigs dulogangagablorkuyo dang 'brel:phreng bas grangs rnams gcig du sdud:dbye ba rnam pa bzhi yin te gzhi gnas rang sar yenasab lam pa grol bas mu gnad gsum lugand snying srogagand rtsa dbang lo gnad migago ste mi 'gyur gzer 'debs tig: ltaraganag gnapaso'adod pa'i don spyod rin po che dbyingasarig khru wal go par rgyun chagasaganas phyir phreng :dgosapa man ngag dum bur rga chu 'an 2sopar ston dper na ja 'dramu tigakhriwa04

rgyud kya khong don bsdu pa sgon mosnang byed/ga su brgyus legasa'adra:khong don man ngag rnam pa gsum:/del pa rang dag rang gi rapa grol bar blta rkyen grol mu:gal mdo 5/de sdud byed grol byed /de:a/degand gsum thob yul /desalen phreng :/del pa dumoro/deshe pa grol /de dbang ོrtulaspyo gnyis yin te:'bad med /de4gi 4/de man ngag rang gisarang grol dang :'bad bca/degand dang /delen gyi dusasu lus/deg stangasakyi gnad yularkyen med kyi gnad rig pa ma rtsal ba'i /ded da 'brel ba 'o:gal mdo'i man ngag /de gcig ste:sngon byung thog ma rtog te sangs rgyas ma byung ma rtogaste sems can ma byung ba'i gnasalugasaka dag gzhi ngo bo /del pa mi mnga' ba'i ye shes/ded pa med par ka nas dag pa'i rig pa la bzhugs so /de bzhin cha yisam gosapa'i snang ba kha dog lasa'adasapa'i gsal ba rang du ba/des so thugasarje ni ye shes phra ba'i ye shesasu 'dod ste de med na bems po dang khyad med rags par na gzugs sku gnyis dang khyad med pasaphra bar yod gsum gyi bdag nyid do de yang rang gi /deg /de gyi cha la ngo bo ka dag gi ye shesade /del ma myong bsarang ba/de lhun grub kyi ye shes sogasal byed bag la nyal te cha /de bar yod zugs rje kun khyab gyi ye shes rang ba spe shugasal ga/de ba/dede las ma nges lhun /deb ga/de sna tshogs ma ngesapa'i gzhi /de bya ste /dekhrub rin po /de lus la bag /desakyi sa bon langs te rṣa mongs pa lnga'i sa bon bag ྾ byuri :ma rig rgyu bdag 7 spyog pa'i ma rig pa ni rang gi ga/de cha lasabyung de nyid rang bzhi lhan cig pa skyes pa'i ma rig pa ni dus ma/de pa'i sku ste shesapa'i cha kun ba7sakyi ma rig pa yul gyi /de gsum dang rkyen bzhi rgyu'i rkyen ma rig pa dngosabadag /de rkyen shes pa ragasapa'i cha ste rtog pa dmigs rkyen yul du mar shar ba la bdag por /deng ste de dus/desapa de ma thag pa'i rkyen /debyam dang :shes pa sbags pa'i de rang gas dang gzhi shesapa'i khyad par las /del pa 'o:/del nas sems can la ji ltar gnas na khams gsum 05

rgyud kyi khong don bsdu pa sgon mosnang byed/ga su brgyus legasa'adra:khong don man ngag rnam pa gsum:'khrul pa rang dag rang gisorang grol bar bam rkyen grol mu:gal mdo rsāgogo sdud byed grol byed tig:gsosagand gsum thob yul nyamasalen phreng :'khrul pa dumarogs she pa grol tshul dbang phartulargya gnyis yin te:'bad med lhas bgi tsāgrog man ngag rang gisarang grol dang :'bad bcabasagand dang nyamasalen gyi dusasu lu 'dug stangasakyi gnad yularkyen med kyi gnad rig pa ma rtsal ba'i sad da 'brel ba 'o:gal mdo'i man ngag bcu gcig ste:sngon byung thog ma rtog te sangs rgyas ma byung ma rtogaste sems can ma byung ba'i gnasalugasaka dag gzhi ngo bo 'khrul pa mi mnga' ba'i ye shesa'abyed pa med par ga nas dag pa'i rig pa la bzhugs so yang bzhin cha yisam gosapa'i snang ba kha dog lasa'adasapa'i gsal ba rang du bzhugs so thugalorje ni ye shes phra ba'i ye shesasu 'dod ste de med na bems po dang khyad med rags par na gzugs sku gnyis dang khyad med pasaphra bar yod gsum gyi bdag nyid do de yang rang gi 'dug tshul gyi cha la ngo bo ga dag gi ye shesade 'khrul ma myong bsarang bzhin lhun grub kyi ye shes sogasal byed bag la nyal te cha tshang bar yod thugs rje kun khyab gyi ye shes rang ba na shugasal gsal ba'o de las ma nges lhun sdo/ba galha/ sna tshogs ma ngesapa'i gzhi zhes bya ste lhunagrub rin po che'i lus la bag chagasakyi sa bon langs te rṣa mongs pa lnga'i sa bon bag rya byu༄ :ma rig rgyu bdag go gog pa'i ma rig pa ni rang gi gzhi'i cha lasabyung de nyid rang bgo lhan cig pa skyes pa'i ma rig pa ni dus mnyam pa'i sku ste shesapa'i cha kun bawasakyi ma rig pa yul gyi cha'o gsum dang rkyen bzhi rgyu'i rkyen ma rig pa dngosabadag po'i rkyen shes pa ragasapa'i cha ste rtog pa dmigs rkyen yul du mar shar ba la bdag por gzung ste de dusam sapa de ma thag pa'i rkyen zhesabya'o dang :shes pa sbags pa'i de rang gawa dang gzhi shesapa'i khyad par las 'khrul pa 'o:'khrul nas sems can la ji ltar gnas na khams gsum 05

rgyud kyi kho— rdon bsdusapa sgron ma snang byed/len dang :rig/ pa thod rgal /dem⑪ de ltar snapab lago/depacug cir mthongasnari ba cer /deshe4pa rang yan du ba —masapasaye she4sbom du shesate 'bad cipa lus kyi gnad gzir ba'i dgos pa de nyid la ched pa'o gnyis yin no:rtsol ba can de rnam pa gsum: /deg stangs gsum la she— pabyang na skyes bu'i rgyangs thabasate rtag tu rgod na drang sropa gi 'dug stangs bying rgod ga— yang med tsa na glang po /de 'dug ngasabya'o gzhi bca' ste: mi /del gsum gyis lu ma 'gul bas mig mi 'a/de de ma 'a ༄la ba4rag pa mi 'gul bshe de nas shesapa rapa zin lo ga/de la phab: sdod pa gsum gyis dbyi— 4sdod pa4rig pa sdod de stod pas 'gro 'ong /de de las kya rlu— zad ye shes kya rlung zan ri 'i rtagasarig pa spyod pa4gzhi ma 'degs pa sa /de nyid rkyen ba'i pa4grolaba'istag4sa/de rnams bzung : grol ba gsum dbyingasaḥ— tha/de/dede/derdo la sogs /deng /de snang ba 'gag rig pa rlupa lasagrol je ma /der bar sdod lus rkyen lasagrolate gnang /deng mi dgos par ji ltar byasakyang snang barha pa'o gyis yid ches bya: smin pa gsum gyisadabyingasarṣa pas/derga lnga ma 'dresapar /der thag le smin pasanang du sku re re ras pa smin pasagar ga/de du sdod pa ni phyir mi ldag pa 'o brtan par bya:thob pa rngakasum gyis mthar phyin dbyisgo/desakhang du tho0yong rigapa/de /dedu thob pa dang /derkyen sna tshogasadabyangasarig tā thob pa sna de lasayar /degasakyang shul rmed pa /debya'o pa/de: le/ debargyad kyis ga/de don rdzogs: i ti: rgya rgya rgya: :rig pa rang grol zhesabya ba'i:rgyud de'i tshig don bdun gyisagasal bar bya:ngo bo rang ga/de rang shar lamāsapa'i ma dzeegrol bar byed:nges/de ma rig sogs/del pa'i rtog pa du masadam du bcings pa: gawa la ma lko pa rang gis grol bas rang grol zhes: dbye na rnam pa gsum yin te: snang ba rang sar grol phyir rig:ga/de la lhos pa med pasamatha' rnams 'gags phyir rang : spyi snapa ba rang ryās tsho ma/de nyid spe 7 gcod pas grol: dper na sbrul mdud rang grol bzhin:—07—

rgyud kyi kho don bsdusapa sgron ma snang byed/len dang :rig pa thod rgal lasamaca de ltar sna ba lagomasapalog cir mthongasna ba cer gralashelopa rang yan du ba masopa ye sheposbom du shesate 'bad cing lus kyi gnad gzir ba'i dgos pa de nyid la chod pa'o gnyis yin no:rtsol ba can de rnam pa gsum:'dug stangs gsum la she pabying na skyes bu'i rgyangs thabasate rtag tu rgod na drang srong rgo 'dug stangs bying rgod gas yang med tsa na glang po che'i 'dug nga bya'o gzhi bca' ste: mi 'do/la gadza/ma gyis lusam 'gul bas mig mi 'gul de ma 'gul ba rag pa mi 'gu' ba de nas sheyopa rang zin yo gtan la phab: sdod pa gsum gyis dbying sosdod pasorig pa sdod de snga/da pas 'gro 'ong chad de las kya rlu zad ye shes kya rlung zen 'i rtagasarig pa stod palogazhi ma 'degs pa sa chas nyid rkyen ba'i pa grolaba'itogasasomed rnams bzung : grol ba gsum dbyingasalub b.lasagraladeyosardo la sogs 'byung ba'i snang ba 'gag rig pa rlung lasagrol rte me masar bar sdod lus rkyen lasagrolate gnad gzung mi dgos par ji ltar byasakyang snang barha pa'o gyis yid ches bya:smin pa gsum gyisadabyingayo pasakhangag lnga ma 'dresapar 'char thig le smin pasanang du sku re re rab pa smin pasagar gtad du sdod ba ni phyar mi ldog pa 'o brtan par bya:thob pa sum gyis mthar phyin dbyi4gsalalokhang du thobabang rigapagato samadu thob pa dang masaparkyen sna tshogasadabyingasarig tu thob pa ni de la yar gshegasakyang shul med pa zhesabya'o pa71: le(5 brgyad kyis gzhung don rdzogs i ti: rgya rgya rgya: :rig pa rang grol zhesabya ba'i:rgyud de'i tshig don bdun gyilogasal bar bya:ngo bo rang gzhan rang shar largasopa'i ma bgrol bar byed:ngesatshig ma rig sogasa'abyul pa'i rtog pa du masodam du bcings pa ga la ma lko pa rang gis grol bas rang grol zhes: dbye na rnam pa gsum yin te: snang ba rang sar grol phyir rig:g.yin la ltos pa med pa mtha' rnams 'gags phyir rang :spyi snang ba rang yo kya mtshan nyid spe po gcod pas grol dper na sbrul mdud rang grol bzhin:—07—

me lo shul ba ga la / klo go ba khum kya gsu khrum/()sems go mkha' la phyungasapas chu la nya ltar bying ba med:cir snang chosaskur grol bsari la thog me du zang thal lo:le'u gsum gyis gzhu rga rdzogs:i ti:rgya rgya rgya rin go spungasapa zhesabya ba'i ma 4du྾ngo bo sha' yon wa skyed par byed:ngesatshig rnams pa gnyisayin te:byasogayon ma rdzogasapasarin po che:bo lami zad ye shes rab rdzogasaspungs :dbye ba rnam pa gsum yin te gzhi nasasgo ramakha྾ du cuba'akhrul pa dag pas rin po che:zag med ye shes go yo byibagatsosago don spungs pa:'gyur med ltabom 'ag rgyun du gnas pas rgyud du bstan:dper na phyug lo bang mdzod sgo byes bzhin no soca 'do lu bdapa'adra:dgos pa yon tanasgonudabyangashabagabalta sna ba camayogasaspyorga rnamasa'adzin khong don man ngag rnam garṣate:yon ༅ du ma rdzogasapa'i rig gnad waṃ gnya47bdang :rgya che 'khosna la go byes /bye//bye 2) 2) 0ri /khye/la gsasnabazad pa da pa dngasag spungs: ga pa nyad cha 'phrul sna chagam go 4b.rin po che:'khrul pa nyid kyang de yi rtsal du snang :sangasargyasanyid kyi mdzad pa du ma yang :rig pa'i rtsal te de nyid rang gi ngang :rig pa'i gnas de snying yin pas:chosakyi sku yang snying khar ྾rtarṣatsa gnas:rig pa'i lam ni rtsa yin pas:thig le wa cig rtsardodzeg gagralangamakhasanasa'agyu:rig pa'i sgo ni skyon go mig yin pas lta ba rigawa shisagaloye yizer khyab che mig nasa'achar:rig pa'i yul ni nayomakha' pome yin pas:gzung dka' khyab gdal rarka nam mkhar zin rig pa'i ltosa' ga྾ni spyor ba ste:nyag gcig rsāpas cha phra kun tu khyab:rig pa'i dgra mayeba'i ni myang

rgyu kyi kho don bsdus sgon ma sna bye/'das tesnyegand gzir rig ngo stong gsal mthong snyerig pa'i gol sasku gsum ste:lā.āolazhe 'dod kya mthar ni lhung bar lngar:rig pa'i sgrib pa blosabyasakyisalta sgom go 4labaka 'dzanasparnam ste:byas pa rnams ni 'jig pa'i rgyu:rig pa'i sna du moshesha /del pa 'od yin te:ga/de /deng gakhoyonagyi spyob /del pa'i rtsa ba can:dbyings kyi gnas ni tsitta 'a sna lnga' drukhu 'ag palta ste:nam mkha'i khamasanibayo 0/de7 she snying na gnas:dbyingasakyi lam /de/deni rma yin pas:shes pa'i dngasam /de 'od du gsal:dbyingasakyi sgo ni mdzod sbu nas: lhomathing kha /desalngas khyab ོ shesapa'i grogs:dbyingasakyi yul ni mig yin pas:mthong byed migazur laston rgyun du gnas:dbyingasakyi zad saltorṣa nam mkha' ste:risamed yul la 'osnuthagalerna khyab par gdal:dbyingasakyi 'bras bu lus yin pasa' /deltomepaskumathong byed ཿla snang phya bame 'di la gcod:dbyingasakyi gol sa 'od yin pas4 snapadumosheyo:gser sgogasathag sgrog /de bar makro:dbyingasaska grogs ni /deng lnga ma gyebs:thu lnga zad pas /del pa'i /de yul regags:de phyir yon kha thamasacad ni:dbyingasa.adang rigapar 4yolaspungs pas sgrungs:le'u lnga yis galnga sha rdzogs:a ti:rgya rgya rgya:nag mo khros ma spyo bya bsaḥngo bo 'aro bsru āon༄ 'gal byed oṃ la 'bebs:nges tshig rnam pa gnyis yin te:mi /der ye shes nag mo la:/de ོོ /de /de /de/de /de ོdug rtsad gcad khras ma na:da ba rnam pa lnga yan :ga mug khrasapa' /de shagob4sa e kar /deg:nga /de khrosapa' /desa.agobayos tsa tir

rgyu kyi kho don bsdus sgon ma sna bye/rteste :sgo rten/sa sa ma 'tsho (ri shāste/sa 'das :gnad gar ga nga stang gsal mthang :rag pa gal sasku gsum ste:walalazhe 'dod kya mthar ni lhung bar 'gyur:rig pa'i sgrib pa blosabya kyi lta sgom go palab༅ 'dzanaparnam ste byas pa rnams ni 'jig pa'i rgyu:rig pa'i sna du yoshesha 'khrul pa 'od yin te gzhan 'byung g.yoyonagyi spyob 'khrul pa'i rtsa ba can:dbyings kyi gnas ni tsitta ra sna lnga' dukhu 'ag palta ste:nam mkha'i khamasanibayo mam phe she snying na gnas:dbyingasakyi lam gsangagrol ni po yin pas shes pa'i dngasam sto.a 'od du gsal:dbyingasakyi sgo ni mdzod spu nas: pomathing kha spyotsosalngas khyab go shesapa'i grogs dbyingasakyi yul ni mig yin pas mthong byed migazur laston rgyun du gnas:dbyingasakyi zad sagarma nam mkha' ste:risamed yul la 'oskuthagalerna khyab par gdal:dbyingasakyi 'bras bu lus yin pasa' sa rtelto pa mthong byed 'khrul snang phya bame 'di la gcod dbyingasakyi gol sa 'od yin pasab snangadumashesha:gser sgogasathag sgrog 'ching bar mawa dbyingasaska grogs ni 'byung lnga rma tho༄gosabs:lu lnga zad pas 'khrul pa'i zhen yul regags:de phyir yon ma thamasacad ni:dbyingasayodang rigapar yoyo spungs pas spungs:le'u lnga yis gzhung rga rdzogs a ti:rgya rgya rgya:nag mo khros ma zhes bya bas:ngo bo 'asha bsru canadu 'gal byed lo la 'bebs nges tshig rnam pa gnyis yin te mi 'gyur ye shes nag mo la dug gi rtsad gcod khros ma yin:dbye ba rnam pa lnga yin te:gti mug khrosapa' sa gab4sa e gar gcig:nga rgyal khrosapa' sa samagab྾sa tsa tir

me po'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen rab 'byamasakya gsung 'a ma/ (kabyung : 'dod chags khros pa'i kha mo4brag ladathu pas bdag gachan dpal: phrag dog khrosapa'i ྾mo4bugasago4pasami 'gyur nag: zhe sdang khrosapa 'i samosaru la dahphu pa sa'abyung khungs mo: dper na spyod rṣa spu gri lta bu 'o: dgos pa 4sa྾kyi bstan pa dam pa bsrung : khong don man ngag rnam pa gsum: sbes pa'i dus 'ad man ngag dang zla bsaspyod: bsam pa gnag pa'i man ngag ba4 lem khrubadang :mo ste sgongs dugathun sa ⑫ drug man ngag go: dus tshod dbyid zla 7sar bzhi brgyad dang drug: bcu bzhi bcu dgu go rim bzhan tso dang sbyor kabya : da3 da zla 'apring po bsang mar ngo nyi spyoganyis dang lngaḥ bdun dang gnam stong go rim bzhin: da3 da skasogasatha chung bzhi dang brgyad dang dgu: bcu gcig bcas te go rim bzhan:bsam pa rdzas thod pa dang ga sngags badzra to to nyal lugs so kha byang du lta ba: thun drug re re ya phral ༄rga༄ dril ba dang ཿ de'inangaja snying thun gtso ste bsad sngags ma matsatsha bcu: ma marṣa skyo 0 khrom bcu btang ste bhyo yis 'khrub: le 'u brgyad dang bcu gcig gis: gzhus gi tshad rnamasardzogs pa 'o:de ltar spros ladatso b.late rgyud kyi don: rnam pa bdun du rab bye nas: bstan pa 'dzin skyong bsrung ba yi:don du de nyid bstan pa 'o: mchog tu nyams len gnad gsum du: bsdus te dril nas gang zag ni: ga ga gi cha rkyen dag du bstan: rgyud rnams kun gyi snying dang 'dra snyephyungs pas: snying khrag sa ri ga dbyings dang rig pa byung : gnad gsum ldan pa'i mchusagazhabs nas: sngar ma phyong ba'i lnga/myoparo rted ste: ro myong snying la mda' phog bzhin: phyi phyir ldog pa ma yin no: ga/de bla na yī pa 'di don man ngag mi shes par: phyi nang gsang bar gding 'cha' ba: dbul —1/4—

me po'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen rab 'byamasakya gsung 'bum/ (3)byung : 'dod chags khros pa'i ma mosokhyag yodab pas bdag gzhan dpal: phrag dog khrosapa'i mamoyobugasag4pasami 'gyur nag: zhe sdang khrosapa 'i mamasorulol das pa sa'abyung khungs mo dper na yod yo spu gri lta bu 'o: dgos pa 4 makyi bstan pa dam pa bsrung : khong don man ngag rnam pa gsum: khros pa'i dus chod man ngag dang zlo ba chud: bsam pa gnag pa'i man ngag bayo le4 bdang :mo ste sgongam dugathun sa ma drug man ngag go: dus tshod dbyid zla stosar bzhi brgyad dang drug: bcu bzhi bcu dgu go rim bzhin tso dang sbyor babya : dbyi da zla 'bring po bawo mar ngo nyi guganyis dang lnga: bdun dang gnam stong go rim bzhin: dbyi da blosog tha chung bzhi dang brgyad dang dgu: bcu gcig bcas te go rim bzhin:bsam pa rdzas thod pa dang ga sngags badzra to rṣa nyal lugs so kha byang du lta ba: thun drug re re ya phral sagatu dril ba dang : de'inangajasasnying thun gtso ste bsad sngags ma matsatsha bcu: ma marṣa spyo ༅thakhrom bcu btab ste bhyo yis 'grub le 'u brgyad dang bcu gcig gis: gzhung gi tshad rnamasardzogs pa 'o:de ltar spros ladashka babate rgyud kyi don: rnam pa bdun du rab phye nas: bstan pa 'dzin skyong bsrung ba yi:don du de nyid bstan pa 'o: mchog tu nyams len gnad gsum du bsdus te dril nas gang zag ni: gcig gi cha rkyen dag du bstan: rgyud rnams kun gyi snying dang 'dra —phyungs pas: snying khrag ga ga dbyings dang rig pa byung : gnad gsum ldan pa'i mchusagazhibs nas sngar ma myong ba'i lnga myo ro rted ste: ro myong snying la mda' phog bzhin: phyi phyir ldog pa ma yin no: gagayo bla na go pa 'di don man ngag mi shes par: phyi nang gsang bar gding 'cha' ba dbul —1/4—

rgyung kyi khoju don bsdusapa sgron ma snari byed/ po'i nang na med pa ngo da yod lngar byasapa mdzod bu sgo bcad 'dra: de phyir 'di ni snying la phur: rgyud kun snying ni 'dir phyungs pas: rgyud tshig rnams kyis ci zhig bya:'di nyid nyams su len par gyisaḥ a ti: rgyud thams cad kyi khong snying phyungs pa dkar po dung gis jes pa'i dung ris ma zhes kyang bya: sgon ma snang byed ces bya ba dur khrod bha sing du: ye shesam do4lung /dete mkhas pa bi ma la/derdo rje'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi don du mdzad pa'o: long ba'i sna khrid dang 'dra ba rdzogs so: gter nas gter du btsas pa 'di sngags kyi srung mas srungasashiga'adi ni 'dzam bu gling ga/de na med par yid ches so: las can cig dang phrad par /deg: /de ti: rgya rgya rgya: rgya rgya rgya: rgya rgya rgyaḥ /de rbha: : /15—

rgyud kyi khong don bsdusapa sgron ma sna byed/ po'i nang na med pa ngo da yod lhar bya pa mdzod bu sgo bcad 'dra: de phyir 'di ni snying la phur: rgyud kun snying ni 'dir phyungs pas: rgyud tshig rnams kyis ci zhig bya:2da tsa ri /bye// zhes mi 2 ri /byeX/ma sto sgyu ri'ad nyad nyams su na par gyas: a ta: rgyud thams cad khang snyang phyungs pa dkar po dung gis bris pa'i dung ris ma zhes kyang bya: sgron ma snang byed ces bya ba dur khrod bha sing du: ye shesar dosalung shkate mkhas pa bi ma lasardo rje'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi don du mdzad pa'o: long ba'i sna khrid dang 'dra ba rdzogs so gter nas gter du btsas pa 'di sngags kyi srung mas srungasashiga'adi ni 'dzam bu gling gawa na med par yid ches so: las can cig dang phrad par shog: a ti: rgya rgya rgya: rgya rgya rgya: rgya rgya rgya: shu bhe: : /15

khreng yig can)/༄7/ /dung yig can gyi rgyab yig ste gnad kyi yi ge bzhugs:rgyud kyi gnad yig gsang ba zer/rgya gar skad du: a khya ra kha tra nan gu hya nā ma: bod skad du: rgyud kyi gnad tshig gsang ba zhes bya ba: bcom ldan gab pa rnams mngon du ston pa la phyag 'tshal lo: gang dag rgyud kyi gsang ba'i tshig rnamasakyi: de yi don la the tshom ga da pa'i phyir: gsang ba dung gi yi ge can la yang : tig la 'bebs pa'i snying kho sgron ma 'di: mun pa rnamasal snang ba'i 'od bzhi du: rtsa kho snying gi dkyil du phab nas ni: gsang ba'i yang gsang thugs kyi bcud rnams ni: bla ma'i man ngag rim nasarim brgyud pa'i: thugs kyi bcud rnamasabadag gis 'dir bkod la: snying pa'i yang snying gsal bar bya ba'i phyir: bcud rnams bsdus nas nyams len phyogs gcig lco bsdebs te skal ldan gcig gi cha rkyen du: bcu bdun rgyud kyi gsang don gcig tu bstan: de yi phyir na rgyud lung tshig rnams la: 'grub dang mi 'grub man ngag bas du ni: gsang ba'i rgyab yig med na 'grub mi srid: de yi phyir na yi ge 'di nyid gces: 'di med sa /bye ces :go /de 1pe /re spyo༄ sa :sku sa /steshākyad la dgas pa yang da: sa sa pa snyang pa mthang : mchu 'gyur sgra yis sna tshogs smra byed kyang : don gyi phyogs su rdul rtsam nye ba med:des na gsang ba'i sgon ma 'di med na: mun khung nang gi phyag rgya bsgyur ba 'dra: //6—

khreng yig can)/༄/ /dung yig can gyi rgyab yig ste gnad kyi yi ge bzhugs:rgyud kyi gnad yig gsang ba zer/rgya gar skad du: a khya ra ma tra nan gu rgya nā ma: bod skad du rgyud kyi gnad tshig gsang ba zhes bya ba bcom ldan gab pa rnams mngon du ston pa la phyag yol lo: gang dag rgyud kyi gsang ba'i tshig rnamasakyi de yi don la the mo ༅da pa'i phyir gsang ba dung gi yi ge can la yang : go la 'bebs pa'i snying khi sgron ma 'di: mun pa rnamasal snang ba'i 'od bzhi du rtsa go snying gi dkyil du phab nas ni: gsang ba'i yang gsang thugs kyi bcud rnams ni: bla ma'i man ngag rim nasarim brgyud pa'i: thugs kyi rsād rnamasabadag /// (bye/ bsnga tsa ga mag 'a tsa nga /de/ tsa mis 'a ra bkad la: snyang pa' yang snyang gsal bar bya ba phyar: bcud rnams bsdus nas nyams len phyogs gcig zhu bsdebs te skal ldan gcig gi cha rkyen du rsā bdun rgyud kyi gsang don gcig tu bstan: de yi phyir na rgyud lung tshig rnams la: 'grub dang mi 'grub man ngag bcud du ni: gsang ba'i rgyab yig med na 'grub mi srid: de yi phyir na yi ge 'di nyid spyos 'di med rgyud la dgos pa ci yang med: go gis nges pa'i snying po mi mthong ste: mchu 'gyur sgra yis sna tshogs smra byed kyang : don gyi phyogs su rdul rtsam nye ba med:des na gsang ba'i sgron ma 'di med na: mun khung nang gi phyag rgya bsgyur ba 'dra:—//6

dung yigacan gyi rgyab yig ste gnad kyi yi ge'adi ni gsang ba dung gi yi ge can: tig la 'bebs pa'i mi 'gyur thig yin no: 'dir tshig rgyud rnams kyi rgyab yig gi man ngag ni: mdo rgyud kyi don gsal ba zhes bya ste gsang ba dung gi yi ge can yin no: man ngag de yi rgyab tu 'di med na rnal 'thur pa rnams kyi don mi 'grub ste: tshi chad pa don sted do: de'i phyir na 'di rab tu gsang bar bya'o: tshig gi rgyud rnams la re re la bdun bdun gyis bstan pa ni: ngo bo dang : ngebasatshig dang : dbye ba dang : dag bsapa'i don dang : mtshon pa'i dpe dang : khong bas kyi man ngag dang : le'u'i grangs du yod pa dang bdun gyis rgyud de dag gi rim pa bstan pa yin te: de yang ngo bos ni rang gi rig pa'i mtshon tshul ston pa yin gyi: gzhan ston pa ma yin no:nges tshig gis ni rgyud de mi 'gyur bar bya ba'i tshig yin gyi nyams su len pa'i thabs su ni ma yin no: dbye bas ni tshig gi rim pa bshad pa yin gyi rig pa gtan la 'bebs pa ni ma yin no: dgos pa'i don ni sems can gyi dbang po las bye ba yin gyi gnas lugs la ni ma yin no: mtshon pa'i dpe ni rgyud de nyid rang che bstan pa yin gyi rig pa la ni ma yin no: khong don gyi man ngag gis ni rnal 'thur pa rnams kyi nyams su blang ba yin gyi: tshogs su bshad pa ni ma yin no: le'u'i grangs du yod pas ni gang zag rnams kyi rgyud la bsnan phri mi 'dod pa'i don du bstan pa yin gyi gzhan gyi dgos pa ni ci yang med do: de'i phyir na bdun po de dag gis gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i thabs la ni bdun char dgos pa ma yin te: khong bas kyi man ngag rnams kyi 'di nyid du sangs rgyas par byed pa'i thabs bstan pa yin no: 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i —//7—

dung yimacan gyi rgyab yig ste gnad kyi yi ge'adi ni gsang ba dung gi yi ge can tig la 'bebs pa'i mi 'gyur thig yin no: 'dir tshig rgyud rnams kyi rgyab yig gi man ngag ni: mdo rgyud kyi don gsal ba zhes bya ste gsang ba dung gi yi ge can yin no: man ngag de yi rgyab tu 'di med na rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi don mi 'grub ste: tshi chad pa don med do: de'i phyir na 'di rab tu gsang bar bya'o: tshig gi rgyud rnams la re re la bdun bdun gyibasnabastan pa ni: ngo bo dang : ngebasatshig dang : dbye ba dang : dbo bsapa'i don dang : mtshon pa'i dpe dang : khong bcud kyi man ngag dang : le'u'i grangs du yod pa dang bdun gyis rgyud de dag gi rim pa bstan pa yin te: de yang ngo bos ni rang gi rig pa'i mtshon tshul ston pa yin gyi: gzhan ston pa ma yin no:nges tshig gis ni rgyud de mi 'gyur bar bya ba'i tshig yin gyi nyams su len pa'i thabs su ni ma yin no: dbye bas ni tshig gi rim pa bshad pa yin gyi rig pa gtan la 'bebs pa ni ma yin no: dgos pa'i don ni sems can gyi dbang po las bye ba yin gyi gnas lugs la ni ma yin no: mtshon pa'i dpe ni rgyud de nyid rang che bstan pa yin gyi rig pa la ni ma yin no: khong don gyi man ngag gis ni rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi nyams su blang ba yin gyi: tshogs su bshad pa ni ma yin no: le'u'i grangs du yod pas ni gang zag rnams kyi rgyud la bsnan phri mi 'dod pa'i don du bstan pa yin gyi gzhan gyi dgos pa ni ci yang med do: de'i phyir na bdun po de dag gis gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i thabs la ni bdun char dgos pa ma yin te: khong bcud kyi man ngag rnams kyi 'di nyid du sangs rgyas par byed pa'i thabs bstan pa yin no: 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i —//7

mesapo' shul bsalas/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/ /shigand kyi yi ge rnams bsdus nas gcig tu bstan pa ni: sngon du rdzogs par rang byung gi rgyud kyi man ngag gi rten khyad par can bsgrub pa ste: phyi nang gis dbang gis spros pa dang bcas pa'i blo can gyi don yin te 'di yis dus na lus sku gsum du gtan la phab nas lus kyi gnad tu rtsa gtilas pa yin no: gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni gang zag chags pa can gyi don yin te: de'i man ngag tu chags can kyi pra khrid kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i man ngag byas nas gnas pa rtsa'i zems kyis gtilas: de ma gtims na rlung mi zin: mi 'gyur ba yi ge thebs kyis rlung gtilas: de ma gtims na las rlung log nas lus kyi 'byung ba 'khrugs: bkod pa byang chub sems kyi thems kyis lus gtisas: de ma gtilas na kun rdzob kyi zig le la dbang mi thob bo: de dag yang gzhan don thabs yin gyi: sangs rgyas pa la ni dgos pa ma yin noḥ rang rig yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang gi man ngag gis spros bcas kyi don khyad par can sgrub par byed pa'o: rgyud kyi nang nas bstan pa'i dbang de kun ni drang zhing bkri ba'i don yin no: rdzogs pa rang byung gi rgyab yig gsang ba snying po dung yig can gyi snying zig: rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya:sprul sku sgrub par byed pa sgra thal 'gyur gyi rgyud kyi rgyab yig gsang ba ni:'di ni 'jig rten don mngon shes la sogs pa'i rtags phyungs te gzhan 'jug par bya ba'i yan lag du bstan pa yin te: 'di la brten nasa'adod pa'i yon tan lnga la lam du byed pa'i rnal 'thur pa nyid kyi nyams len bstan pa yin gyi:nyams su blang ba dngos gzhi ma yin no: de yang nyams su len pa'i dngos gzhi —/18

mesapo'i shul ba galas/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/ (3)gnad kyi yi ge rnams bsdus nas gcig tu bstan pa ni: sngon du rdzogs par rang byung gi rgyud kyi man ngag gi rten khyad par can bsgrub pa ste: phyi nang gis dbang gis spros pa dang bcas pa'i blo can gyi don yin te 'di yis dus na lus sku gsum du gtan la phab nas lus kyi gnad tu rtsa gtims pa yin no: gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni gang zag chags pa can gyi don yin te: de'i man ngag tu chags can gyi pra khrid kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i man ngag byas nas gnas pa rtsa'i thems kyis gtims: de ma gtims na rlung mi zin: mi 'gyur ba yi ge thebs kyis rlung gtims: de ma gtims na las rlung log nas lus kyi 'byung ba 'a spyogs bkod pa byang chub sems kyi thems kyis lus gtims: de ma gtims na kun rdzob kyi thig le la dbang mi thob bo: de dag yang gzhan don thabs yin gyi: sangs rgyas pa la ni dgos pa ma yin no: rang rig yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang gi man ngag gis spros bcas kyi don khyad par can sgrub par byed pa'o: rgyud kyi nang nas bstan pa'i dbang de kun ni drang zhing bkri ba'i don yin no: rdzogs pa rang byung gi rgyab yig gsang ba snying po dung yig can gyi snying thig rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya:sprul sku sgrub par byed pa sgra thal 'gyur gyi rgyud kyi rgyab yig gsang ba ni:'di ni 'jig rten don mngon shes la sogs pa'i rtags phyungs te g.yin 'jug par bya ba'i yan lag du bstan pa yin te: 'di la brten nasa'adod pa'i yon tan lnga la lam du byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa nyid kyi nyams len bstan pa yin gyi:nyams su blang ba dngos gzhi ma yin no: de yang nyams su len pa'i dngos gzhi —/18—

dung yisacan gyi rgyab yig ste gnad kyi ya gede nyid kyi grogs su 'gro ba'i man ngag gzhan ni dpe'o: de rang gi 'grub pa yin no: 'byung ba lnga'i sgra don nyams su len pa'i dus na gnad bsdus pa'i ni 'di ltar yin te: 'di kun gyi sngon du ni tsas ngag gi gnad gtimasapa gal cha': lus ngag gi gnad gtams pa'i rjes la gang mos pa'i spyod lam rtsom pa ni sems rnal du 'bebs pa'i dgos pa yod pas gal che: de la thog mar me'i dbyibs la brtag pa ni: mtshan ma' dus su ri yi rtse la phyin la brtag pa yin gyis gam nas ni mtheng ba ma yin/ no: lhag ma ni dpe rang na zhi : 'di ni gnad yin no: kha dog la brtag pa'i dus na rgyang grags byed kyis ni lkog gi phyogs nas blta bar bya'o: de na sgra dngos gzhi la nyams su len pa'i dus na rṣang gang nas byung ba'i me'i rgyab tu 'dug pa yin te 'dom do tsam zer yang skyes byes rdo ba 'phaskres pas sleb pa'i sa yin no: de'i tshe rna bar shes pa bcug ste ma yengs pa gco che: de'i dus na zhag gsum lon nas bde sangs pa cig 'ong :bzhi la dga' yal ba cig 'ong : bdun na mi rnams kyi shes pa la ci yod pa skad ston pas shes pa'o: ba la dmyal ba'i skad shes: bcu gcig la yi dwags rnams kyi skad shes: bcu gnyis la byos song rnams kyi skad shes/bcu gsum la la ma yin gyi skad shes: ba bzhi lha rnams kyi skad shes te mngon par shes pa rnams dus gcig tu 'char ro: de ni dbang po yang rab rnams kyi'o: 'bring gis de ltar lan bdun gyis 'khrub pa yin te 'di ni lo re la lan grangs de snyed du bya'o: tha mas ni ba lnga byas pas 'khrub pa la the tshom med do: a ti: :—/19—

dung yigacan gyi rgyab yig ste gnad kyi ya gede nyid kyi grogs su 'gro ba'i man ngag gzhan ni dpe'o: de rang gi 'grub pa yin no: 'byung ba lnga'i sgra don nyams su len pa'i dus na gnad bsdus pa'i ni 'di ltar yin te: 'di kun gyi sngon du ni thus ngag gi gnad gtimasapa gal che'o: lus ngag gi gnad gtims pa'i rjes la gang mos pa'i spyod lam rtsom pa ni sems rnal du 'bebs pa'i dgos pa yod pas gal che: de la thog mar me'i dbyibs la brtag pa ni: mtshan mo'i dus su ri yi rtse la phyin la brtag pa yin gyis gam nas ni mtheng ba ma yin no: lhag ma ni dpe rang na zhib: 'di ni gnad yin no: kha dog la brtag pa'i dus na rgyang grags phyed kyis ni lkog gi phyogs nas blta bar bya'o: de na sgra dngos gzhi la nyams su len pa'i dus na rāng gang nas byung ba'i me'i rgyab tu 'dug pa yin te 'dom do tsam zer yang skyes jes rdo ba 'phanges pas sleb pa'i sa yin no: de'i tshe rna bar shes pa bcug ste ma yengs pa gtso che: de'i dus na zhag gsum lon nas bde sangs pa cig 'ong :bzhi la dga' yal ba cig 'ong : bdun na mi rnams kyi shes pa la ci yod pa skad ston pas shes pa'o: bcu la dmyal ba'i skad shes: bcu gcig la yi dwags rnams kyi skad shes: bcu gnyis la byos song rnams kyi skad shes/bcu gsum la la ma yin gyi skad shes: bcu bzhi lha rnams kyi skad shes te mngon par shes pa rnams dus gcig tu 'char ro: de ni dbang po yang rab rnams kyi'o: 'bring gis de ltar lan bdun gyis 'grub pa yin te 'di ni lo re la lan grangs de snyed du bya'o: tha mas ni bco lnga byas pas 'grub pa la the tshom med do: a ti: :—/19—

me bo'i shul bas las/ klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'tsho/ ()chu'i sgra la spyod na: dus ni ston char chad du nye ba'i dus ni gnad yin no:de yang mtshan mo shin tu thag ring ba nas shes pa rna bar gtad de ma yengs pa rab tu gaXs so: de'i tshe bying na chu bo yi rtsar 'dug ste shes pa gtad: rgod na mgo bstums te dar gcig 'dug go: nyin mo chu'i dkyil du shes pa gtad pa ni man ngag go: de ltar lus kyi gnad dang bstun nas byas na zla ba gcig na mkha' 'gro ma yis chos smra ba'i skad sna tshogs pa 'ong : gnyis na rang la chos sna tshogs pa'i nyams skye: gsum na chos las grol ba'i nyams ni dbang po rab la 'ong : 'bring la dgu: tha ma bca brgyad na de ltar mi 'ong mi srid do: 'di ni shes rab sna tshogs pa sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i man ngag yin no: i ti: rlung gi sgra la spyod pa ni: sngon du 'gro ba spyir 'dra: lhag ma dpe na zhib: rlung phyogasakyi zhur khung la rna ba gtad de shes pa rna bar gzhug pa man ngag: de yang res mgo bstums shing nyal ba ni gnad: 'di'i dus su kha zas ni sha chen po dang : mar bzang po dang : bu ram rnying pa brten no: 'di ltar nyams su blangs pas dbang po rab kyis zla ba gcig na nam mkha' la rgyu nus: 'bring gi zla ba lnga 'am ba gcig na: tha mas lo gsum na nam mkha' la rgyu nus te: 'di ni phyi'i rlung sbyong ba'i man ngag go: 35: :sa'i sgra la spyod pa ni: sgo nga kha dog tshon gyis kha bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i lag pa'i 'du byed bsgom pa ste: 'di la rtag tu sbyangs na dbang po rab zla ba drug nas 'byung ba'i dgrasami tshugs: 'bring bca brgyad na: tha ma na lo drug na 'byung ba rnams kyi dgras mi tshugs pa yin no: āoṃ: :—120

me po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/ (3)chu'i sgra la spyod na dus ni ston char chad du nye ba'i dus ni gnad yin no:de yang mtshan mo shin tu thag ring ba nas shes pa rna bar gtad de ma yengs pa rab tu gces so: de'i tshe bying na chu bo yi rtsar 'dug ste shes pa gtad: rgod na mgo bstums te dar gcig 'dug go: nyin mo chu'i dkyil du shes pa gtad pa ni man ngag go: de ltar lus kyi gnad dang bstun nas byas na zla ba gcig na mkha' 'gro ma yis chos smra ba'i skad sna tshogs pa 'ong : gnyis na rang la chos sna tshogs pa'i nyams skye: gsum na chos las grol ba'i nyams ni dbang po rab la 'ong : 'bring la dgu: tha ma bco brgyad na de ltar mi 'ong mi srid do: 'di ni shes rab sna tshogs pa sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i man ngag yin no: i ti: rlung gi sgra la spyod pa ni: sngon du 'gro ba spyir 'dra: lhag ma dpe na zhib: rlung phyogasakyi zhur khung la rna ba gtad de shes pa rna bar gzhug pa man ngag: de yang res mgo bstums shing nyal ba ni gnad: 'di'i dus su kha zas ni sha chen po dang : mar bzang po dang : bu ram rnying pa brten no: 'di ltar nyams su blangs pas dbang po rab kyis zla ba gcig na nam mkha' la rgyu nus: 'bring gi zla ba lnga 'am bcu gcig na tha mas lo gsum na nam mkha' la rgyu nus te: 'di ni phyi'i rlung sbyong ba'i man ngag go: snyi: :sa'i sgra la spyod pa ni: sgo nga kha dog tshon gyis kha bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i lag pa'i 'du byed bsgom pa ste: 'di la rtag tu sbyangs na dbang po rab zla ba drug nas 'byung ba'i dgrasami tshugs: 'bring bco brgyad na tha ma na lo drug na 'byung ba rnams kyi dgras mi tshugs pa yin no: lho: :—120—

dung yig can gyi rgyab yig ste gnad kyi yi genam mkha'i sgra la spyod pa'i rnal 'byar ni: lus brgyangs pas rlung rang so na gnas pa yin no: dbugs drag po phyir bton te mi 'gyur ba drag pa'i yi ge ha ha nyis brtsegs ngag tu gdon no: lus kyi nang du dbugs chags su mi gzhug pa ni gnad yin no: mig gis mthong tshad kyi nam mkha'i steng du 'phang ba ni rlung gi tshad 'dzin pa yin: de yang dbang po rab kyis log gsum na mig gi mthong tshad kyi nam mkha' la rgyu bar nus: 'apring gis dgu na: tha mas ba brgyad na rgyu bar nus par the tshom med do: 'di ni nges pa kho na'o: 'di ni nang gi rig pa phyi'i dbyings la bor ba'i man ngag go: lja: :de'i yon tan ni dpe na zhi bo: sgra thal 'gyur gyi rgyud kyi rgyab yig man ngag gi rgyal po dung yig can gyi snying tig gtan la 'bebs pa rdzogs so: las can cig dang phrad par shadag: sa ma yā: kha baṃ: rgya rgya rgya: :de ltar sprul pa'i sku bsgrubs nasagazhan don rdzogs par byas te: da rig pa'i gnas tshul gtan la dbab pa'i phyir bkra shis mdzes ldan gyi gnad kyi man ngag bstan pa ni: 'di ni shes par bya ba'i chos yin pa las nyams su blang du btu pa ni ma yin te: de nyid la khong don man ngag bzhir bstan pa'i ma 'khrul ba'i ye shes kyi man ngag ni nyams su blang bar bstan pa yin no: de'i sngon du yi ge ma ru nas byung ba'i 'bar 'das ru shan 'byed pa'i spyod pa byas nas de la rtags byung ba dang : rang gi rig pa nyid mngon du gtan ma la phab na:snang ba'i dngos po 'di zad par byed pa la rig pa mngon sum gyi yin gyis:stong pas ni snang ba'i dngos po 'di zad par nus pa ma yin no: de'i phyir na —12/

dung yig can gyi rgyab yig ste gnad kyi yi genam mkha'i sgra la spyod pa'i rnal 'byor ni: lus brgyangs pas rlung rang so na gnas pa yin no: dbugs drag po phyir bton te mi 'gyur ba drag po'i yi ge ha ha nyis brtsegs ngag tu gdon no: lus kyi nang du dbugs chags su mi gzhug pa ni gnad yin no: mig gis mthong tshad kyi nam mkha'i steng du 'phang ba ni rlung gi tshad 'dzin pa yin: de yang dbang po rab kyis log gsum na mig gi mthong tshad kyi nam mkha' la rgyu bar nus: 'bring gis dgu na: tha mas bco brgyad na rgyu bar nus par the tshome med do: 'di ni nges pa kho na'o: 'di ni nang gi rig pa phyi'i dbyings la bor ba'i man ngag go: sgri: :de'i yon tan ni dpe na zhib bo sgra thal 'gyur gyi rgyud kyi rgyab yig man ngag gi rgyal po dung yig can gyi snying tig gtan la 'bebs pa rdzogs so las can cig dang phrad par re ga: sa ma yu: kha the: rgya rgya rgya: :de ltar sprul pa'i sku bsgrubs nasagazhan don rdzogs par byas te da rig pa'i gnas tshul gtan la dbab pa'i phyir bkra shis mdzes ldan gyi gnad kyi man ngag bstan pa ni: 'di ni shes par bya ba'i chos yin pa las nyams su blang du btub pa ni ma yin te: de nyid la khong don man ngag bzhir bstan pa'i ma 'khrul ba'i ye shes kyi man ngag ni nyams su blang bar bstan pa yin no: de'i sngon du yi ge ma ru nas byung ba'i 'khor 'das ru shan 'byed pa'i spyod pa byas nas de la rtags byung ba dang : rang gi rig pa nyid mngon du gtan ma la phab na:snang ba'i dngos po 'di zad par byed pa la rig pa mngon sum gyi yin gyis:stong pas ni snang ba'i dngos po 'di zad par nus pa ma yin no: de'i phyir na —12/

mesapo'i shul ba'ag las/ 1nga chen rab 'grum sakya gsu— 'bum/ (kadangos pos dngos po zad par byed pa yin gyi: stong pas ni stong pa zad par nus la: mngon sum gyis mngon sum zad par nus pas na: rang bzhan rdzogs pa chan po'i rnal 'thur pa rang gis rang grol bar bstan pa yin noḥ des gsang ba mchog gis man ngag 'di yi lugs kyi: tshig gi rnam pa thams cad tu sangs rgya bar mi nus pa dang : rdzogs chen spyi la sogs te theg pa rim pa dgu la sogs pa'i tshig rnams dang ཿ mu stegs rtag chad pa dang : 'jig rten tha mal pa'i tshig la 'di gsum khyad par rdul tsam yang med pa ni tshig tu mnyam pa dang :don ni yid dpyod yin par mnyam pa'i phyir ro: de ltar tshig la sangs rgyas med par yid ches nas don gyi rig pa mngon sum du bstan par bya ba ni: de ltar lus ngag gi zhen pa rang log pa'i rnal 'thur pas yul nam mkha' stong pa 'khrul pa med pa ni sprin dang bral ba la bya: rig pa 'khrul pa med pa ni rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi sku nam mkha' la gtan pa yin te shin du dben pa'i gnas su mi skad la sogs mi thos pa'i sar nyamasasu blang bar bya'oḥ dbang po 'khrul pa med pa ni mig mi 'gal ba gnad yin no: de'i phyir mi 'gyul ba rnam pa gsum la gnad du bstun pa ni rab tu zab bo: gzer rnam pa gsum gyis man ngag gis:de'i rgyab brten gyi gnad yin te de ni dpe na zhib po: bkra shis mdzes ldan kyi rgyud kyi rgyab yig man ngag gi rgyal po dung yig can gyi snying tig gnad la 'bebs pa rdzogs so: :a ti: rgya rgya rgya: :kun tu bzang po thugs kyi me long gi gnad kyi man ngag gsum la: dngos po ma shes pas gol sa dang : blos brtags rim pa'i gol sa'i man ngag gnyis —/22

mesapo'i shul ba'ag las/ klong chen rab 'byam sakyi gsu 'bum/ (3)dngos pos dngos po zad par byed pa yin gyi: stong pas ni stong pa zad par nus la mngon sum gyis mngon sum zad par nus pas na: rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa rang gis rang grol bar bstan pa yin no: des gsang ba mchog gis man ngag 'di yi lugs kyi: tshig gi rnam pa thams cad tu sangs rgya bar mi nus pa dang : rdzogs chen spyi la sogs te theg pa rim pa dgu la sogs pa'i tshig rnams dang ཿ mu stegs rtag chad pa dang : 'jig rten tha mal pa'i tshig la 'di gsum khyad par rdul tsam yang med pa ni tshig tu mnyam pa dang :don ni yid dpyod yin par mnyam pa'i phyir ro: de ltar tshig la sangs rgyas med par yid ches nas don gyi rig pa mngon sum du bstan par bya ba ni: de ltar lus ngag gi zhen pa rang log pa'i rnal 'byer pas yul nam mkha' stong 7pa 'khrul pa med pa ni sprin dang bral ba la bya: rig pa 'khrul pa med pa ni rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi sku nam mkha' la gtad pa yin te shin du dben pa'i gnas su mi skad la sogs mi thos pa'i sar nyamagasu blang bar bya'o: dbang po 'khrul pa med pa ni mig mi 'gul ba gnad yin no: de'i phyir mi 'gul ba rnam pa gsum la gnad du bstun pa ni rab tu zab bo: gzer rnam pa gsum gyis man ngag gis de'i rgyab brten gyi gnad yin te de ni dpe na zhib po bkra shis mdzes ldan gyi rgyud kyi rgyab yig man ngag gi rgyal po dung yig can gyi snying tig gnad la 'bebs pa rdzogs so: :a ti: rgya rgya rgya: :kun tu bzang po thugs kyi me long gi gnad kyi man ngag gsum la: dngos po ma shes pas gol sa dang : blos brtags rim pa'i gol sa'i man ngag gnyis —/22
