g.yu yig /de sheste ཿga/de sko rnams//de ma/de /de bar du dang ldan na skun bdunab dku /de sworyāsgoroshinatu dkon pa gsang ba'i rgyud rgyal grangs:shin tu rgya che rnam par bkod pa las bsdusate gsang /de snyeng dang 'dra ba du skyago phya ma /den :de ltar snying thig yang gab sbas pa yi: ma gas ba ya na yache bsdus4mar gyi yang /de lta bu'i snying po 'di:phyi rabs gang dang gang gis 'dzin par /der:tha ma ston pa'i bstan pa mi gnas/de tshe /debye:bstan pa'i btsasasu gang gisame ro byed:thig lem/de gsang bla med yongs rdzogs 'di'i:bstan pa nyid la 'phel 'asprib ji ltar /deng :skal dang ldan pa'i skyes bu lung rab can:/deng ba rang dengasablo ldan du /de phu she lhagar /deng ཿsnyigasam rtsod ldan le losarab g.yengasapasasnye'adi kho gomasapar ma gyur gding med pa:bar dor snyekharang ngo bstan pa du zhig /deng :skye med ga shā sna bamachog de goms pa ma gyur yang 'di nyid mthong brka skye yon ngal ba/de sa gnasagang :rmongasapa rnamasakyi gdung ba /ded pa'i phyir:ston pa thugs rje /de po nyid ba/des la:bdag ni don la yid /de/deg phyir gsungs:de nasaston pa dru/de rje spre'od srungasartsa/de /de:/de nge 'dzin snapa༅4 spyo lasab/des nasani:shā ri'i bu la 'di skad gsungs:kye ma tshe dang ldan pa /de:gdung pa dag ni sel ba'i /de:khyod kyis khyo thigo rgya rigaglon 0'di dag gzung bar dka':zeg pa dman la /desapa dang :rtokhe ba dge sbyong dag gi gzugs 'dzin la: sgratsoralngar bsa'adi ni rab gsang snying /de don:byang chub semasadapa' ོ po yi:spyod yul nyid lasag/de gyisamin:de yi phyir na don 'a a spyo/dezung ba dka' 'o:49

gamu yig can ོte spugachung sko rnams/tshig mtshon tsheg bar du dang ldan na tshan bdunab po ma gosgosgopashinatu dkon pa gsang ba'i rgyud rgyal grangs:shin tu rgya che rnam par bkod pa las bsdusate gsang tig snying dang 'dra ba du skyar phya ma bas na :de ltar snying thig yang gab sbas pa yi: ma gas ba ya na yadu bsdulobamar gyi yang zhus lta bu'i snying po 'di phyi rabs gang dang gang gis 'dzin par 'gyur tha ma ston pa'i bstan pa mi gnasasus tshe chagamasabye bstan pa'i btsasasu gang gisame ro byed:thig lemachog gsang bla med yongs rdzogs 'di'i:bstan pa nyid la 'phel 'grib ji ltar 'byung :skal dang ldan pa'i skyes bu lung rab can:'byung ba rang dengasablo ldan du zhig phu she lhagar 'byung :snyigasam rtsod ldan le losarab g.yengasapas:'di go gomasapar ma gyur gding med pa bar dor waṃbarang ngo bstan pa du zhig 'byung :skye med ga yo sna bamachog de goms pa ma gyur yang :'di nyid mthong bag skye yon ngal bso'i sa gnasagang :rmongasapa rnamasakyi gdung ba bcad pa'i phyir ston pa thugs rje chen po nyid bzhengs la bdag ni don la yid chesa'adug phyir gsungs de nasaston pa druga' rje 4'od srungasartsapagasonyid:ting nge 'dzin snab༅4 kha lasabazhengs nasani shā ri'i bu la 'di skad gsungs:kye ma tshe dang ldan pa nyon:gdung pa dag ni sel ba'i tshig:khyod kyis khyo thigapho rgya rigaglon ba'adi dag gzung bar dka':theg pa dman la zhugasapa dang :rtol ba dge sbyong dag gi gzugs 'dzin la: sgrakhabalngar bsa'adi ni rab gsang snying po'i don:byang chub semasadapa' go po yi:spyod yul nyid lasagayin gyisamin:de yi phyir na don 'a yo kyasogazung ba dka' 'o:49

mes/de shu ba/de /de/ klo /de ba /demasakya gsu /dem//deni:/deng ba lnga yi /degs /de no:bltasapas/de pa lo brgya la:dgod pa dag ni drug /de bar:brgya phyed la ni lag /dengs so:de nasaganyisag/de/ded pa 'o:de lasakhye 'u bu /de /degs:kun nas rasasam shing shun /de:zas su sa yi tshil /de za:ser sna'i gsog 'jog dag gisani:/de rim blangasapasade yang nub:de nas salu'i 'bras kyang sbyad:de la nga dang bdag /deng bas:nga /dedag dang zhe sdang ste:de yisazasakyang rim gyisanub:stong byed dag gis lo re bri:brgyad khri dag gi dusakyi tshe:bdag ni mngal skyes /degs can te:lha dbang ma/de rab /deg phud dang :'dod yum /de ldan rgyu rkyen las:busapa dag gi gzugs su 'ongs:de tshe sems/de de dag gi:'dod /des bzhi las byung ba'i /degs:skye ba bzhi /degs tha dad ste:brdzus nas skyesapa sayi /degs:sgong skyesadrod ste me yi gzugs:drod /de sdud pa chu yi gzugs mngal skyes/de gi /degs su 'o:de ltar skye ba/de lus len yang :/deng ba nyid lasabaskyed pa 'o:phal cher drod dang /der las so:thog mar /deng bsabaskyed pas na:tha ma /deng bsa'ajig pa 'o:sum cu rtsa gsum /de bya ba:dga' dang ldan pa'i yul de sagasgobar byed pa'i sman gyi ma/de:skyed par byed pa sman gyi ma/de:skyed par byed pasag/de nu la:khyad par yid 'ong sdum ra der:nga ni drug pa rdo rje /de :byang tso semasadapa'i /degs su /dengs:sangs rgyasa'od srungasal sogasate:rab ni bdun po /der du 'o:'brasabu gsum gyi zas zosaso:lha dbang brgya byin khangs bzangs kyi:lho yi phyogs su de ltar ro:lha dbang brgya byin /den mo 4

mesapo'i shu bzhag la / klo chen ba 'byamasakya gsu 'bum/(la/ni 'byung ba lnga yi gzugs can no:bltasapasatshim pa lo brgya la:dgod pa dag ni drug cu'i bar:brgya phyed la ni lag bcangs so:de nasaganyisaganyisa'abyud pa 'o:de lasakhye 'u bu mo'i gzugs kun nas rasasam shing shun rgyan:zas su sa yi tshil zhag za ser sna'i gsog 'jog dag gisani zhag rim blangasapasade yang nub:de nas salu'i 'bras kyang spyad:de la nga dang bdag bzung bas:nga rgyaladag dang zhe sdang ste:de yisazasakyang rim gyisanub:stong byed dag gis lo re bri:brgyad khri dag gi dusakyi tshe bdag ni mngal skyes gzugs can te:lha dbang mchog rab gtsug phud dang :'dod yum brtse ldan rgyu rkyen las busapa dag gi gzugs su 'ongs:de tshe semasacan de dag gi 'dod chags bzhi las byung ba'i gzugs:skye ba bzhi gzugs tha dad ste:brdzus nas skyesapa sayi gzugs sgong skyesadrod ste me yi gzugs drod rlan sdud pa chu yi gzugs mngal skyesarlung gi gzugs su 'o:de ltar skye bzhi'i lus len yang :'byung ba nyid lasabaskyed pa 'o:phal cher drod dang gsher las so:thog mar 'byung bsabaskyed pas na tha ma 'byung bsa'ajig pa 'o:sum cu rtsa gsum zhes bya ba dga' dang ldan pa'i yul de phugasobar byed pa'i sman gyi mchog:skyed par byed pa sman gyi mchog:skyed par byed pasagaston nu la:khyad par yid 'ong ldum ra der:nga ni drug pa rdo rje las :byang sa semasadapa'i gzugs su 'khrungs sangs rgyasa'od srungasal sogasate:rab ni bdun po 'khor du 'o:'brasabu gsum gyi zas zosaso:lha dbang brgya byin khangs bzangs kyi lho yi phyogs su de ltar ro:lha dbang brgya byin btsun mo 4

g.yu yigacan po ti sgrug chung skorasnams/dang : sum cu rtsa gnyis sras bcas pas: nyid dang drag po yid bzhin dang snye lha mor bcasapa de dag gi: nyan mongs zad par bya phyir 'ongs: der ni bdun cu rtsa lnga lon: de nas don med stong phrag bdun: yang ni brtse ba'i sems skyes nas: nyon mongasagadug rtsub mkha' 'gra'i gnas: gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod du: gnod sbyin rakṣa seng gdong dang : 'dod pa'i dbang ma'ilhumasanas skyes: yid khrosa'ajigasapa'i gzugasasu byas: gzhan nu dpa' ba'i stobasadang ldan: 'khar ni byang chub semasadapa' bdun: mkha' 'gro purna nyer zhi dang : tshangs pa nyid ni dung gi masprin: drang sgong zla 'od gzhan nu dang : seng ge'i gdong can la sogs te: 'di dag gdul ba'i yul du byas: tshe lo drug khri'i dus su 'o: de nas stong du bstan pa btsugs: de nas mya ngan 'da' tshul ston: de ltar rim pa gnyis ldan no: de 'og ting 'dzin bum phrag gcigag: tshe lo stong gi dusadag lco srin po phywa'i yul du yang : srin por raka khro gdong dang :srin mo sham sham nag mo'i bur: nga ni drang sgong khros par 'ongs: 'bar ni srin po bye ba gcig: de dag zhi ldan semasal bkodaḥ de don stong phrag gnyis kyi bar: de nabasamya ngan 'da' ba'i zhes: stag spyang khrosapa'i ri la 'o: ting 'dzin dag la 'bum phrag phyed: de nasalto phyogasa'adzam gling rgyan: nyan thos rnamasadang yid 'dresaphyir: rgyal po dza ri zhes bya ba'i: khab kyi lho nas rgyang gragasagacig: bya rgod sgrungs pa zhesabya ba'i: ri 'dir nga ni da lta 'o: tshe lo dag ni stong byed la: rigs ldan rgyal rigs dag gi bu: rgyal po seng ge bzang po dang :mjes ma 'od ldan yum gyi lhums: nga skyes skyes bu lus shed can: 'phangasadang —155

galu yigacan po ti skrug chung skorarnams/dang : sum cu rtsa gnyis sras bcas pas: nyid dang drag po yid bzhin dang : lha mor bcasapa de dag gi: nyon mongs zad par bya phyir 'ongs der ni bdun cu rtsa lnga lon de nas don med stong phrag bdun: yang ni brtse ba'i sems skyes nas: nyon mongasagadug rtsub mkha' 'gro'i gnas: gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod du: gnod sbyin rakta seng gdong dang : 'dod pa'i dbang mo'ilhumasanas skyes: yid khrosa'ajigasapa'i gzugasasu byas gaston nu dpa' bo'i stobasadang ldan: 'khor ni byang chub semasadapa' bdun: mkha' 'gro purna nyer zhi dang : tshangs pa nyid ni dung gi mgrin: drang sgong zla 'od gzhen nu dang : seng ge'i gdong can la sogs te: 'di dag gdul ba'i yul du byas: tshe lo drug khri'i dus su 'o: de nas stong du bstan pa btsugs de nas mya ngan 'da' tshul ston: de ltar rim pa gnyis ldan no: de 'og ting 'dzin bum phrag gci ga: tshe lo stong gi dusadag zhu srin po wa'i yul du yang : srin por rakka khro gdong dang :srin mo sham sham nag mo'i bur: nga ni drang srong khros par 'ongs: 'khor ni srin po bye ba gcig de dag zhi ldan semasal bkod: de don stong phrag gnyis kyi bar: de nabashamya ngan 'da' ba'i tshul: stag spyang khrosapa'i ri la 'o: ting 'dzin dag la 'bum phrag phyed: de nasalto phyogasa'adzam gling rgyan: nyan thos rnamasadang yid 'dresaphyir rgyal po dza ri zhes bya ba'i khab kyi lho nas rgyang gragasagacig: bya rgod spungs pa zhesabya ba'i ri 'dir nga ni da lta 'o: tshe lo dag ni stong phyed la: rigs ldan rgyal rigs dag gi bu: rgyal po seng ge bzang po dang :mjes ma 'od ldan yum gyi lhums: nga skyes skyes bu lus shed can: 'phangasadang —155—

me po'i shusabazhagalas/ klong rṣa rab spyomasakyigasung 'akum/()sgyu rtsal kun la mkhas: nyi shu rtsa lnga dag na ni: nub phyogasabasags pa'i mchad rten rtsar: rang gisarang byung rab tu byung : kha dog ngur sgrug gosargyan te: nyan thosarnamasakyi gdung ba ba da: de nasa'adi nas byang gi phyogs: 'brasabu yongasasu rdzogasapa yi: byang chub snying po'i shing can du: lo ni brgya dang nyi shu rtsabyang chub sems dpa'i gdung ba bcad: de 'og da lta phung pa'i rir: bdun cu rtsa gnyis bar du ni: nyan thos byang chub semasadapa' yi: gdung ba ba da phyir 'di ltar ro: bram ze dag ni mtshan bzang dang : dge slong ma ni padma'i spyan:gdul yul yon bdag 'di dag go: dgra ba ma bdun gyi 'khar snang ba: thog ma'i sangs rgyas bdun la sogs: dkyil 'khor gcig bsdus 'khar yin no:da lta tshe lo sum brgya la: gdul bya nyon mongs rnams ba da phyir: 'od srung bsgresapo zhes bya ba: rgasapa'i sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir: dge sgong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'o: da ni 'di nasanub byang mtshams: rdo rje gdan drung byang chub gnas: byang chub shing la rgyab gtad nas: sgod la bdud kyi dpung rnamasabatso: nam byed ting 'dzin mnyam bshag nas: skya rengs dag ni shar ba la/nga ni mya ga 'da' tshul ston: ngasani thog ma de ltar du: brdzus dang sgo nga drod dang brlan: mngal las skyesapa'i gzugs dang niḥ rim pasasemasacan nyid dang bcan: de ltar sprul nas don byasaso: bkod pa chen po 'a ma tsho drug gi bdag nyid las: dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs pasabargyud pa'i don tshig ces bya ba rdzogs so:lja: rgya rgya rgya: :༈ de nas nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugasalas byung ba'i lo rgyus zhesabya —156—

me po'i shu bzhagalas/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyigasung 'bum/(ri/sgyu rtsal kun la mkhas nyi shu rtsa lnga dag na ni: nub phyogasabasags pa'i mchod rten rtsar rang gisarang byung rab tu byung : kha dog ngur sprig gosargyan te: wa thosarnamasakyi gdung ba bcad de nasa'adi nas byang gi phyogs: 'brasabu yongasasu rdzogasapa yi: byang chub snying po'i shing can du lo ni brgya dang nyi shu phubyang chub sems dpa'i gdung ba bcad: de 'og da lta phung po'i rir: bdun cu rtsa gnyis bar du ni: nyan thos byang chub semasadapa' yi gdung ba bcad phyir 'di ltar ro bram ze dag ni mtshan bzang dang : dge slong ma ni padma'i spyan gdul yul yon bdag 'di dag go: dgra bcom bdun gyi 'khor snang ba: thog ma'i sangs rgyas bdun la sogs: dkyil 'khor gcig bsdus 'khor yin no:da lta tshe lo sum brgya la gdul bya nyon mongs rnams bcad phyir: 'od srung bsgresapo zhes bya ba rgasapa'i sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'o: da ni 'di nasanub byang mtshams: rdo rje gdan drung byang chub gnas: byang chub shing la rgyab gtad nas: srod la bdud kyi dpung rnamasabatul: nam phyed ting 'dzin mnyam bzhag nas skya rengs dag ni shar ba la/nga ni mya pha 'da' tshul ston: ngasani thog ma de ltar du: brdzus dang sgo nga drod dang brlan: mngal las skyesapa'i gzugs dang ni: rim pasasemasacan nyid dang bstun: de ltar sprul nas don byasaso: bkod pa chen po 'bum tsho drug gi bdag nyid las dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs pasabargyud pa'i don tshig ces bya ba rdzogs so:snyi rgya rgya rgya: :/ de nas nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugasalas byung ba'i lo rgyus zhesabya —156

g.yu yig yi po ti ཿga sa stor rnam /ba rnam par spros so: tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig: nga ni brdzus nasaskyes pa'i tshe: khye 'u gzhan nu 'khrul med la: 'jigs rten nyi masarab dgang phyir: rgyud kyi rgyal po thal 'gyur te: nam mkha' mi 'byed bar snang nas: ka la ying ka'i mchus bsgyur nas: 'gro ba 'dul phyir 'di dag bstan: 'di ni bstan pa 'byung ba'i 'go: nga ni sgo nga las skyes tshe: sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyud: yon tan phrin las rgyud lnga ni: 'byung ba 'gyur ba'i bar dag nas: 'byung ba'i rang sgra dag gis bsgyur: des ni sems can lusasogs grol: nga ni dron brlan lasaskyes tshe: dong sprug rma bya mjing bsnol dang : 'byung ba zad pa'i rgyud rnamasani:bar snang ga nga dang bral ba las: rlung gi sgra las drangs te bsgyur: 'dis ni 'dod pa'i zhen chags g.yod: de nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi: rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzangs su: rigs drug nyon mongs gdung bcad phyir: gdung ba sel ba'i dam chas drug: blo rim gnyisasu snang ba'i phyir: rtsol sgrub 'bad pasagrol ba dang : 'bad med rang sar grol ba gnyis: 'bad ba sadag ni tshig gi don:'bum tsho gnyis su rnam bshad do: de yang rgyas pa 'bum dang gcig: bzhi khri stong phrag brgyad du bstan: 'bad med yongs su bshad pa dang : kun gsal dang ni rigasagasum rgyud: rnam par bye ste bstan pa 'o: de nas dur khrod gsang chen du: shes rab chags pa can dag la: 'dod chags nyid kyis 'dul ba'i phyir: ma yi rgyud ni bye ba gnyis: chags pa can gyi don du bstan: thabs kyis skyes pa 'dul ba'i phyir: pha yi rgyud ni bye ba dgu: skyes pa rnams kyi don du gsungs: ma yi rgyud lasarnam bsdusapa: 'bum tsho lnga yi bdag nyid do: pha —157—

galu yig yo po ti spug yo smor rnams/ba rnam par spros so: tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig: nga ni brdzus nasaskyes pa'i tshe khye 'u gzhen nu 'khrul med la 'jigs rten nyi masarab dgang phyir: rgyud kyi rgyal po thal 'gyur te: nam mkha' mi 'byed bar snang nas ka la ping sha'i mchus bsgyur nas 'gro ba 'dul phyir 'di dag bstan: 'di ni bstan pa 'byung ba'i 'go: nga ni sgo nga las skyes tshe: sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyud yon tan phrin las rgyud lnga ni: 'byung ba 'gyur ba'i bar dag nas: 'byung ba'i rang sgra dag gis bsgyur: des ni sems can lusasogs grol: nga ni dron brlan lasaskyes tshe: dong sprug rma bya mjing bsnol dang : 'byung ba zad pa'i rgyud rnamasani:bar snang gzung dang bral ba las: rlung gi sgra las drangs te bsgyur: 'dis ni 'dod pa'i chen chags gcod: de nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzangs su rigs drug nyon mongs gdung bcad phyir gdung ba sel ba'i dam chos drug blo rim gnyisasu snang ba'i phyir rtsol sgrub 'bad pasagrol ba dang : 'bad med rang sar grol ba gnyis: 'bad bcasadag ni tshig gi don:'bum tsho gnyis su rnam bshad do: de yang rgyas pa 'bum dang gcig: bzhi khri stong phrag brgyad du bstan: 'bad med yongs su bshad pa dang : kun gsal dang ni rigasagasum rgyud: rnam par phye ste bstan pa 'o: de nas dur khrod gsang chen du: shes rab chags pa can dag la: 'dod chags nyid kyis 'dul ba'i phyir ma yi rgyud ni bye ba gnyis: chags pa can gyi don du bstan: thabs kyis skyes pa 'dul ba'i phyir: pha yi rgyud ni bye ba dgu: skyes pa rnams kyi don du gsungs: ma yi rgyud lasarnam bsdusapa: 'bum tsho lnga yi bdag nyid do: pha —157

me bo'i shulabashagal / klong chen rab 'grumasakyig nga 'bum/()las khyad par rnam sdud pa: gsang mchag bla na med pa yi: bkod pa gsang ba'i rgyud rnams bstan: de nasasrin pa'i yul dag 1 rags pa 'dul ba'i rgyud bcu bstan: sog pa'i yul du phra rgyud bdun: 'dir ni mdo sde 'a ma phrag ni: nyi shu rtsa lnga nyid du bstan: sngagasani khri phrag gnyisasu bstan: lung ni khri phrag phyed dang brgyad: de ltar rnam par bye ba 'o: zhes bkod pa chen po 'a ma tsho drug gi bdag nyid las: bstan pa'i chosaji ltar gsungs pa'i don tshig bstan pa ste gnyis pa'o: rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya: :de nas rdo rje chen po rnam par rol ba zhes bya ba'i tshig dag rnam par spros so: de ltar bstan pa'i chasarnams la: shad ni brgyad kyisagacig byas pa'i:brgyad 'gyur ba phrag 'bum phrag 'gyur: de rdzogs tshig rnams rnam bye bas:gsal byed sgon ma'i rim pa 'o: stong pa nyid ni mtshon pa yi: rim dang rim min phye nas bstan: 'di rdzogasamasagyi stobar lo 'o: zhes bkod pa ོ po 'bum phrag drug pa las: gcad par bya ba 'bras bu'i don tshig bstan pa ste gsum pa rdzogs so:lja: rgya rgya rgya: :de nas nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs las sde rnam par 'byed pa'i zhesabya ba'i tshig rnam par phyung ngo : kye kye nyon cig dge sbyong khyod: rigasaldan rigasabu shā ri'i bu: rdzu'aphrul mchog dang ldan pa nyon: ngasabastan pa yi chasarnams ni: sems can blo yi rim pa las: che dang chung ba'i khyad par gyis: rim pa gnyis kyi tshul du bstan: rang rang lta dang sor gzhag go: rang rang nyid ni rim pa gnyis: phyin ci log dang yang dag lta: log par rtogs pasa'akhar la —158—

me po'i shulabazhagal / klong chen rab 'byam kyig nga 'bum/()las khyad par rnam sdud pa: gsang mchog bla na med pa yi bkod pa gsang ba'i rgyud rnams bstan de nasasrin po'i yul dag zhu rags pa 'dul ba'i rgyud bcu bstan sog po'i yul du phra rgyud bdun: 'dir ni mdo sde 'bum phrag ni nyi shu rtsa lnga nyid du bstan sngagasani khri phrag gnyisasu bstan lung ni khri phrag phyed dang brgyad de ltar rnam par bye ba 'o: zhes bkod pa chen po 'bum tsho drug gi bdag nyid las: bstan pa'i chosaji ltar gsungs pa'i don tshig bstan pa ste gnyis pa'o: rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya: :de nas rdo rje chen po rnam par rol ba zhes bya ba'i tshig dag rnam par spros so: de ltar bstan pa'i chosarnams la shad ni brgyad kyisagacig byas pa'i brgyad 'gyur bcu phrag 'bum phrag 'gyur de rdzogs tshig rnams rnam phye bas:gsal byed sgron ma'i rim pa 'o: stong pa nyid ni mtshon pa yi rim dang rim min phye nas bstan 'di rdzogasachosagyi 'khor lo 'o: zhes bkod pa go po 'bram phrag drug pa las: gcad par bya ba 'bras bu'i don tshig bstan pa ste gsum pa rdzogs so:snyi: rgya rgya rgya: :de nas nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs las sde rnam par 'byed pa'i zhesabya ba'i tshig rnam par phyung ngo : kye kye nyon cig dge sbyong khyod: rigasaldan rigasabu shā ri'i bu: rdzu'aphrul mchog dang ldan pa nyen: ngasabastan pa yi chosarnams ni: sems can blo yi rim pa las che dang chung ba'i khyad par gyis rim pa gnyis kyi tshul du bstan: rang rang lta dang sor gzhag go: rang rang nyid ni rim pa gnyis: phyin ci log dang yang dag lta log par rtogs pasa'akhor la —158—

gabu yig can potesnag chung skor rnams/gnas: yang dag pa ni rim gsum ste: chung ba'i blo dang chen po la: de bzhin 'bring po'i blo can la'o: rim pa gsum gyi tshul du bstan: chung ba'i rim pa rnam gsum ste: de yi blo dang mthun pa'i chos: rtogapas sbagasal nyan thos te:'du shes can la rang rgyal nyid rtog 'dug can la byang sems so: 'bring po gsum la bstan pa ni: rab tu dman la bya ba ste: dman pa rnams la spyod pa 'o:rnam shes can la rnal 'byor nyid chen po rim ldan gsum dag la: sems yas pa la bskyed pa ste: sems bcud can la rdzogs pa 'o: mchog gsang rab la rdzogs pa che: de yi rnam par dbye ba ni 'on kyang de 'das 'og dag zhu'adi ltar rnam par snang bar 'gyur yid can rnams la sems kyi sde nam mkha' can la klong gi sde rim rtsol bral la man ngag go: de ltar rdzogs chen a ti la: 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi las semasasde nyi shu rtsa gcig ste: klong ni nyi shu gnyis yin no: man ngag nyi shu rtsa gcig pa: de las rgyud sde rim gsum la pha dang ma dang ma ning ngo : a ti pha rgyud chen po ni: bkod pa chen po gsang ba'i rgyud: 'bum phrag drug pa 'di nyid do: ma rgyud 'bum phrag bcu gsum la:ma ning dag ni rnam pa gnyis: 'dir ni pha ma ma ning gsum rnam par bsdusanas gcig tu ste: de yi don tshig rnam spros pas spros bcas rnamasal bzhi nyid ste: sprosamed rnam grangs bcu bdun no: shin tu spros pa med pa ni: rdo rje bkod pa nyid yin no: rab tu spros dang bral ba la 'das rjes gsum gyis grol pa yin gal te tshig la rab 'dzin na: thig le'i rgyud ni sum cu dgu:'di dag rnamasani ngasabastan pas: de dag rnams la yid ches bya bco lnga —159

g.yu yig ༅ pohaṃ༄ga ca skor rnams/gnas: yang dag pa ni rim gsum ste: chung ba'i blo dang chen po la: de bzhin 'bring pa'i blo can la'o: rim pa gsum gyi tshul du bstan: chung ba'i rim pa rnam gsum ste: de yi blo dang mthun pa'i chas: rtogapas sbagasal nyan thos te:'du shes can la rang rgyal nyid: rtog 'jug can la byang sems so: 'bring po gsum la bstan pa ni: rab tu dman la bya ba ste: dman pa rnams la spyod pa 'o:rnam shes can la rnal 'thur nyid: chen po rim ldan gsum dag la: sems yas pa la bskyed pa ste: sems bca can la rdzogs pa 'o: mchag gsang rab la rdzogs pa che: de yi rnam par dbye ba ni: 'on kyang de 'das 'og dag lco'adi ltar rnam par snang bar 'gyur: yid can rnams la sems kyi sde: nam mkha' can la 1nga gi sde: rim rtsol bral la man ngag go: de ltar rdzogs chen a ti lasnye 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi las: semasasde nyi shu rtsa ga ga ste: 1nga ni nyi shu gnyis yin no: man ngag nyi shu rtsa ga ga pa: de las rgyud sde rim gsum la: pha dang ma dang ma ning ngo : a ti pha rgyud chen po ni: bkod pa chen po gsang ba'i rgyud: 'bum phrag drug pa 'di nyid do: ma rgyud 'bum phrag ba gsum la:ma ning dag ni rnam pa gnyis: 'dir ni pha ma ma ning gsum: rnam par bsdusanas gcig tu ste: de yi don tshig rnam spros pas: spros bcas rnamasal bzhi nyid ste: sprosamed rnam grangs bcu bdun no: shin tu spros pa med pa ni: rdo rje bkod pa nyid yin no: rab tu spros dang bral ba la: 'das rjes gsum gyis grol pa yin: gal te tshig la rab 'dzin na: thig le'i rgyud ni sum cu dgu:'di dag rnamasani ngasabastan pas: de dag rnams la yid ches bya: bco lnga —159—

me po'i shulabasal / klopaza thu 'byam kyigasung las//shigasum byed ming rgyud la: khri phrag gnyis dang stong phrag lnga: thig le mchag gi rgyud rnams so: khyad par mchog tu gsang ba'i rgyud: bstan pa 'dzin skyong bsrung ba yi: rim gsal snying dang 'dra ba'i rgyud: rnam pa bco brgyad dag bstan la:stong phrag dag ni bcu bdun yin: bstan pa kun gyi bu gcig po: brgya phrag gnyis dang bye dang brgyad: sde dang lung rab de ltar snang : 'di ni mchag tu gsang ba las: kun gyi spyod yul ma yin pas: 'byung ba'i dgra bral sangs rgyasa'adzin: 'di lasasde bzhi dag tu 'phro: nam mkha' nyid la 'phar ba dang :sa rnams la yang thogasamed 'gyur: des ni sangasargyas gdung 'dzin pa'o: de ltar ngas bstan rgyud chen rnams: brdzusaskyesadusakyi byin brlabasal: sgong skyes thar pa'i rgyud tsam mtshon: drod skyes la ni drang ba'i don: mngal skyes dga' ldan yul dag tu 'ga' zhig stongasapar gtan la phab: kha cig de bsanye bar bstan: dur khrod nyid du rnam bshad pa: pho mo ma ning rnamasakyi don: sna tshogs thabs kyisamatshon nasabastan: khyad par mtshog gsang zab par bstan:'dir ni drang zhing 'dul bar bstan: nges pa'i snying po 'ga' tsam mo: srin po'i yul du zhi rgyas dbang : tshang gcod don du mngan spyod bstan: sog pa'i yul du sems rgyud bcad: de ltar rgyud rnamasarab bye ba: sems can rnamasakyi don du ste: de yi don rnams rgya che bas: bstan pa'i lugasani rnam pa gsum: ji ltar skasakyi rim pa bzhin: dbang pa'i don du bstan pa dang : 'o ma las ni mar bzhin du: bsdu ba'i don du bstan pa dang : tsha ba'i nad la ga bur bzhin:gnyen pa'i don du bstan pa 'o: dbang ba'i don du bstan pa ni: rim dgu blo —160—

me po'i shulab galas/ klopachen rab 'byam kyigasung 'bram/(3)gsum phyed ming rgyud la: khri phrag gnyis dang stong phrag lnga thig le mchog gi rgyud rnams so: khyad par mchog tu gsang ba'i rgyud: bstan pa 'dzin skyong bsrung ba yi rim gsal snying dang 'dra ba'i rgyud: rnam pa bco brgyad dag bstan la:stong phrag dag ni bcu bdun yin: bstan pa kun gyi bu gcig po: brgya phrag gnyis dang phye dang brgyad sde dang lung rab de ltar snang : 'di ni mchog tu gsang ba las: kun gyi spyod yul ma yin pas: 'byung ba'i dgra bral sangs rgyasa'adzin 'di lasasde bzhi dag tu 'phro: nam mkha' nyid la 'phar ba dang :sa rnams la yang thogasamed 'gyur: des ni sangasargyas gdung 'dzin pa'o: de ltar ngas bstan rgyud chen rnams brdzusaskyesadusakyi byin brlabasal sgong skyes thar pa'i rgyud tsam mtshon: drod skyes la ni drang ba'i don mngal skyes dga' ldan yul dag tu 'ga' zhig stongasapar gtan la phab: kha cig de bsanye bar bstan: dur khrod nyid du rnam bshad pa: pho mo ma ning rnamasakyi don sna tshogs thabs kyisamachen nasabastan khyad par mchog gsang zab par bstan 'dir ni drang zhing 'dul bar bstan: nges pa'i snying po 'ga' tsam mo srin po'i yul du zhi rgyas dbang : tshar gcod don du mja spyod bstan sog po'i yul du sems rgyud bcad: de ltar rgyud rnamasarab phye ba sems can rnamasakyi don du ste: de yi don rnams rgya che bas: bstan pa'i lugasani rnam pa gsum ji ltar skasakyi rim pa bzhin: dbang po'i don du bstan pa dang : 'o ma las ni mar bzhin du: bsdu ba'i don du bstan pa dang : tsha ba'i nad la ga bur bzhin:gnyen po'i don du bstan pa 'o: dbang ba'i don du bstan pa ni: rim dgu blo —160

gaku yig can po ti ཿga chung skor rnams/dang bstun nas ni: che longs dang ni zhib tshegasaso: bsdu ba brgyad khri bzhi stong las: sde bzhir dag tu rnam par bsdus : gnyen po sems can rang rgyud la:nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong ste: de yi snying por mas kyang ngo : de ltar bshad pa'i sems can gyi: rang rgyud ba ngas pa dag lasagrol: tshig gisamachen pa'i rgyud rnams ni: sde dang 'bum tsho grangs su ba da: ces a ti bkod pa chen po 'bum phrag drug pa las: bstan pa'i chos rnams kyi sde dang grangs gtan la phab pa ste bzhi pa rdzogs so:zhi: rgya rgya rgya: :de nas dam tshig rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin las langs te: 'di skad ces ched du brjod do: de ltar bstan pa snying po bkod pa'i don:rgya che rab tu sprosate bsdus pa dang : mchog tu bsdus dang shin tu rab bsdus pas: sems can blo yi gdung ba las grol te: stong pa chen pa'i ngang du mtshon pa'i phyir: tsheg bar bdun gyi rnam par ba da pa 'di: shwa lo 'a ma tsho'i grangasadang tshig du bcad: nyi shu brgyad la sha lo gcig tu bstan: de nyid gong nasagong du bgrangs pa yis: 'a ma dang bye ba saya rgya cher 'gyur: snyigasam dus kyi mtha' la dgos srid pasasnye rabasabadun bstan pa smin par bya ba'i phyir: tsheg bar bdun gyis rnam par ba da nas bstan: rgyud kyi gzhung la phri gzhug mi bya'i phyir: 'di ni snying pa'i don du bkod pa 'o: zhes bkod pa ོ po 'bum tsho drug pa las: tshigasasu bcad pa'i don bstan pa ste lnga pa rdzogasaso: rgya rgya rgya: :de nas nyid kyis rgyud rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas: yang ched du brjod pa'i 'di brjod do: e ma rṣa bka' gsang ngesapa'i —/61—

g.yu yig can po ti spug chung skor rnams/dang bstun nas ni che longs dang ni zhib tshegasaso bsdu ba brgyad khri bzhi stong las sde bzhir dag tu rnam par bsdus : gnyen po sems can rang rgyud la:nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong ste: de yi snying por chos kyang ngo : de ltar bshad pa'i sems can gyi: rang rgyud bcings pa dag lasagrol: tshig gisamatshon pa'i rgyud rnams ni sde dang 'bum tsho grangs su bcad: ces a ti bkod pa chen po 'bum phrag drug pa las bstan pa'i chos rnams kyi sde dang grangs gtan la phab pa ste bzhi pa rdzogs so:snyi: rgya rgya rgya: :de nas dam tshig rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin las langs te 'di skad ces ched du brjod do: de ltar bstan pa snying po bkod pa'i don:rgya che rab tu sprosate bsdus pa dang : mchog tu bsdus dang shin tu rab bsdus pas: sems can blo yi gdung ba las grol te: stong pa chen po'i ngang du mtshon pa'i phyir tsheg bar bdun gyi rnam par bcad pa 'di shā lo 'bum tsho'i grangasadang tshig du bcad nyi shu brgyad la sha lo gcig tu bstan: de nyid gong nasagong du bgrangs pa yis: 'bum dang bye ba saya rgya cher 'gyur: snyigasam dus kyi mtha' la dgos srid pas: rabasabadun bstan pa smin par bya ba'i phyir tsheg bar bdun gyis rnam par bcad nas bstan rgyud kyi gzhung la phri gzhug mi bya'i phyir: 'di ni snying po'i don du bkod pa 'o: zhes bkod pa go po 'bum tsho drug pa las tshigasasu bcad pa'i don bstan pa ste lnga pa rdzogasaso: rgya rgya rgya: :de nas nyid kyis rgyud rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas: yang ched du brjod pa'i 'di brjod do: e ma ho bka' gsang ngesapa'i —/61—

mesabo'i shulabasal / klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/(kasnying po don rnams ni: shin tu rgya che grangs su chad pa las: 'bum phrag nyid ni drug cu rtsa bzhi la: le 'u 'bum phrag gsum dang ldan: yang dag ngesapa'i sar bsgral phyir: rnam par bkod nas nga yis bstan: de nas mchog tu bsdus pa ni:khri phrag gnyis dang stong phrag lnga'o: de nyid rnam par bshad pa'i rgyud: bskyed dang bsdus dang gnas pa dang : gsal dang byams dang nyid dang ni: gsum bzhi drug dang yang gnyis dang : bshad dang rdzogasadang spungasapa 'o: de nyid las ni shin du gsang ཿ yang gab sbas pa'i gsang tshig la: stong phrag dag ni ba bdun no: de don rab tu gsang ba niḥ babs dang rtogs par byed pa'o:de don snying pa'i rgyud rnamasani: gnyisadang gnyisa'abrel yang gnyisadang : de yi yang gsum don rnamasal: de ni bsdus pa gsum yin no: de lasarnam par rab spros pas: rtsa ba brgyad kyi tshul las ni: go rim 'jug phyir rnam bshad pa:bskyed dang bshad pa yan lag dang : lung dang man ngag dgongasapa dang :'jug dang mkhasapa cho ga yis: bstan pa 'dzin dang skyong dang bsrung : sprosapa bco brgyad tshul du byung : gu hya bstan pa'i bu gcig po: snyeng po yang gsang rab tu gsang : 'di dag rnamasani rab tu bsdus: de yi don rnam rgya cher bkod pa las: snying po nges pa'i lung ni 'di dag go: 'di dag rtag tu gomasapar gang byed pa: dam pa rnams kyi gsang chen 'di yis thob: a ti bkod pa chen po 'bum phrag drug pa las: gsang ba snying dang 'dra ba'i rgyud rnams bsdus te rnam par bstan pa ste drug pa rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya:lja: :de nas lung bstan rjes su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin las —/62—

me bo'i shulab gal / klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/(3/snying po don rnams ni: shin tu rgya che grangs su chod pa las 'bum phrag nyid ni drug cu rtsa bzhi la: le 'u 'bum phrag gsum dang ldan: yang dag ngesapa'i sar bsgral phyir: rnam par bkod nas nga yis bstan: de nas mchog tu bsdus pa ni khri phrag gnyis dang stong phrag lnga'o: de nyid rnam par bshad pa'i rgyud: bskyed dang bsdus dang gnas pa dang : gsal dang byams dang nyid dang ni: gsum bzhi drug dang yang gnyis dang : bshad dang rdzogasadang spungasapa 'o: de nyid las ni shin du gsang : yang gab sbas pa'i gsang tshig la: stong phrag dag ni bcu bdun no: de don rab tu gsang ba ni: babs dang rtogs par byed pa'o:de don snying po'i rgyud rnamasani: gnyisadang gnyisa'abrel yang gnyisadang : de yi yang gsum don rnamasal de ni bsdus pa gsum yin no: de lasarnam par rab spros pas: rtsa ba brgyad kyi tshul las ni: go rim 'jug phyir rnam bshad pa:bskyed dang bshad pa yan lag dang : lung dang man ngag dgongasapa dang :'dug dang mkhasapa cho ga yis bstan pa 'dzin dang skyong dang bsrung : sprosapa bco brgyad tshul du byung : gu rgya bstan pa'i bu gcig po: snying po yang gsang rab tu gsang : 'di dag rnamasani rab tu bsdus de yi don rnamasargya cher bkod pa las snying po nges pa'i lung ni 'di dag go: 'di dag rtag tu gomasapar gang byed pa: dam pa rnams kyi gsang chen 'di yis thob a ti bkod pa chen po 'bum phrag drug pa las gsang ba snying dang 'dra ba'i rgyud rnams bsdus te rnam par bstan pa ste drug pa rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya snyi: :de nas lung bstan rjes su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin las —/62—

galu yig can pote skrug chung skorarnams/bzhengs nas sku gsung thugasardo rje bkod pa chen po las 'di skad ched du brjod do kye shā ri'i bu rsā dang ldan pa: 'di rsā rigasakyi bu khyod zung : nga ni 'di nasami gnasatshe: phyi rabs nga yi bstan pa 'di: snying po yang nas yang bsdusapa nges gsang mchog gi snying po'i rgyud 'di dag rnamasakyisa'adzin par 'gyur: nga ni 'di nas mi gnasanas: sum brgya dang ni drug ston: nub phyogs o rgyan dag gi yum: dha na ko sha zhes bya bar: thabasakyi cha med shesarab las u pa rā tsa ces/pa dang : snang ba gsal ba'i 'od ldan yum: gnyisalasabaskyed pa chosakyi sde'i: lhums su pha yi rgyu med zhugs: chosakyi sde yi rmi lam du: shel las grub pa'i mi dkar ni: gzugasadang lang tsho ldan pa zhig:shel kyi bum pa 'od 'bar ba yi ge lnga dang bcas pa thogs spyi bo'i steng du bzhag pa rmi de nasadus tshod rdzogs pa la ngesapa'i snying po 'di 'dzin pa'i khye 'u bde ba'i bag ldan pa sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi sras: de ming badzra pra he zhes: mi lus rnam dag semasacan 'byung : des ni bstan pa 'dul ba yi:thabasani rnam pa du ma yi: mdzad pa dag ni sprosabyasanas lo ni sum cu rtsa gnyis na nga yis bstan pa'i chos rnams ni: ma la ya yi rtse mo la: rdo rje dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma: 'jig rten bde ba'i ro can dang : bde byed ser mo zhes bya bas tshig dang yi ger 'god par 'gyur: rang byung dag gisayi ge ni:bstan pa kun gyi bu gcig go de nasarjes 'dug sprul pa de: bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du shesarab kyi ni gdul bya la: bstan pa dam pa 'di nyid ston de tshe nub phyogasarim gnyis grong : bram ze legasaldan ston pa dang : snang ba'i —163

g.yu yig can pohaṃ ཿga chung skorarnams/bzhengs nas sku gsung thugasardo rje bkod pa ོ po las: 'di skad ched du brjod do: kye shā ri'i bu wo dang ldan pa: 'di rṣa rigasakyi bu khyod zung : nga ni 'di nasami gnasatshe: phyi rabs nga yi bstan pa 'di: snying po yang nas yang bsdusapa: nges gsang mchog gi snying pa'i rgyud: 'di dag rnamasakyisa'adzin par 'gyur: nga ni 'di nas mi gnasanasaḥ sum brgya dang ni drug ston: nub phyogs o rgyan dag gi yumaḥ dha na ko sha zhes bya bar: thabasakyi cha med shesarab las: u pa rā tsa zhes/pa dang : snang ba gsal ba'i 'od ldan yum: gnyisalasabaskyed pa chasakyi sde'i: lhums su pha yi rgyu med zhugs: chesakyi sde yi rmi lam du: shel las grub pa'i mi dkar ni: ga gsadang lang tsho ldan pa zhig:shel kyi bum pa 'od 'bar ba: yi ge lnga dang ba sa pa thogs: spyi ba'i steng du bzhag pa rmi: de nasadus tshod rdzogs pa la: ngesapa'i snying po 'di 'dzin pa'i:khye 'u bde ba'i bag ldan pa: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi sras: de ming badzra pra he zhes: mi lus rnam dag semasacan 'byung : des ni bstan pa 'dul ba yi:thabasani rnam pa du ma yi: mdzad pa dag ni sprosabyasanas: lo ni sum cu rtsa gnyis na nga yis bstan pa'i chas rnams ni: ma la ya yi rtse mo la: rdo rje dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma: 'jig rten bde ba'i ro can dang : bde byed ser mo zhes bya bas: tshig dang yi ger 'god par 'gyur: rang byung dag gisayi ge ni:bstan pa kun gyi bu gcig go: de nasarjes 'jug sprul pa de: bsil ba tshal dzee ṣṭṛ drotram̐ byedzee/dzeerdzu ṅgernyirdo ༵ /sdu spya rdzugasdu/napa tt+waṃ ma pa pad ༷ sdo dzeedā spyaṭwā —163—

me /de shul ba/del / klo ོ ba —ma zu gsu /dem//desgon ma'i yum lhums su:/desate skal ldan rjes 'dzin pa:de ming mañdzu shri pra ti:rig pa'i gnasarnams kun sbyangasapa:skyesabu wo ni ma/de de la:'jam dpal gyi ni lung bstan nas:ba/de pa dam pa 'di la gzud:sprul pa po ni lo brgya dgu:de tshe rjes /deg de dang /ded:de yang shes pa'i rgyud dag nas:shel gyi gong bu ba/de du /der:'di ltar /dem /de dbye ba dang :bsdusadang rgyas dang rab rgyas su:rnam par bye nasaston pa'o:de nasabadun /dertsa lnga na:de yang mya ga 'da' /de ston:chu bo dan /de ces bya'i mgor:zag dkus phung po nyid dang bral:nam mkha' 'o kung gis bkang ste:gdung ba /ded kyi zhal chems so:de nas rjes /deg mañdzu des:/den pa kun gyi snying po 'di:rdo rje gdan du sped par /der:de dusaman ngag sde ga/de su:de nyid kyis ni rnam par /dedasnyeso sa gling gi dur khrod du:rjes/deg de nyid /desasu len:bstan pa'i snying po 'di ston /der:de lo brgya dang rtsa dgu na:rgya nag sho /de gling /depar:/de bdag dge ldan yid can dang :snang ga/de mkhyen ma bya ba'i yum:gnyis kyi rgyu rkyen las/dengs pa'i:de ming dpal gyi seng ge /de:mkhas pa sbyangs pa'i /den ldan pa'i:skal ldan skye/debu de nyid la:sbyan ra/degazigasakyis lung bstan nas:brgya dang sum cu rtsa gnyisan:/de nyid dang 'dzom par /der:de yang sngon sbyangs skal ldan pas:shel gyi gong bu bzhin du /der :de nasanyi shu rtsa lnga na:mañdzu mya /de 'da' /de ston:/deng ba dag ni rang dengs su:nam mkha' 'od kyi phung por /der:gdung ba /ded phyir /de /des so:sgra dang /desate lung bstan thob:de nasabastan pa'i snying po ni:/de

me po'i shul bshagalas/ klo chen ba 'byam rkya gsu 'bum/(la/sgron ma'i yum lhums su:zhugasate skal ldan rjes 'dzin pa:de ming mañdzu phri pra ti:rig pa'i gnasarnams kun sbyangasapa skyesabu nyid ni mchog de la 'jam dpal gyi ni lung bstan nas bstan pa dam pa 'di la gzud:sprul pa po ni lo brgya dgu:de tshe rjes 'jug de dang 'phrad:de yang shes pa'i rgyud dag nas:shel gyi gong bu bzhin du 'gyur:'di ltar 'bum tsho'i dbye ba dang :bsdusadang rgyas dang rab rgyas su:rnam par phye nasaston pa'o:de nasabadun bcurtsa lnga na:de yang mya ༅ 'da' tshul ston:chu bo dan tig ces bya'i mgor:zag bcas phung po nyid dang bral:nam mkha' 'o phung gis bkang ste gdung ba bcad kyi zhal chems so:de nas rjes 'jug mañdzu des:bsten pa kun gyi snying po 'di:rdo rje gdan du sped par 'gyur:de dusaman ngag sde gnyis su:de nyid kyis ni rnam par 'byed so sa gling gi dur khrod du rjesa'ajug de nyid nyamasasu len:bstan pa'i snying po 'di ston 'gyur:de lo brgya dang rtsa dgu na:rgya nag sho khe gling ceXgapar:khyim bdag dge ldan yid can dang :snang gsal mkhyen ma bya ba'i yum gnyis kyi rgyu rkyen lasa'akhrungs pa'i:de ming dpal gyi seng ge zhes:mkhas pa sbyangs pa'i don ldan pa'i skal ldan skyebasabu de nyid la spyan rabasagazigasakyis lung bstan nas brgya dang sum cu rtsa gnyisan:mañdzu nyid dang 'dzom par 'gyur:de yang sngon sbyangs skal ldan pas:shel gyi gong bu bzhin du 'gyur :de nasanyi shu rtsa lnga na:mañdzu mya pha 'da' tshul ston:'byung ba dag ni rang dengs su:nam mkha' 'od kyi phung por 'gyur:gdung ba yod phyir zhal chems so:sgra dang bcasate lung bstan thob de nasabastan pa'i snying po ni:64

g.yu yig ༅ po ti ཿga cad skor rnams/skal dang ldan pa des khyer nas: rgya nag yul du snang bar 'gyur: byang chub 'byung ba'i shing drung du: dgongs pa rtse spyog don rja nas: rigs bzhi dag tu des 'byed 'gyur: sde gsum don rnams gter sted 'gyur: yang dag gsang ba snying zig 'di: bkra shis khri sgo zhes byar sped: des na lo brgya nyi shu lon:dgongs pa dag la rab tu gnas: de tshe rgya gar nub phyogs yul: glang po sgang zhes rgyud rings par: khyim bdag de ni dge ldan las: rab tu rgyu dang rkyen las 'khrungs: de ming phyag rgya rgya chen dang : shar phyogasaka ma shī la'i grong : gdol pa shan ting lag pa dang : dge ba'i sems can yum gyi lhums: rgyu dang rkyen las 'khrungs pa yi: de ming dzñā na su tra zhes: de gnyisasbyangs pa'i yon tan rdzogs: de dus rdo rje gdan nyid na: paṇa ḍi ta ni lnga brgya bzhugs: de dag rnams las mchag tu mkhas: ye shes mdo dang bye ma lar: nub phyogasa'adam bu'i tshal zhes par: rdo rje sems dpas lung ston 'gyur: seng ha nyid dang zhal 'phrad ste: des kyang dam pa'i don snyen 'gyur: yang gsang snying pa'i bstan pa 'di: dzñā na su tra skal ldan par: de yi slob mar de 'gyur ro: de nasalo ni ba bdun na: de yang mya ngan 'da' tshul ston: 'byung ba dag ni rang dengasasu: nam mkha' 'od kyis bkang ste 'gro: gdung ba dag ni gcad pa'i phyir: bstan pa'i btsas su zhal chems so skal ba nyid dang rab ldan pa'i: ye shes mdo ni bha sing du: mkha' 'gra'i gdung ba gcod par 'gyur: mkha' 'gro ma yi lung bstan nas: mu dra nyid kyang skal ldan 'gyur: gnyis kyis lo ni brgya dang gsum: de nas lo lnga'i bar du gnas: skal ldan mchog de rang dengs su: nam —165—

gabu yig can po ti skrug chung skor rnams/skal dang ldan pa des khyer nas: rgya nag yul du snang bar 'gyur byang chub 'byung ba'i shing drung du: dgongs pa rtse gcig don chod nas: rigs bzhi dag tu des 'byed 'gyur: sde gsum don rnams gter sted 'gyur: yang dag gsang ba snying thig 'di: bkra shis khri sgo zhes byar sped: des na lo brgya nyi shu lon:dgongs pa dag la rab tu gnas de tshe rgya gar nub phyogs yul: glang po sgang zhes rgyud rings par: khyim bdag de ni dge ldan las: rab tu rgyu dang rkyen las 'khrungs de ming phyag rgya rgya chen dang : shar phyogasaka ma shī la'i grong : gdol pa shan ting lag pa dang : dge ba'i sems can yum gyi lhums: rgyu dang rkyen las 'khrungs pa yi: de ming dzñā na su tra zhes: de gnyisasbyangs pa'i yon tan rdzogs: de dus rdo rje gdan nyid na paṇa ḍi ta ni lnga brgya bzhugs: de dag rnams las mchog tu mkhas: ye shes mdo dang bye ma lar nub phyogasa'adam bu'i tshal zhes par rdo rje sems dpas lung ston 'gyur seng ha nyid dang zhal 'phrad ste: des kyang dam pa'i don snyen 'gyur yang gsang snying po'i bstan pa 'di dzñā na su tra skal ldan par: de yi slob mar de 'gyur ro: de nasalo ni bcu bdun na: de yang mya ngan 'da' tshul ston: 'byung ba dag ni rang dengasasu: nam mkha' 'od kyis bkang ste 'gro gdung ba dag ni gcad pa'i phyir: bstan pa'i btsas su zhal chems so: skal ba nyid dang rab ldan pa'i ye shes mdo ni bha sing du: mkha' 'gro'i gdung ba gcod par 'gyur: mkha' 'gro ma yi lung bstan nas: mu dra nyid kyang skal ldan 'gyur gnyis kyis lo ni brgya dang gsum: de nas lo lnga'i bar du gnas skal ldan mchog de rang dengs su nam —165—

me tsho shul ba la / klong za rab 'amasakyi gsung lam/(kamakha' 'od snang de bzhin no: gdung ba ba da phyir zhal chems so: phyag rgya rgya chen zhes bya ba'i: mkhas pa mchog de rka rur gnas: de nas dur khrod rab snang du: dgongs laganasashing spyod pa skyong : de dusabho ṭa'i rgyal khamasasu: rgyal po byang chub sems pa'i rigs: sprul pa phyag brnyan ba sapa 'byung : de yi bstan pa'i snying po 'di: bi ma la dang skal ldan par: gyur nas snying pa'i don 'di ni: rab tu gsang zhing 'dzin par 'gyur: mu dra nyid ni rgya nag yul: bhe lasha kra zhes bya bar: de nasasnang ste skye shi bral: 'di nyid mya ngan 'da' ba min:de nas lnga ba rtsa lnga na: de yi phyag brnyan dge sgong gzugs: rang rgyud rnam par dag nasani: bhi la zhi zhes bya ba yi: gtsug lag khang du sted par 'gyur: lo brgya'i bar du der gnas te: de 'og dge slong dad brtsen ldan: de dang 'phrad nasaskal ldan 'gyur: de nas lo ni bco lnga na: yang ni dge spyong gzugasa'adzin pa: skal ldan de la snang bar 'gyur: desani shing ldan ri rgyud la: bstan pa dam pa 'di sped 'gyur: de nasalo ni sum ba na: paṇa ḍi ta ni gnam dum zhes: desani sde gnyisadag la sprod: de nasalo ni brgya byed na: bstan pa yang gsang nges pa yi: don rgyu man ngag gsang tig 'di: sa la gnasapa gcig gisaspyod: de yi rjes 'dzin slob ma ni: lag na rdo rje sprul pa po: 'disani bstan pa dar bar 'gyur: de nas de dag 'dasa'og 1 dge sbyong dag gi ga gas 'dzin pa: lus nag yan lag rags pa yis: bstan pa 'di ni ba nga ba'i tshe: dam chas 'di ni lo brgya sa/'di dag rnamasani nub par 'gyur: de nas yang ni bod yul du: rgyal po dge ba'i semasaldan pa: kha dog dmar po —166—

me po'i shul ba galas/ klong za rab 'amasakyi gsung 'bum/()mkha' 'od snang de bzhin no: gdung ba bcad phyir zhal chems so phyag rgya rgya chen zhes bya ba'i: mkhas pa mchog de ke rur gnas: de nas dur khrod rab snang du dgongs laganasashing spyod pa skyong : de dusasto ṭa'i rgyal khamasasu: rgyal po byang chub sems pa'i rigs: sprul pa phyag brnyan bcasapa 'byung : de yi bstan pa'i snying po 'di: bi ma la dang skal ldan par: gyur nas snying po'i don 'di ni: rab tu gsang zhing 'dzin par 'gyur mu dra nyid ni rgya nag yul ste lasha kra zhes bya bar de nasasnang ste skye shi bral: 'di nyid mya ngan 'da' ba min:de nas lnga bcu rtsa lnga na: de yi phyag b.lo dge slong gzugs rang rgyud rnam par dag nasani bhi la ki zhesabya ba yi: gtsug lag khang du sped par 'gyur lo brgya'i bar du der gnas te: de 'og dge slong dad brtson ldan: de dang rsād nasaskal ldan 'gyur: de nas lo ni bco lnga na: yang ni dge sbyong gzugasa'adzin pa skal ldan de la snang bar 'gyur desani shing ldan ri rgyud la bstan pa dam pa 'di sped 'gyur: de nasalo ni sum bcu na paṇa ḍi ta ni gnam dum zhes: desani sde gnyisadag la sprod: de nasalo ni brgya phyed na bstan pa yang gsang nges pa yi: don rgyu man ngag gsang tig 'di sa la gnasapa gcig gisaspyod: de yi rjes 'dzin slob ma ni: lag na rdo rje sprul pa po: 'disani bstan pa dar bar 'gyur: de nas de dag 'dasa'og zhu dge spyong dag gi gzugs 'dzin pa: lus nag yan lag rags pa yis: bstan pa 'di ni bzung ba'i tshe: dam chos 'di ni lo brgya phu 'di dag rnamasani nub par 'gyur: de nas yang ni bod yul du rgyal po dge ba'i semasaldan pa kha dog dmar po —166—

ga yig can po ti skrug chung skor rnams/gser gyi swo: rigs ldan 'khar g.yog ldan pas ni: bstan pa'i me ro sgong nas ni: mkhas pa lce yi rdzu'akhrul can: zhig gi yi ge'i brda bsgyur te: 'di nyid me lce 'bar ba bzhin: bstan pa'i snying po lo stong du: yi ge yo gi'i ga gas dag gis: rim lasarim gyis 'dzin par 'gyur: de nas lo ni nyisabargya na: yang ni rgyal po bongs chung ba: mgo la ral gri'i mun po 'dzin: 'di dang 'phrad nas mun par 'gyur: de nas dge slong dpal dang ldan: bram ze dag gi rigs mchog gis: kha che'i yul nas 'di rnyed nas: de nyid yul du bstan pa 'di: spang la me mched bzhin du ste: snying po lo brgya'i bar du gnas:de nas lo ni sum cu sa yab ni rgyal po snying stobs can: de dang 'phrad nas mun par 'gyur: de nasanub phyogasa.o rgyan yul: gling dang ldan pa zhes bya bar: mkha' 'gro dpal 'dzin zhes bya bas: rgya mtsho'i gling nas phyung nasani:yang ni bstan pa dar bar byed: de nas rim dang rim gyisani: skal dang ldan pa'i skyesabu ni: don rnams rim pa nyid ldan 'gyur: tshe lo ba pa'i dusadag 1 'disani sgron ma 'bar bar byed: de nas bstan pa'i snying po rnams: nam mkha' dag la 'phar bar 'gyur: bstan pa kun gyi bu ga ga po: 'byung ba'i sgra dang bral ba'i phyirasnye rdo rje gdan nas me ro byed: ces a ti bkod pa chen po 'a ma phrag drug pa las: phyi rabs skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag ji lta bu 'byung ba lung bstan pa bdun pa rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya: de nas nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan dang phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo las 'di dag phyungs te rnam par spros so: nyan cig: dge sbyong rdo rje yang 'dzin pasnye—167—

g.yu yig can po ti skrug chung skor rnams/gser gyi sa: rigs ldan 'khor g.yog ldan pas ni bstan pa'i me ro sgong nas ni mkhas pa lce yi rdzu'aphrul can: zhig gi yi ge'i brda bsgyur te: 'di nyid me lce 'bar ba bzhin: bstan pa'i snying po lo stong du: yi ge yo gi'i gzugs dag gis rim lasarim gyis 'dzin par 'gyur: de nas lo ni nyisabargya na yang ni rgyal po bongs chung ba: mgo la ral gri'i chun po 'dzin 'di dang 'phrad nas mun par 'gyur de nas dge slong dpal dang ldan bram ze dag gi rigs mchog gis: kha che'i yul nas 'di rnyed nas: de nyid yul du bstan pa 'di spang la me mched bzhin du ste snying po lo brgya'i bar du gnas:de nas lo ni sum cu phu yab ni rgyal po snying stobs can: de dang 'phrad nas mun par 'gyur: de nasanub phyogs rgyan yul gling dang ldan pa zhes bya bar: mkha' 'gro dpal 'dzin zhes bya bas: rgya mtsho'i gling nas phyung nasani:yang ni bstan pa dar bar byed: de nas rim dang rim gyisani skal dang ldan pa'i skyesabu ni don rnams rim pa nyid ldan 'gyur tshe lo bcu pa'i dusadag zhu 'disani sgron ma 'bar bar byed: de nas bstan pa'i snying po rnams nam mkha' dag la 'phar bar 'gyur bstan pa kun gyi bu gcig po: 'byung ba'i sgra dang bral ba'i phyir: rdo rje gdan nas me ro byed: ces a ti bkod pa chen po 'bum phrag drug pa las: phyi rabs skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag ji lta bu 'byung ba lung bstan pa bdun pa rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya: de nas nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan dang phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo las 'di dag phyungs te rnam par spros so: nyen cig dge sbyong rdo rje yang 'dzin pa —167—

me po'i shul bzhagal / klong chen rab 'byams rkya gsung 'bum/ (3)'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang : rdo rje theg pa rab gragasapa: khyad par chen po'i chos rnams ni: 'jig rten bkod pa'i zhing khams 'dir bstan pa dag gi gnas mi gnas: ye thog dang po'i sangs rgyas dang : dam pa stong gi dkyil 'khor 'dus de nas bstan pa gnyis pa la: spyi phud 'jig rten mgon zhes pas dam pa stong gis 'di phyag mdzad bstan pa dag ni gsum pa la: tshangasapa stong gi spyi phud mgon: sangasargyas stong gi thugs nyid dril: de nasabastan pa bzhi pa la: nyi ma stong gi rgyal po dang : sangs rgyasastong gis mnga' dbang bskur bstan pa nyid ni lnga pa la 'jig rten dra ba mgon zhesapa'i dam pa stong gi thugs la sbas bstan pa drug gi sangs rgyas ni: 'od zer stong gi mu khyud mgon rigs can stong gis 'di nyid sbas: de nas bstan pa bdun pa la:ye khyab 'khor 'jig tshangs pa'i mgon bde chen stong gi spyi bor bzung : de ltar de ltar bstan pa ni: 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi rtsa sangs rgyas grangasani de nyid kyis gsang chen 'di ni yongs bzung pa'o: bstan pa'i sangs rgyas nges pa yi: sa ya phrag ni bcu dgu yis: 'di nyid phyag mdzad bcud dril pa'o:de phyir bstan pa'i sa bon ni: nges pa'i snying po zhes bya ba: bstan pa kun gyi bu gcig pu: 'byung ba lnga yi dgra dang bral: rang byung ngag gi yi ge ni gang gi rkyen gyis 'jig pa med: nyi ma spungs pa'i sgron ma 'dis: sangs rgyasakun gyi sa bon 'debs ston pa dag ni re re 'o: bstan pa dag ni nub pa'i tshe: 'di ni ston pa gang 'byung ba'i sngon du lo brgya'i dang po la 'byung ste sku gsung thugasakyi rgyud 'di nyid lasani 'phro bar 'gyur: 'di nyid gang gi bzung ba de bzo —/68—

me po'i shul ba la / klong chen rab 'byams kya gsung 'bum/ ()'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang : rdo rje theg pa rab gragasapaḥ khyad par chen pa'i chas rnams ni: 'jig rten bkod pa'i zhing khams 'dir: bstan pa dag gi gnas mi gnas: ye thog dang pa' sangs rgyas dang : dam pa stong gi dkyil 'khar 'dus: de nas bstan pa gnyis pa la: spyi phud 'jig rten mgon zhes pas: dam pa stong gis 'di phyag mdzad: bstan pa dag ni gsum pa la: tshangasapa stong gi spyo kud mgon: sangasargyas stong gi thugs nyid dril: de nasabastan pa bzhi pa la: nyi ma stong gi rgyal po dang : sangs rgyasastong gis mnga' dbang bskur: bstan pa nyid ni lnga pa la: 'jig rten dra ba mgon zhesapa'i: dam pa stong gi thugs la sbas: bstan pa drug gi sangs rgyas ni: 'od zer stong gi mu khyud mgon: rigs can stong gis 'di nyid sbas: de nas bstan pa bdun pa la:ye khyab zhabar 'jig tshangs pa'i mgon: bde chen stong gi spyo bor bzung : de ltar de ltar bstan pa ni: 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi rtsa sangs rgyas grangasani de nyid kyis: gsang chen 'di ni yongs bzung pa'o: bstan pa'i sangs rgyas nges pa yi: sa ya phrag ni ba dgu yis: 'di nyid phyag mdzad bcud dril pa'o:de phyir bstan pa'i sa bon ni: nges pa'i snying po zhes bya ba: bstan pa kun gyi bu gaXg pu: 'byung ba lnga yi dgra dang bral: rang byung ngag gi yi ge ni: gang gi rkyen gyis 'jig pa med: nyi ma spungs pa'i sgon ma 'dis: sangs rgyasakun kyi sa bon 'debs: ston pa dag ni re re 'o: bstan pa dag ni nub pa'i tshe: 'di ni ston pa gang 'byung ba'i: sngon du lo brgya'i dang po la: 'byung ste sku gsung thugasakyi rgyud: 'di nyid lasani 'phro bar 'gyur: 'di nyid gang gi bzung ba de: bzo —/68—

g.yu yig can po ti sbug chung skor rnams/dang sgyu rtsal thams cad dang : bstan bcas kun dang sgra rnams ni: ji ltar 'dod bzhin shes par 'gyur: gsang mchag bla na med pa de: mchad dang bstod dbang bskur byas na: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams: ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du 'byung : 'di nyid bcangs pa tsam gyis ni: lung dang man ngag 'dzin par 'gyur: 'jig rten mun sel nor bu'i 'od: snang ba byed pa'i sgron ma 'di: gang la snang bar 'gyur ba de: de ni 'byung ba rang dengasasu: skal ldan 'gyur bar the tshom med: ces a ti bkod pa chen po 'bum phrag drug pa las:bstan pa'i snying po 'byung khungs bstan pa ste brgyad pa rdzogs soḥ rgya rgya rgya:de nas yang nyid kyi sku gsung thugs las 'di dag byung ngo : kye kye nyan cig rigs ldan shā ri'i bu: bstan pa'i dam pa rgya che rab bkod las: mchag tu snying po yang nas yang bsdus pa: gser gyi snying po nyi mas snang byed 'di: thun mong 'tshol bar dar ba ma yin te: gsang chen rigs dang ldan pa 'ga' la 'byung : snyigs ma rtsod ldan nyon mongs rags pa'i dus: sde pa nang 'thab dben gnas kun kyang 'jig: rgyal khrims mi gnas rang dga' 'dod rgyal spyod: pha dang bu 'thab mtshon gyis lus rnams bsrung : bsagasapa'i tshogs yal sayi bas rnams zad: mi mthun lta spyod dag kyang grangs mang 'byung :snyigs ma lnga brgya tshe lo rim gyis bri: bsod nams skal chung tshe lo drug cu'i tshe:snying po 'di ni lo ni drug can gnas: de nas 'og tu lo brgya'i bar du ni: rtog ge daphyod cing gsang ba 'di mi gnas: de 'das 'og tu lo stong nyid du yang snyethos bsam bral ba'i gang zag yal nas ni: gsang ba mchog 'di nyi ma bzhin —/69—

galu yig can po ti spug chung skor rnams/dang sgyu rtsal thams cad dang : bstan bcos kun dang sgra rnams ni ji ltar 'dod bzhin shes par 'gyur gsang mchog bla na med pa de mchod dang bstod dbang bskur byas na mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams: ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du 'byung : 'di nyid bcangs pa tsam gyis ni: lung dang man ngag 'dzin par 'gyur 'jig rten mun sel nor bu'i 'od snang ba byed pa'i sgron ma 'di gang la snang bar 'gyur ba de de ni 'byung ba rang dengasasu skal ldan 'gyur bar the tshom med ces a ti bkod pa chen po 'bum phrag drug pa las:bstan pa'i snying po 'byung khungs bstan pa ste brgyad pa rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya:de nas yang nyid kyi sku gsung thugs las 'di dag byung ngo : kye kye nyen cig rigs ldan shā ri'i bu: bstan pa'i dam pa rgya che rab bkod las mchog tu snying po yang nas yang bsdus pa: gser gyi snying po nyi mas snang byed 'di: thun mong 'tshol bar dar ba ma yin te: gsang chen rigs dang ldan pa 'ga' la 'byung : snyigs ma rtsod ldan nyon mongs rags pa'i dus sde pa nang 'thab dben gnas kun kyang 'jig: rgyal khrims mi gnas rang dga' 'dod rgyal spyod: pha dang bu 'thab mtshon gyis lus rnams bsrung : bsagasapa'i tshogs yal sayi bcud rnams zad: mi mthun lta spyod dag kyang grangs mang 'byung :snyigs ma lnga brgya tshe lo rim gyis bri bsod nams skal chung tshe lo drug cu'i tshe:snying po 'di ni lo ni drug cur gnas: de nas 'og tu lo brgya'i bar du ni rtog ge dpyod cing gsang ba 'di mi gnas: de 'das 'og tu lo stong nyid du yang :thos bsam bral ba'i gang zag yal nas ni gsang ba mchog 'di nyi ma bzhin —/69—

mesapa'i shulabs la / klong ོ rab gomasakyi gsung khrum/()du 'gyur: de 'dasa'og tu nyis brgya mun par 'gyur: de nas tshe lo dag ni bzhi bcu na: snying po 'di ni lo brgya'i bar du gnas: de 'das sum cu'i bar du mun pa 'gyur: de'i 'og lo brgya'i bar du gnasapa la: de 'das tshe lo sum cu'i dus na 'di: nub nas rgyang 'phen lo brgya'i bar du dar: de nasayang ni lo bas bar du gnas: tshe lo nyi shu pa la 'di mi 'byung snye bcu pa'i dusasu snying po 'di 'byung bas: 'di dang gang 'phrad 'byung ba rang dengs 'gyur: de nasayal te mi snang bstan pa'i btsas: yang ni bstan pa'i me ro bshin du 'gyur: zhesabakod pa chen po 'bum phrag drug pa las: bstan pa dam pa'i 'pheb 'asprib ji ltar 'byung ba ste: zhus don dgu pa rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya:de nas yang sku'i 'od zer rnam par spros te 'di skad ces rngams par bsgrags so: nyon cig rigasaldan dge spyong dpal: nga ni 'di nasami gnas nas: tshe lo drug cu yan chad la: 'brasabu grol ba stong phrag gcig: 'byung bar rang dengs dag tu ste: dge sbyong gzugasani de yi byed: lhag ma byang chub sems dpa'o: de nasalnga ba la thug par: 'byung bar rang sar dengasapa ni:'bum phrag gnyis kyisaskye med thob: phal cher bud med dag gi gzugs:skyes pa dag ni stong phrag gnyis: de nasatshe lo sum cu'i bar: 'bum phrag dag ni drug pa ste: 'di dag phal cher skyesapa la: bud med gzugs ni 'bum gcig yin: 'byung ba dag ni rang dengs so: de dag sngon byung nga yi 'khor:snyigs ma'i dus na sangasargyas thob: nges gsang snying po yang bsdus pa'i:'bras bu nyid ni thob pa las: bstan pa gzhan gyi 'brasabu med: gal te —170—

me po'i shulabazhag la / klong chen rab 'byam kyi gsung 'bum/()du 'gyur de 'dasa'og tu nyis brgya mun par 'gyur: de nas tshe lo dag ni bzhi bcu na: snying po 'di ni lo brgya'i bar du gnas: de 'das sum cu'i bar du mun pa 'gyur de'i 'og lo brgya'i bar du gnasapa la de 'das tshe lo sum cu'i dus na 'di nub nas rgyang 'phen lo brgya'i bar du dar: de nasayang ni lo bcu'i bar du gnas: tshe lo nyi shu pa la 'di mi 'byung : bcu pa'i dusasu snying po 'di 'byung bas 'di dang gang 'phrad 'byung ba rang dengs 'gyur: de nasayal te mi snang bstan pa'i btsas yang ni bstan pa'i me ro bzhin du 'gyur zhesabakod pa chen po 'bum phrag drug pa las bstan pa dam pa'i 'pheb 'grib ji ltar 'byung ba ste: zhus don dgu pa rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya:de nas yang sku'i 'od zer rnam par spros te 'di skad ces rngams par bsgrags so nyon cig rigasaldan dge sbyong dpal nga ni 'di nasami gnas nas: tshe lo drug cu yan chad la 'brasabu grol ba stong phrag gcig: 'byung bar rang dengs dag tu ste: dge sbyong gzugasani de yi byed: lhag ma byang chub sems dpa'o: de nasalnga bcu la thug par 'byung bar rang sar dengasapa ni:'bum phrag gnyis kyisaskye med thob: phal cher bud med dag gi gzugs skyes pa dag ni stong phrag gnyis: de nasatshe lo sum cu'i bar 'bum phrag dag ni drug pa ste 'di dag phal cher skyesapa la bud med gzugs ni 'bum gcig yin: 'byung ba dag ni rang dengs so: de dag sngon byung nga yi 'khor:snyigs ma'i dus na sangasargyas thob nges gsang snying po yang bsdus pa'i 'bras bu nyid ni thob pa las bstan pa gzhan gyi 'brasabu med: gal te —170—

gakuyig can po ti ཿga chung skor rnams/bstan pa gzhan dag la: mngon par sangs rgyas 'pha 'dod na: 'di nyid phrad de de bzhin no: de phyir 'bras bu'i dus ka sa 'di nyid dag ni bstan pa 'o:zhes bkod pa chen po 'bum phrag drug pa las: nges pa'i 'bras bu thob pa 'byung ba rang dengs su song ba'i grangs lung bstan pa ste ba pa rdzogs so: rgya rgyargya:de nas yang nyid kyi thugs kyi dal nas mgur gyi bum par dril:ljags kyi dbang po la bkram nas ched du brjod pa 'di dag brjod do: e ma gsang ba'i gsang mchag nges pa'i snying po 'dis: 'khar bar brgyud pa'i bag chags kun ba da nas: ye shesamadzod kyi snang ba rab bstan te: snyigs ma'i yang snyigs tshe lo sum cu la: le los g.yengs nas de 'das 'og tu ni: skye gnyis bar du mngon par sangs rgyas pa: tshe lo ba pa'i bar chad 'di rnams 'byung : stong phrag bdun ni snang ba ma dang phrad: skyes pa dag ni stong phrag drug nyid la: bud med gzugs ni stong phrag gcig yin no: de ltar skye dang bud med khyi dang mo: ji ltar gyur pa'i ga gsasu 'dug khyang sla'i: 'di dang phrad par rnam par grol ba'o: gzhan gyi rigasalas phrad yang 'di nyid du: des na gsang mchag nges pa'i snying po 'di: g.yin gyi yul min skal ldan shugs kyis phrad:bde gsal snying pa'i don du bkod pa'o: zhes bkod pa chen po 'a ma phrag drug pa las: skye gnyis mtshams su sangs rgyas pa 'byung bar lung bstan pa ste ba gcig pa rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya: kede nas yang ting nge 'dzin seng ge rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba las bzhengs —17/—

gabuyig can po ti skrug chung skor rnams/bstan pa gzhan dag la: mngon par sangs rgyas 'byung 'dod na: 'di nyid phrad de de bzhin no: de phyir 'bras bu'i dus ga rtsa 'di nyid dag ni bstan pa 'o:zhes bkod pa chen po 'bum phrag drug pa las nges pa'i 'bras bu thob pa 'byung ba rang dengs su song ba'i grangs lung bstan pa ste bcu pa rdzogs so: rgya (1 dres:de nas yang nyid kyi thugs kyi dal nas mgur gyi bum par dril:ljags kyi dbang po la bkram nas ched du brjod pa 'di dag brjod do: e ma gsang ba'i gsang mchog nges pa'i snying po 'dis: 'khor bar brgyud pa'i bag chags kun bcad nas: ye shesamadzod kyi snang ba rab bstan te: snyigs ma'i yang snyigs tshe lo sum cu la: le los g.yengs nas de 'das 'og tu ni skye gnyis bar du mngon par sangs rgyas pa tshe lo bcu pa'i bar chad 'di rnams 'byung : stong phrag bdun ni snang ba ma dang phrad skyes pa dag ni stong phrag drug nyid la bud med gzugs ni stong phrag gcig yin no: de ltar skye dang bud med khyi dang mo ji ltar gyur pa'i gzugasasu 'dug kyang sla'i 'di dang phrad par rnam par grol ba'o: gzhan gyi rigasalas phrad yang 'di nyid du: des na gsang mchog nges pa'i snying po 'di gzhan gyi yul min skal ldan shugs kyis phrad:bde gsal snying po'i don du bkod pa'o: zhes bkod pa chen po 'bum phrag drug pa las skye gnyis mtshams su sangs rgyas pa 'byung bar lung bstan pa ste bcu gcig pa rdzogs so rgya rgya rgya: de nas yang ting nge 'dzin seng ge rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba las bzhengs —17/—

me po'i shul ba las/ slong 'a rab 'grumasakyigasung 'tsho/(3)nas: yang ched du brjod pa 'di sang snyilorna ngabadag rnam par brjod do: snyigasam lnga brgya mirsāg calodusha dusakyi tha ma la: gsang ba'i snying po ྾'di ni mi yul snang : de rjes 'dzin pa'i gang zag skal ba can: snying po 'di ni su la snang gyur pa: de dag rnams ni mi 'gyur sa la yan la 'da': gal te snyigs mar tshe thung nad mang bas: snying pa'i don 'di golkopa sa bsagading du ma gyur kyang : 'di nyid kyi ngosbyod mthong bas spyorabol dbugasachen nyid 'byin pa:ba gcig pharosachaboltaran kun tu 'od ste sprul pa'i zhing : brdzusaskyes dag pasamangal gyi rgya dang bral: shar phyogs mngan dga' mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zhing : mi bskyod ston pas 'khar gyi chas 'dibs pa rgyud grol: gdul bya rang snang yon tan bsam mi khyab ste sto dpal ldan dang nungapadma brtsegs pa dang : byapalas rab nyid ni yongs su rdzogs pa'i zhing : rin chen 'byung dang padma gar dbang rta: ston pa'i bstan pa wor masashesabya'i sgrib pa sbyong : shar dkar lhoser nubadamar dang byang ljang khu'i kha dog gsal: mthodag khopa khod snyoms yid 'ong ri sgeg dku bya skad sna tshogs sgogs: dri bsung ngad 'jam lta bsachog mi shes:dbang po tshim byed yon to kun dang ldanasnye kha dog lus rdzogs zas gosadusagacig rdzogs: lus kyi rtsol bral la kyi rlang gisabaskyod3lir snapala'agro dang 'dug: rlung 'a ba ma dpa'isad kyi mkhrisabad kan 'dusapa'i nad rnamasapred:yan lag brgyad ldan ro brgya 'dus pa'i chu: 'thungasapasalus྾ tshim byed reg na lus kyang 'jam: sa chu me long 'byung bsaphan gnod bral: yid la'adod shā bkresadang skom dang tsha grang sdug bsngal med: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug —/72—

me tsho shul ba ga las/ klo pho ba bam kyilasu 'bum/()nas:yang go du brjod pa 'di gang snyiporna bdag rnam par brjod do:snyigasam lnga brgya tshersāg cuyodusha dusakyi tha ma la:gsang ba'i snying po mo'adi ni mi yul snang :de rjes 'dzin pa'i gang zag skal ba can snying po 'di ni su la snang gyur pa de dag rnams ni mi 'gyur sa la ྾ 4'da' gal te tsa ri //sde/ zhe rdo ma 'ilag tsho 2 ri (15snyags mar thung nad mang bas snyang pa dan 'ad go4 ca bsagadang du ma gyur kyang :'di nyid rkya ngos mthong bas spyobal dbugasaryā nyid chun pa:bstokheg parogamipoltaran kun tu 'od ste sprul pa'i snyo :brdzusaskyes dag pasamangal gyi rgya dang bral:shar phyogs mja dga' mi lur rdo rje'i go :mi bskyod ston pas spyor gyi mo 'dishka rgyud grol:gdul bya rang snang yon tan bsam mi khyab ste lho dpal ldan dang nungapadma brtsegs pa dang :byangalas rab nyid ni yongs su rdzogs pa'i snyo :rin go ཿnga dang padma gar dbang rta ston pa'i bstan pa lor ྾shesabya'i sgrib pa sbyong :shar dkar lhoser nubadamar dang bya ljang khu'i kha dog ga4 mthodapha gob khod snyoms yid 'ong ri skeg rga bya skad sna tshogs sgogs:dri bsung ngad 'jam lta bsachog mi shes dbang po tshim byed yon to kun dang ldan:kha dog lus rdzogs zas gosadusaspyog rdzogs lus kyi rtsol bral la kyi po gsabaskyod3lir snapala'agro dang 'dug:rlung rga ba gtsopa'iwa kyisomakhrisabad gan 'dusapa'i nad rnamasamed yan lag brgyad ldan ro brgya khus pa'i chu khrungasapasalusaryā ma byed reg na lus kyang 'jam:sa chu me long lung bsaphan gnod bral yi ba' tha bkresadang skom dang tsha grang sdug bsngal med:'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug

g.yuyag can she skrug /de sko rngams/nyon mongs rnams:skye ba'i rgyu med shes pa bag yangs so:blta rgod lag bcangs gnyis /ded 'dod gos med:chog shes sred bral rtag tu /de la /de /de /de spyo /de/de /de /de /de/de/de: ba gnyas bral nas ba ga thags:ma/de pa lha mas yad 'ong bkra shis brjod:gzhal yasakhang mdzes sgo bzhi rta babs ldan:shel ka dang gser se dang mar gad mar /deṇḍanai la sngo:bkra shisaphyogayasnyogadugasadang spyor lo rgyal mo mdzes:de ltar phyogs ཿ rang bzhi sprul pa'i snyo :rang rang ston pas rang rang spyor rgyud 'grol:mdun gyi nam mkha' mi hphud rtsegs pa na:'jigs pa'i khro gnas dur khrod me ri 'bar:'jigs pa'i sgra hūṃ pha/deng khro /degasa.a la la:'di nyid mthong ba tsam gyi grol lngar:skal ldan /debastobasamed snying tsho don ྾na pa:der /de /de wo ni dbugs phyung skye ba /deg pa ste:lnga brgya dag na ngesapa'i sar grol lo:spyo bkod pa ོ po khrum tsho drug gi bdag nyid las rmongs pa'i gdung ba rnam par bsal ba brgyud pa gsum du gtso la phab pa ste:shā ri'i bu skar ma 'od bzang gis ston pa 'od srungs nyid la 0 pa'i lan gyi le'u ste ཿ gnyis pa rdzogs sosnyerdo rje legs pa mgon po gres thag can:bka' 'di gto do khyod kyis bya ra gyis sa ma yā:rgya rgya rgya:gawa yang :bkod pa ོ po /dem tsho drug pa las:lus dang 'dra ba'i le 'u stong phrag bzhi:brjod bya ma/de tu zab cing rgya che yang :sum brgya gsang ba'i le 'u 'di med na:gzugs kyi phung po snying med ro dang 'dra:des na snying dang 'dra ba'i le 'u 'di:'jam dpal /desagarṣa bdag gis phyung :nam

g.yupag can she spug chung sko rnams/nyon mongs rnams:skye ba'i rgyu med shes pa bag yangs so:blta rgod lag bcangs gnyis ཿda 'dod sas med:chog shes sred bral rtag tu mo la wa sgrib gnyis bral nasaskye ba kheg gi thogs:marga pa'i lha mos yid 'ong bkra shis brjod:gzhal yasakhang mdzes sgo bzhi rta babs ldan shel sa dang gser se dang mar gad mar lngasaṇḍani la sngo:bkra shisaphyogab྾gdugasadang spyor lo rgyal mo mdzes:de ltar phyogs rsā rang bgo sprul pa'i snyo :rang rang ston pas rang rang spyor rgyud 'grol:mdun gyi nam mkha' mi spyod rtsegs pa na 'jigs pa'i khro gnas dur khrod me ri 'bar:'jigs pa'i sgra / pha' dang khro gzugasa.a la la:'di nyid mthong ba tsam gyi grol khrur:skal ldan yisabastobasamed snying tsho don lon pa:der bsgo para'i go ni dbugs phyung skye ba gcig pa ste:lnga brgya dag na ngesapa'i sar grol lo kho bkod pa go po khrum tsho drug gi bdag nyid las rmongs pa'i gdung ba rnam par bsal ba brgyud pa gsum du ga༅ la phab pa ste:shā ri'i bu skar ma lag rwa /// mag ma mag ra tsa ri /sde/ sgyu gzhe pe /ste/ sgyu ri'ad bzang sa stan pa 'ad srungs nyad la zhus pa lan gya 'u bcu gnyas pa rdzogs so:rdo rje legs pa mgon po gres thag can bka' 'di gto do khyod kyis bya ra gyis:sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya:gawa yang :bkod pa rsā po 'bum tsho drug pa las lus dang 'dra ba'i le 'u stong phrag bzhi brjod bya mchog tu zab cing rgya che yang :sum brgya gsang ba'i le 'u 'di med na gzugs kyi phung po snying med ro dang 'dra:des na snying dang 'dra ba'i le 'u 'di 'jam dpal gsagarsā bdag gis phyung :nam

me bo'i shul bsalas/ klong ོ rab 'byam kyi gsung lam/()zhig snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus: tshe lo nyid ni drug cu la: bstan pa'i btsas su 'di nyid ni: skal ldan de dang phrad par shogaḥ rgya rgya rgya:rgya gar nub phyogs glang po sgang gi grong : 'bum tsho'i grangs las khyad par bdag gi blo nyid sbyangs: skad dang yi ge ma mthun grangs mang bdag gi blo la snang : de yi phyir na sgra dang bstan bcos tshad ma kun la mkhas: rgyud lung man ngag mang po blo sbyangasakyang : snying po yang bsdus gsang mchog 'di med na:bdag blos mthong ba'i don med brag ca'i sgra la spyod: dam pa'i rgyud pa rnams kyi rtsa ba nges shes can: bha sing nagasasu bdag gi blo yi mun pa kun bsal nas: de nasadur khrod chen po rab tu snang byed du: thig le mchog gi rgyud lung man ngag rnams: dpe gsum nyid du bdag gis brisapa las: dpe gciga.o rgyan yul gyi rgya mtsho'i gling la sbas: dpe ga ga kha che'i yul gyi mtha' 'khob rigasangan dag gi yul: gser gyi gling zhesamakha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas: phyi rabasabastan pa'i btsas su dgos srid nas: rang rgyasabatang ste mkha' 'gro rnams la gtad: dpe gcig bod kyi rgyal pa'i bka' nan rab che bas: bod yul dbus kyi bsam yas sgra bsgyur gling : mtshan mo tho rangs skal ldan ska cog gnyis: smra byed lce la dbang thob gnyisakyisaphal cher bsgyur: rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga gnyags kyis sngon du bsgyur: de dag skal ldan rje blon gnyis la gtad: de nas mchimasaphu brag dmar dge gong du: rgya yi dpe lasabod kyi yi ge sagasang ba'i man ngag 'di ni bdag gis bsgyur: ra gan sbyangs pa'i byang bu lnga ba la: dkar ngo dung bzhus yi ger btang ste bsgyur yang ni ra gan sbyangs—174—

me bo'i shul ba galas/ klong chen rab 'byam kyi gsung 'bum/(3)zhig snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus tshe lo nyid ni drug cu la bstan pa'i btsas su 'di nyid ni: skal ldan de dang phrad par shog: rgya rgya rgya:rgya gar nub phyogs glang po sgang gi grong : 'bum tsho'i grangs las khyad par bdag gi blo nyid sbyangs: skad dang yi ge ma mthun grangs mang bdag gi blo la snang : de yi phyir na sgra dang bstan bcos tshad ma kun la mkhas rgyud lung man ngag mang po blo sbyangasakyang : snying po yang bsdus gsang mchog 'di med na:bdag blos mthong ba'i don med brag ca'i sgra la spyod: dam pa'i rgyud pa rnams kyi rtsa ba nges shes can bha sing nagasasu bdag gi blo yi mun pa kun bsal nas: de nasadur khrod chen po rab tu snang byed du thig le mchog gi rgyud lung man ngag rnams: dpe gsum nyid du bdag gis brisapa las: dpe gcigaso rgyan yul gyi rgya mtsho'i gling la sbas dpe gcig kha che'i yul gyi mtha' 'khob rigasangan dag gi yul: gser gyi gling ceXgamakha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas: phyi rabasabastan pa'i btsas su dgos srid nas rang rgyasabatab ste mkha' 'gro rnams la gtad: dpe gcig bod kyi rgyal po'i bka' nan rab che bas: bod yul dbus kyi bsam yas sgra bsgyur gling : mtshan mo tho rangs skal ldan ska cog gnyis: smra byed lce la dbang thob gnyisakyisaphal cher bsgyur: rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga gnyags kyis sngon du bsgyur: de dag skal ldan rje blon gnyis la gtad: de nas mchimasaphu brag dmar dge gong du rgya yi dpe lasabod kyi yi ge rtsagasang ba'i man ngag 'di ni bdag gis bsgyur ra gan sbyangs pa'i byang bu lnga bcu la: dkar ngo/ dung bzhus yi ger btab ste bsgyur: yang ni ra gan sbyangs—174

gartsayig can po ti sgrug chung skor rnams/pa'i byang bu drug cu lnga: zangs bzhus yi ger btang ste bsgyur ba'i pu ti gcig:dmar po zangs byang byang bu brgya dang sum cu la: sngon po g.yu sbyangs yi ge btang te bsgyur ba'i po ti gcig: chu dar bsgrigs pa'i sdeb ma nyi shu la: phra men yi ge sngo dmar btang ste bsgyur ba'i po ti gcig: rgya yi dpe las 'di dag bsgyur nas ni: su la'ang ma bstan bstan pa'i btsas su bzhag: rgya gar yul du slar log bdag mi 'gro: rgya nag ri ba'i rtse la sdod snyam nas: bdag gis ma khyer lam la gdug rtsub pas: bdag gi don snying phyung nasa'adi ru sbas: dam pa bstan pa'i bdag pos 'di rnyed shog: yi ge mi mthun brgya dang drug cu las:gsang ba'i rgyud lung man ngag yi ge rnams: nā ga ra yi yi ger bkod nas ni:'di nas byang shar 'dom tshad nyi shu'i bar: pha 'ong dmar po stag nyal 'dra ba'i 'og: yi ge a yi mtshan ma btang nas ni lcags kyi sgom bur ba ga nas sbas te yod: snyigs ma'am dusan gsang ba'i rgyud lung rnams: stong 'dusa'o ma bzhin du bslad nasani: bod kyi rgyal khamasa'adi yis khengs pa'i tshe: 'di nyid longs la rgya la goms pas bsgyur: lhag dang chad pa rnams ni 'di yis bskangs: 'di las lhag pa gzhan la gcig kyang med: desani bstan pa'i sgon me byasanasani: 'di nyid spyod pa'i skal ldan du ma 'byung : bstan pa'i dam pa yang nas yang bsdus snying po 'di: rang gi snying la phur la gzhan la bstan pa min: 'jig rten yid dga' sgyu ma'i nor gyi phyir: nga yi dpral mig khong snying 'di btang na: snying khrag 'dzag cing mi 'brasathang la lhung : de bsarang gi snying la rgyasagadab la: rig pa goms pas gnad du 'di phur zhig: mgon po nag 175—

gcayig can po ti spug chung skor rnams/pa'i byang bu drug cu lnga zangs bzhus yi ger btab ste bsgyur ba'i pu ti gcig:dmar po zangs byang byang bu brgya dang sum cu la sngon po g.yu sbyangs yi ge btab te bsgyur ba'i po ti gcig chu dar bsgrigs pa'i ldeb ma nyi shu la: phra men yi ge sngo dmar btab ste bsgyur ba'i po ti gcig: rgya yi dpe las 'di dag bsgyur nas ni su la'ang ma bstan bstan pa'i btsas su bzhag: rgya gar yul du slar log bdag mi 'gro: rgya nag ri bo'i rtse la sdod snyam nas: bdag gis ma khyer lam la gdug rtsub pas bdag gi don snying phyung nasa'adi ru sbas: dam pa bstan pa'i bdag pos 'di rnyed shog yi ge mi mthun brgya dang drug cu las:gsang ba'i rgyud lung man ngag yi ge rnams: nā ga ra yi yi ger bkod nas ni:'di nas byang shar 'dom tshad nyi shu'i bar: pha 'ong dmar po stag nyal 'dra ba'i 'og yi ge a yi mtshan ma btab nas ni lcags kyi sgrom bur bcug nas sbas te yod: snyigs ma'am dusan gsang ba'i rgyud lung rnams: tshong 'dusa'o ma bzhin du bslad nasani: bod kyi rgyal khamasa'adi yis khengs pa'i tshe 'di nyid longs la rgya la goms pas bsgyur lhag dang chad pa rnams ni 'di yis bskangs: 'di las lhag pa gzhan la gcig kyang med: desani bstan pa'i sgron me byasanasani: 'di nyid spyod pa'i skal ldan du ma 'byung : bstan pa'i dam pa yang nas yang bsdus snying po 'di: rang gi snying la phur la gzhan la bstan pa min: 'jig rten yid dga' sgyu ma'i nor gyi phyir: nga yi dpral mig khong snying 'di btang na snying khrag 'dzag cing mi 'brasathang la lhung : de bsarang gi snying la rgyasagadab la rig pa goms pas gnad du 'di phur zhig: mgon po nag —175—

mesapo'i shulabazhag la / 1nga za rab stimasakyi gsung 'bum/()po masaskyong srung ma khyod: bka' 'di gto do khyod kyis thub par srungs: skal ldan man ngag bdag po byung ba'i tshe: khyod kyis zhen pa thongs la 'di byin cig:ban dgra dam med dag gis 'di khyer na: tshe la bar chad gyis la 'gyur ba'i sgog dbugs chod: rgya rgya rgya:bdag gi blo la 'khrul pa'i snang ba rang dag kyang : man ngag 'di la 1 ni breng chagasanas: rgya nag yul du khyer te 'gro snyam pas: lam du bstan pa'i sgod med gdug cor mon pa dang snye tshal dang gdug pa'i gcan gzan chu chen dang : 'jigs pa'i rong khung dmigasapa'i lam ma byang : brag dang chu 'thab 'jigs pa'i shing nags khrod: 'di dag rnams su 'di nyid brlag dogs nas:rang rgyas btang ste bstan pa'i btsas su bzhag: de ltar lam na gdug rtsub grangs mang yang : bdag rang gcig pur sdusa'akhrul thabs kyis 'a11: skal ldan snying gi bu dang 'phrad par spron: rgya rgya rgya: dad ldan rnams kyi snyingagi dkyil du zhag: 'di lasalhag pa'i bzhag thabasagazhan na yod re kan: bdag ni thos chung rtog ge ma yin pas: theg pa spyi yi don rnamasabadag gisashes: de yi phyir na thabs 'di snying gi bu: yang mdzod dmar pa'i nang du rgyasathob la: rang gi yid la brnag cing zhe dga'i yid kyisa'agrogs: 'phangs pa'i nor bzhin ser snas dam du zung : de ltar byasan dngos grub cig car thob: paṇḍita chen po bi ma la mi tras bsgyur ba rdzogasaso:3) rgya rgya rgya: ma yig rin po che gdung pa ṣṭhad pa'o: dge'osnye—176—

me bo'i shulabazhag la / klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/()po chosaskyong srung ma khyod bka' 'di gtad do khyod kyis thub par srungs skal ldan man ngag bdag po byung ba'i tshe: khyod kyis zhen pa thongs la 'di byin cig ban dgra dam med dag gis 'di khyer na: tshe la bar chod gyis la 'gyur ba'i srog dbugs chod rgya rgya rgya:bdag gi blo la 'khrul pa'i snang ba rang dag kyang : man ngag 'di la blo ni breng chagasanas rgya nag yul du khyer te 'gro snyam pas lam du bstan pa'i snod med gdug cor mon pa dang : tshal dang gdug pa'i gcan gzan chu chen dang : 'jigs pa'i rong khung dmigasapa'i lam ma byang : brag dang chu 'thab 'jigs pa'i shing nags khrod 'di dag rnams su 'di nyid brlag dogs nas:rang rgyas btab ste bstan pa'i btsas su bzhag: de ltar lam na gdug rtsub grangs mang yang : bdag rang gcig pur rjasa'aXsal thabs kyis 'gro skal ldan snying gi bu dang 'phrad par smon: rgya rgya rgya: dad ldan rnams kyi snyingagi dkyil du shog: 'di lasalhag pa'i bzhag thabasagazhan na yod re gan: bdag ni thos chung rtog ge ma yin pas theg pa spyi yi don rnamasabadag gisashes: de yi phyir na thabs 'di snying gi bu: yang mdzod dmar po'i nang du rgyasathob la: rang gi yid la brnag cing zhe dga'i yid kyisa'agrogs 'phangs pa'i nor bzhin ser snas dam du zung : de ltar byasan dngos grub cig car thob: paṇḍita chen po bi ma la mi tras bsgyur ba rdzogasaso:3) rgya rgya rgya: ma yig rin po che gdung pa bcad pa'o: dge'o:—176—

g.yu yig can po ti spug chung skor rnams/༄7/ /bu yig rin po che gser gyi sgom bu:rgya gar skad du: satwa rna ki gu phu bod skad du semasakyi gnad bstan pa rang sangs rdzogasapa bde ba la phyag 'tshal lo: gang zhig glang chen smyos 'dra'i sems mi rtog bde ba'i lcagasakyusani: de nyid 'dzin par su 'dod pa:mi rtog chen po rnal du phebs: gnas pa sems nyid kyi rgyan du bkod pa dang :gzhag pa sems kyi ra bar gzhug pa dang : 'phro ba sems kyi rol par shar ba'o:3) gang zhig dur khrod wa yi sems: rtogs sangs chen po'i gal gyisani: de nyid 'dzin par su 'dod pa rgyu med 'brasamed rnal du phebs byung khungs 'gag pa sems kyi gnas btsal ba dang : gnad gzir bas semasakyi rta bsad pa rtag bcag pas sems ro mchog ji ltar 'dug bstan pa'o: gang zhig zo chu lta bu'i sems: 'khrul pa rang dengasatho ba yis: 'di nyid 'joms par su 'dod pa: 'khrul 'khor rang ldan rnal du phebs: ltos pa zad par byas pas sems kyi grangs zad pa dang : 'gro 'ong la brtags pas sems ngos bzung ba dang : de nyid bzlog pas sems lam du bor ba'o: snyi:gang zhig nam mkha' lta bu'i sems ngo bo gcig pa'i phyags shing gis:de nyid sdud par su 'dod pa chos sku gcig par rnal du phebs: sgo 'gagasapas sems kyi byung tshor stongs pa dang : yul phyung bas sems kyi rten stongs pa dang : rgya bskyed pasasems nyid dbus su dril ba'o: gang zhig sems la dga' —177—

ga yig can po to skrug chung skor rnams/ra / /bu yig rin po che gser gyi sgom bu:rgya gar skad du: satwa rna gi gu sa bod skad du: semasakyi gnad bstan pa: rang sangs rdzogasapa bde ba la phyag 'tshal lo: gang zhig glang chen spyos 'dra'i sems: mi rtog bde ba'i lcagasakyusani: de nyid 'dzin par su 'dod pa:mi rtog chen po rnal du phebs: gnas pa sems nyid kyi rgyan du bkod pa dang :gzhag pa sems kyi ra bar gzhug pa dang : 'phro ba sems kyi rol par shar ba'o: 3) gang zhig dur khrod wa yi sems rtogs sangs chen pa'i gal gyisani: de nyid 'dzin par su 'dod pa: rgyu med 'brasamed rnal du phebs: byung khungs 'gag pa sems kyi gnas btsal ba dang : gnad gzir bas semasakyi rta bsad pa: rtag bcag pas sems ro mchag ji ltar 'dug bstan pa'oḥ gang zhig zo chu lta bu'i sems: 'khrul pa rang dengasatho ba yis: 'di nyid 'joms par su 'dod pa: 'khrul 'khar rang ldan rnal du phebs: ltos pa zad par byas pas sems kyi grangs zad pa dang : 'gro 'ong la brtags pas sems ngos bzung ba dang : de nyid bzlog pas sems lam du bor ba'o: lja:gang zhig nam mkha' lta bu'i sems: ngo bo gcig pa'i phyags shing gis:de nyid sdud par su 'dod pa: chas sku gcig par rnal du phebs: sgo 'gagasapas sems kyi byung tshor stongs pa dang : yul phyung bas sems kyi rten stongs pa dang : rgya bskyed pasasems nyid dbus su dril ba'o: gang zhig sems la dga' —177—

me /de /de /de /de/klo /de ba /dem spyagasu /dem//deba'i gang zag spros pa can:'di nyid goms nas snying po'i don la /deg:de yi phyir na 'di la 'bad par bya:'bad ste goms na rig pa mthong bar /der:zhes bkod pa /de po 'bum phrag drug pa las sems nyid rnal du dbab pa'i dum bu zhes bya ba rdzogs so:rgya rgya rgya:rgya gar skad dusnye/de tra bhe la kra:bod skad du:rgyud lung ga/de ba'i me long :stong pa maphro byung nyid la phyag /de lo:rol pa rja /de lta stangasakyis:gcig par snang ba'i ye shes thob:sgra don shes pa'i rnal /der gyis:/deng ba rnams la ci dgar rol:/del pa /de pa'i rnal /der gyis:ngo bo thamasacad rnal du 'bebs:lta sgom mthong ba'i rnal /der gyis:ye shesanyid la ci bder spyod:de rgyud 'grol ba'i rnal /der gyis:rṣa mongs /de ba'i mdud pa 'grol:dbyings rig shesapa'i rnal /der gyis:sangasargyasarnamasadang /de du gnas:ba/de thabs shesapa'i rnal /der gyis:rig pa /de ni /den du zin:bkol don shes pa'i rnal /der gyis:/decan dum bu rtse ru grol:gol sgrib shes pa'i rnal /der gyis:rang gi de nyid yid /de skyes:rnal /der shesapa'i rnal /der gyis:lta spyod don rnams bdag por /der:gal mdo shes pa'i rnal /der gyis:rgyud tshig rnams la ci dgar rol:dbyings don shes pa'i rnal /der gyis:chos kyi dbyings rnamasadabang du /desasnye skye ma/des shesapa'i rnal /der gyis:skye ga/debar la ci bder spyod:rang snang shesapa'i rnal /der gyis:ye shesartags la thugasaphrad grol:snga phyir shesapa'i rnal /der gyis:gomasashugs byin /desamangon du /den:8
